a: Meematay korin et shema baaravin mishshaa shehakkohanim nichnasim leechol bitrumatan ad sof haashmura harishona divre rabbi eliezer
Vachachamim omrim ad chatzot
Rabban gamliel omer ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar

Maase uvau vanav mibbet hammishte amru lo lo karinu et shema amar lahem im lo ala ammud hashshachar chayyavin attem likrot velo zo bilvad amru ella kal ma sheamru chachamim ad chatzot mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar

Hekter chalavim veevarim mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar vechal hanneechalim leom echad mitzvatan ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar im ken lama amru chachamim ad chatzot kede leharchik adam min haavera
Gema tanna hecha kae dekatane meematay
Vetu may shena detane bearvit beresha litne deshacharit beresha
Tanna akkera kae dichtiv beshachbecha uvkumecha vehachi katane zeman keriat shema dishchiva emat mishshaa shehakkohanim nichnasin leechol bitrumatan
Vei baet ema yalef mibberiyyato shel olam dichtiv vayehi erev vayehi voker yom echad
I hachi sefa dekatane bashshachar mevarech shettayim lefaneha veachat leachareha baerev mevarech shettayim lefaneha ushtayim leachareha litne dearvit beresha
Tanna patach bearvit vahadar tane beshacharit ad dekae beshacharit paresh mile deshacharit vahadar paresh mile dearvit
Amar mar mishshaa shehakkohanim nichnasim leechol bitrumatan mikkedi kohanim emat ka achli teruma mishsheat tzet hakkochavim litne mishsheat tzet hakkochavim

Milleta aggav orcheh kamashma lan kohanim emat ka achli bitruma mishsheat tzet hakkochavim veha kamashma lan dechappara la meakkeva kidtanya uva hashshemesh vetaher biat shimsho meakkavto milleechol bitruma veen kapparato meakkavto milleechol bitruma
Umimmay dehay uva hashshemesh biat hashshemesh vehay vetaher tehar yoma
b: Dilma biat oro hu umay vetaher tehar gavra
Amar rabbah bar rav shela im ken lema kera veyithar may vetaher tehar yoma kidamri inashe iarav shimsha veiddakki yoma
Bemaarava ha derabbah bar rav shela la shemia lehu uvo lah mibaya hay uva hashshemesh biat shimsho hu umay vetaher tehar yoma o dilma biat oro hu umay vetaher tehar gavra
Vahadar pashtu lah mibbarayeta middekatane bevarayeta siman laddavar tzet hakkochavim shema minah biat shimsho hu umay vetaher tehar yoma
Amar mar mishshaa shehakkohanim nichnasin leechol bitrumatan urminhu meematay korin et shema baaravin mishsheheani nichnas leechol pitto bemelach ad shaa sheomed lipater mittoch seuddato
Sefa vadday peliga ammatnitin resha mi lema peligi ammatnitin
La ani vechohen chad shiura hu

Urminhu meematay matchilin likrot keriat shema bearvit mishshaa shebbene adam nichnasin leechol pittan bearve shabbatot divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim mishshaa shehakkohanim zakkain leechol bitrumatan siman laddavar tzet hakkochavim veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar zecher laddavar shenneemar vaanachnu osim bammelacha vechetzyam machazikim barmachim mealot hashshachar ad tzet hakkochavim veomer vehau lanu hallayela mishmar vehayyom melacha
May veomer
Vechi tema mikki arva shimsha lelya hu veinhu demachshechi umakdemi ta shema vehau lanu hallayela mishmar vehayyom melacha
Ka salka datach deani uvne adam chad shiura hu vei amratte ani vechohen chad shiura hu chachamim hayenu rabbi meir
Ella shema minah ani shiura lechud vechohen shiura lechud la ani vechohen chad shiura hu veani uvne adam lav chad shiura hu

Veani vechohen chad shiura hu urminhu meematay matchilin likrot shema baaravin mishshaa shekkadash hayyom bearve shabbatot divre rabbi eliezer rabbi yehoshua omer mishshaa shehakkohanim metoharim leechol bitrumatan rabbi meir omer mishshaa shehakkohanim tovlin leechol bitrumatan amar lo rabbi yehuda vahalo kohanim mibbeod yom hem tovlim rabbi chanina omer mishshaa sheani nichnas leechol pitto bemelach rabbi achay veamri lah rabbi acha omer mishshaa sherov bene adam nichnasin lehasev
Vei amratte ani vechohen chad shiura hu rabbi chanina hayenu rabbi yehoshua
Ella lav shema minah shiura deani lechud veshiura dechohen lechud shema minah
He minayehu meuchar mistabbera deani meuchar dei amratte deani mukdam rabbi chanina hayenu rabbi eliezer ella lav shema minah deani meuchar shema minah
Amar mar amar leh rabbi yehuda vahalo kohanim mibbeod yom hem tovlim
Shappir kaamar leh rabbi yehuda lerabbi meir

Verabbi meir hachi kaamar leh mi savratte daana abben hashshemashot didach ka amena ana abben hashshemashot derabbi yose ka amena deamar rabbi yose ben hashshemashot keheref ayin ze nichnas veze yotze vei efshar laamod alav

Kashya derabbi eliezer adderabbi eliezer
Tere tannae alliba derabbi eliezer veibaet ema resha lav rabbi eliezer hi
Ad sof haashmura
May kasavar rabbi eliezer i kasavar shalosh mishmarot have hallayela lema ad arba shaot vei kasavar arba mishmarot have hallayela lema ad shalosh shaot

Leolam kasavar shalosh mishmarot have hallayela veha kamashma lan deika mishmarot barakia veika mishmarot beara detanya rabbi eliezer omer shalosh mishmarot have hallayela veal kal mishmar umishmar yoshev hakkadosh baruch hu veshoeg kaari shenneemar mimmarom yishag umimmeon kadsho yitten kolo shaog yishag al navehu
Vesiman laddavar mishmara rishona chamor noer sheniyya kelavim tzoakim shelishit tinok yonek mishshede immo veishsha mesapperet im baalah
May ka chashev rabbi eliezer i techillat mishmarot ka chashev techillat mishmara rishona simana lema li urta hu i sof mishmarot ka chashev sof mishmara acharona lema li simana yemama hu
Ella chashev sof mishmara rishona utchillat mishmara acharona veemtzait deemtzaita veibaet ema kullehu sof mishmarot ka chashev vechi tema acharona la tzerich
Lemay nafka minah lemikre keriat shema leman degane bevayit afel vela yada zeman keriat shema emat kevan deishsha mesapperet im baalah vetinok yonek mishshede immo likum velikre

Amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel mishshemeh derav shalosh mishmarot have hallayela veal kal mishmar umishmar yoshev hakkadosh baruch hu veshoeg kaari veomer oy shehecheravti et beti vesarafti et hechali vehigleti et banay leven ummot haolam

Tanya amar rabbi yose paam achat hayiti mehallech badderech venichnasti lechurba achat mechurvot yerushalayim lehitpallel ba eliyyahu zachur lattov veshamar li al happetach vehimtin li ad shessiyamti tefillati leachar shessiyamti tefillati amar li shalom alecha rabbi veamarti lo shalom alecha rabbi umori veamar li beni mippene ma nichnasta lechurba zo amarti lo lehitpallel veamar li haya lecha lehitpallel badderech veamarti lo mityare hayiti shemma yafsiku bi ovre derachim veamar li haya lecha lehitpallel tefilla ketzara
Beotah shaa lamadti mimmennu shelosha devarim lamadti sheen nichnasin lechurba velamadti shemmitpallelin badderech velamadti shehammitpallel bederech mitpallel tefilla ketzara

Veamar li beni ma kol shamata bechurba zo veamarti lo shamati bat kol shemmenahemet keona veomeret oy shehecheravti et beti vesarafti et hechali vehigleti et banay leven ummot haolam veamar li chayyecha vechayye roshcha lo shaa zo bilvad omeret kach ella bechal yom vaom shalosh peamim omeret kach velo zo bilvad ella beshaa sheyyisrael nichnasin levatte kenesiyyot ulvatte midrashot veonin yehe shemeh haggadol mevorach hakkadosh baruch hu menanea rosho veomer ashre hammelech shemmekallesin oto beveto kach ma lo laav shehigla et banav veoy lahem labbanim sheggalu meal shulchan avihem
Tanu rabbanan mippene shelosha devarim en nichnasin lechurba mippene chashad mippene hammappolet umippene hammazzikin mippene chashad vetipok leh mishshum mappolet

Tanu rabbanan arba mishmarot have hallayela divre rabbi rabbi natan omer shalosh
May tameh derabbi natan dichtiv vayyavo gidon umea ish asher itto biktze hammachane rosh haashmoret hattichona tana en tichona ella sheyyesh lefaneha ulachareha

Verabbi natan mi ketiv tichona shebbattichonot tichona ketiv

May tameh derabbi amar rabbi zerika amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi katuv echad omer chatzot layela akum lehodot lach al mishpete tzidkecha vechatuv echad omer kiddemu enay ashmurot ha ketzad arba mishmarot have hallayela
Verabbi natan savar lah kerabbi yehoshua ditnan rabbi yehoshua omer ad shalosh shaot shekken derech melachim laamod beshalosh shaot shet delelya vetarte dimama hau lehu shette mishmarot
Rav ashe amar mishmara ufalga name mishmarot karu lehu
Veamar rabbi zerika amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi en omrin bifne hammet ella devarav shel met
Amar rabbi abba bar kahana la amaran ella bedivre tora aval mile dealma let lan bah
Veika deamri amar rabbi abba bar kahana la amaran ella afilu bedivre tora vechal shekken mile dealma
Vedavid befalga delelya hava kae meurta hava kae dichtiv kiddamti vanneshef vaashavea umimmay dehay neshef urta hu dichtiv beneshef beerev yom beishon layela vaafela
Amar rav oshaya amar rabbi acha hachi kaamar david meolam lo avar alay chatzot layela beshena
Rabbi zera amar ad chatzot layela haya mitnamnem kesus mikkan veelach haya mitgabber kaari rav ashe amar ad chatzot layela haya osek bedivre tora mikkan veelach beshirot vetishbachot
Veneshef urta hu ha neshef tzafra hu dichtiv vayyakkem david mehanneshef vead haerev lemachoratam may lav mitztzafra vead lelya
La meurta vead urta
I hachi lichtov mehanneshef vead hanneshef o mehaerev vead haerev
Ella amar rava tere nishfe hau neshaf lelya veate yemama neshaf yemama veate lelya
Vedavid mi hava yada palga delelya emat hashta moshe rabbenu la hava yada dichtiv kachatzot hallayela ani yotze betoch mitzrayim
May kachatzot ilema daamar leh kudsha berich hu kachatzot mi ika sefeka kamme shemayya ella daamar leh limchar bachatzot ki hashta vaata ihu vaamar kachatzot alma mesappeka leh vedavid hava yada

David simana hava leh deamar rav acha bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida kinnor haya taluy lemala mimmittato shel david vechevan shehiggia chatzot layela ba ruach tzefonit venoshevet bo umnaggen meelav miyyad haya omed veosek battora ad sheala ammud hashshachar kevan sheala ammud hashshachar nichnesu chachme yisrael etzlo amru lo adonenu hammelech ammecha yisrael tzerichin parnasa amar lahem lechu vehitparnesu ze mizze amru lo en hakkometz masbia et haari veen habbor mitmalle mechulyato amar lahem lechu ufishtu yedechem bigdud
Miyyad yoatzim baachitofel venimlachin besanhedrin veshoalin beurim vetummim
Amar rav yosef may kera dichtiv veachare achitofel benayahu ben yehoyada veevyatar vesar tzava lammelech yoav
Achitofel ze yoetz vechen hu omer vaatzat achitofel asher yaatz bayyamim hahem kaasher yishal ish bidvar haelohim

a: Benayahu ben yehoyada ze sanhedrin veevyatar ellu urim vetummim
Vechen hu omer uvnayahu ben yehoyada al hakkereti veal happeleti velamma nikra shemam kereti ufleti kereti shekkortim divrehem peleti shemmuflaim bedivrehem veachar kach sar tzava lammelech yoav
Amar rav yitzchak bar adda veamri lah amar rav yitzchak bereh derav idi may kera ura chevodi ura hannevel vechinnor aira shachar
Rabbi zera amar moshe leolam hava yada vedavid name hava yada
Vechevan dedavid hava yada kinnor lema leh leitteore mishshinteh
Vechevan demoshe hava yada lema leh lememar kachatzot moshe kasavar shemma yitu itztagnine paro veyomru moshe badday hu deamar mar lammed leshoncha lomar eni yodea shemma titbadde veteachez
Rav ashe amar befalga urta ditlesar naghe arbesar hava kae vehachi kaamar moshe leyisrael amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemachar kachatzot hallayela ki haidana ani yotze betoch mitzrayim

Ledavid shamra nafshi ki chasid ani levi verabbi yitzchak chad amar kach amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam lo chasid ani shekkal malche mizrach umaarav yeshenim ad shalosh shaot vaani chatzot layela akum lehodot lecha

Veidach kach amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam lo chasid ani shekkal malche mizrach umaarav yoshvim aguddot aguddot bichvodam vaani yaday meluchlachot bedam uvshafir uvshilya kede letaher ishsha levaalah velo od ella kal ma sheani ose ani nimlach bimfivoshet rabbi veomer lo mefivoshet rabbi yafe danti yafe chiyavti yafe zikkiti yafe tiharti yafe timmeti velo boshti
Amar rabbi yehoshua bereh derav idi may kera vaadabbera veedotecha neged melachim velo evosh
Tana lo mefivoshet shemo ella ish bshet shemo velamma nikra shemo mefivoshet shehaya mevayyesh pene david bahalacha lefichach zacha david veyatza mimmennu kilav
Veamar rabbi yochanan lo kilav shemo ella daniel shemo velamma nikra shemo kilav shehaya machlim pene mefivoshet bahalacha
Vealav amar shelomo bechachmato beni im chacham libbecha yismach libbi gam ani veomer chacham beni vesammach libbi veashiva chorfi davar

Vedavid mi kare lenafsheh chasid vehachtiv lule heemanti lirot betuv beeretz chayyim vetana mishshemeh derabbi yose lamma nakud al lule amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam muvtach ani becha sheatta meshallem sachar tov latztzaddikim leatid lavo aval eni yodea im yesh li chelek benehem im lav
Shemma yigrom hachet
Kidrabbi yaakov bar idi derabbi yaakov bar idi rame ketiv vehinne anochi immach ushmarticha bechal asher telech uchtiv vayyira yaakov meod amar shemma yigrom hachet
Kidtanya ad yaavor ammecha ad yaavor am zu kanita

Ad yaavor ammecha zo bia rishona ad yaavor am zu kanita zo bia sheniyya mikkan amru chachamim reuyim hau yisrael leasot lahem nes bime ezra kederech shennaasa lahem bime yehoshua bin nun ella sheggaram hachet
Vachachamim omrim ad chatzot chachamim keman sevira lehu i kerabbi eliezer sevira lehu lemru kerabbi eliezer
b: Vei kerabban gamliel sevira lehu lemru kerabban gamliel

Leolam kerabban gamliel sevira lehu veha deka amri ad chatzot kede leharchik et haadam min haavera kidtanya chachamim asu seyag ledivrehem kede shello yehe adam ba min hassade baerev veomer elech leveti veochal kima veeshte kima veishan kima veachar kach ekra keriat shema veetpallel vechotafto shena venimtza yashen kal hallayela aval adam ba min hassade baerev nichnas levet hakkeneset im ragil likrot kore veim ragil lishnot shone vekore keriat shema umitpallel veochel pitto umvarech
Vechal haover al divre chachamim chayyav mita

Ibaet ema mishshum deika ones shena veibaet ema leappoke mimman deamar tefillat arvit reshut ka mashma lan dechova

Amar mar kore keriat shema umitpallel mesayya leh lerabbi yochanan deamar rabbi yochanan ezehu ben haolam habba ze hassomech geulla litfilla shel arvit rabbi yehoshua ben levi omer tefillot baemtza tikkenum
Bemay ka mippallegi

Derabbi yochanan savar geulla meurta name have ella geulla meallayeta la haveya ella ad tzafra verabbi yehoshua ben levi savar kevan dela haveya ella mitztzafra la haveya geulla meallayeta
Veibaet ema kera ushnehem mikra echad darshu dichtiv beshachbecha uvkumecha

Metiv mar bereh deravina baerev mevarech shettayim lefaneha ushtayim leachareha vei amratte bae lismoch ha la ka samech geulla litfilla deha bae lememar hashkivenu

Amri kevan detakkinu rabbanan hashkivenu kigulla arichta damya dei la tema hachi shacharit hechi matze samech veha amar rabbi yochanan battechilla omer sefatay tiftach ulvassof hu omer yihu leratzon imre fi
Ella hatam kevan detakkinu rabbanan lememar sefatay tiftach kitfilla arichta damya hacha name kevan detakkinu rabbanan lememar hashkivenu kigulla arichta damya
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi avina kal haomer tehilla ledavid bechal yom shalosh peamim muvtach lo shehu ben haolam habba
May tama
Ilema mishshum deatya bealef bet nema ashre temime darech deatya bitmanya appin
Ella mishshum deit beh poteach et yadecha nema hallel haggadol dichtiv beh noten lechem lechal basar
Ella mishshum deit beh tarte
Amar rabbi yochanan mippene ma lo neemar nun beashre mippene sheyyesh bah mappaltan shel sone yisrael dichtiv nafla lo tosif kum betulat yisrael
Bemareva metartzi lah hachi nafla velo tosif linpol od kum betulat yisrael amar rav nachman bar yitzchak afilu hachi chazar david usmachan beruach hakkodesh shenneemar somech lechal hannoflim

Amar rabbi elazar bar avina gadol ma shenneemar bemichael yoter mimma shenneemar begavriel deilu bemichael ketiv vayyaof elay echad min hasserafim veilu gabbe gavriel ketiv vehaish gavriel asher raiti vechazon battechilla muaf biaf vego
May mashma dehay echad michael hu
Amar rabbi yochanan atya echad echad ketiv hacha vayyaof elay echad min hasserafim uchtiv hatam vehinne michael echad min hassarim harishonim ba leazreni
Tana michael beachat gavriel bishtayim eliyyahu bearba umalach hammavet bishmone uvishat hammaggefa beechat
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi af al pi shekkara adam keriat shema bevet hakkeneset mitzva likroto al mittato amar rabbi yose may kera rigzu veal techetau imru vilvavchem al mishkavchem vedommu sela
Amar rav nachman

a: Im talmid chacham hu en tzarich amar abbaye af talmid chacham mibe leh lememar chad pesuka derachame kegon beyadcha afkid ruchi padita oti el emet

Amar rabbi levi bar chama amar rabbi shimon ben lakish leolam yargiz adam yetzer tov al yetzer hara shenneemar rigzu veal techetau im nitztzecho mutav veim lav yaasok battora shenneemar imru vilvavchem im nitztzecho mutav veim lav yikra keriat shema shenneemar al mishkavchem im nitztzecho mutav veim lav yizkor lo yom hammita shenneemar vedommu sela

Veamar rabbi levi bar chama amar rabbi shimon ben lakish may dichtiv veettena lecha et luchot haeven vehattora vehammitzva asher katavti lehorotam luchot ellu aseret haddibberot tora ze mikra vehammitzva zo mishna asher katavti ellu neviim uchtuvim lehorotam ze talmud melammed shekkullam nittenu lemoshe missinay

Amar rabbi yitzchak kol hakkore keriat shema al mittato keillu ochez cherev shel shette fiyyot beyado shenneemar rommot el bigronam vecherev pifiyyot beyadam may mashma amar mar zutra veitema rav ashe meresha deinyana dichtiv yalezu chasidim bechavod yerannenu al mishkevotam uchtiv batreh rommot el bigronam vecherev pifiyyot beyadam

Veamar rabbi yitzchak kol hakkore keriat shema al mittato mazzikin bedelin hemennu shenneemar uvne reshef yagbihu uf veen uf ella tora shenneemar hataif enecha bo veenennu veen reshef ella mazzikin shenneemar meze raav ulchume reshef veketev meriri

Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish kol haosek battora yissurin bedelin hemennu shenneemar uvne reshef yagbihu uf veen uf ella tora shenneemar hataif enecha bo veenennu veen reshef ella yissurin shenneemar meze raav ulchume reshef

Amar leh rabbi yochanan ha afilu tinokot shel bet rabban yodin oto shenneemar vayyomer im shamoa tishma lekol elohecha vehayyashar beenav taase vehaazanta lemitzotav veshamarta kol chukkav kol hammachala asher samti vemitzrayim lo asim alecha ki ani rofecha ella kol sheefshar lo laasok battora veeno osek hakkadosh baruch hu mevi alav yissurin mechoarin veochrin oto shenneemar neelamti dumiyya hechesheti mittov uchevi nekar veen tov ella tora shenneemar ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu

Amar rabbi zera veitema rabbi chanina bar pappa bo ure shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam middat basar vadam adam mocher chefetz lachavero mocher atzev velokeach sameach aval hakkadosh baruch hu eno ken natan lahem tora leyisrael vesamach shenneemar ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu

Amar rava veitema rav chisda im roe adam sheyyissurin bain alav yefashpesh bemaasav shenneemar nachpesa derachenu venachkora venashuva ad pishpesh velo matza yitle bevittul tora shenneemar ashre haggever asher teyasserennu yah umittoratcha telammedennu
Veim tala velo matza beyadua sheyyissurin shel ahava hem shenneemar ki et asher yeehav yochiach
Amar rava amar rav sechora amar rav huna kol shehakkadosh baruch hu chafatz bo medakkeo beyissurin shenneemar va chafetz dakkeo hecheli
Yachol afilu lo kibbelam meahava talmud lomar im tasim asham nafsho ma asham ledaat af yissurin ledaat
Veim kibbelam ma secharo yire zera yaarich yamim velo od ella shettalmudo mitkayyem beyado shenneemar vechefetz beyado yitzlach
Peligi bah rabbi yaakov bar idi verabbi acha bar chanina chad amar ellu hem yissurin shel ahava kol sheen bahen bittul tora shenneemar ashre haggever asher teyasserennu yah umittoratcha telammedennu
Vechad amar ellu hen yissurin shel ahava kol sheen bahen bittul tefilla shenneemar baruch elohim asher lo hesir tefillati vechasdo meitti
Amar lehu rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba hachi amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan ellu vaellu yissurin shel ahava hen shenneemar ki et asher yeehav yochiach
Ella ma talmud lomar umittoratcha telammedennu al tikre telammedennu ella telammedenu davar ze mittoratcha telammedenu
Kal vachomer mishshen vaayin ma shen vaayin shehen echad meevarav shel adam eved yotze bahen lecherut yissurin shemmemarkin kol gufo shel adam al achat kamma vechamma

Vehayenu derabbi shimon ben lakish deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish neemar berit bemelach veneemar berit beyissurin neemar berit bemelach dichtiv velo tashbit melach berit veneemar berit beyissurin dichtiv elle divre habberit ma berit haamur bemelach melach mematteket et habbasar af berit haamur beyissurin yissurin memarkin kol aonotav shel adam
Tanya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer shalosh mattanot tovot natan hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael vechullan lo netanan ella al yede yissurin ellu hen tora veeretz yisrael vehaolam habba
Tora minnayin shenneemar ashre haggever asher teyasserennu yah umittoratcha telammedennu
Eretz yisrael dichtiv ki kaasher yeyasser ish et beno elohecha meyasserekka uchtiv batreh ki elohecha meviacha el eretz tova
Haolam habba dichtiv ki ner mitzva vetora or vederech chayyim tochchot musar
Tane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan kol haosek betora uvigmilut chasadim
b: Vekover et banav mochalin lo al kol aonotav

Amar leh rabbi yochanan bishlama tora ugmilut chasadim dichtiv bechesed veemet yechuppar aon chesed zo gemilut chasadim shenneemar rodef tzedaka vachased yimtza chayyim tzedaka vechavod emet zo tora shenneemar emet kene veal timkor ella kover et banav minnayin
Tena leh hahu sava mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay atya aon aon ketiv hacha bechesed veemet yechuppar aon uchtiv hatam umshallem aon avot el chek benehem
Amar rabbi yochanan negaim uvanim enan yissurin shel ahava
Ungaim la vehatanya kol mi sheyyesh bo echad mearbaa marot negaim hallalu enan ella mizbach kappara
Mizbach kappara hau yissurin shel ahava la hau
Vei baet ema ha lan veha lehu
Vei baet ema ha betzina ha befarhesya
Uvanim la hechi dame ilema dahao lehu umetu veha amar rabbi yochanan den garma daasiraa bir ella ha dela hao leh kelal veha dahao leh umetu
Rabbi chiyya bar abba chalash al legabbeh rabbi yochanan amar leh chavivin alecha yissurin amar leh lo hen velo secharan amar leh hav li yedach yehav leh yedeh veokmeh
Rabbi yochanan chalash al legabbeh rabbi chanina amar leh chavivin alecha yissurin amar leh lo hen velo secharan amar leh hav li yedach yehav leh yedeh veokmeh
Ammay lokim rabbi yochanan lenafsheh
Amri en chavush mattir atzmo mibbet haasurim

Rabbi elazar chalash al legabbeh rabbi yochanan chaza dahava ka gane bevet afel galyeh lidraeh unfal nehora chazyeh dahava ka bache rabbi elazar amar leh ammay ka bachet i mishshum tora dela appeshte shaninu echad hammarbe veechad hammamit uvilvad sheyechaven libbo lashshamayim vei mishshum mezone lo kol adam zoche lishte shulchanot vei mishshum bene den garma daasiraa bir
Amar leh lehay shufra devale beafra ka bachena amar leh al da vadday ka bachet uvcho tarvayehu
Addehachi vehachi amar leh chavivin alecha yissurin amar leh lo hen velo secharan amar leh hav li yedach yehav leh yedeh veokmeh

Rav huna tekifu leh arba mea danne dechamra al legabbeh rav yehuda achuh derav salla chasida verabbanan veamri lah rav adda bar ahava verabbanan vaamaru leh leayyen mar bemileh amar lehu umi chashidna beenayechu amaru leh mi chashid kudsha berich hu deaved dina bela dina
Amar lehu i ika man dishmia alay milleta lema amaru leh hachi shemia lan dela yahev mar shevisha laariseh
Amar lehu mi ka shavek li mide mineh ha ka ganev leh kulleh
Amaru leh hayenu deamri inashe batar gannava genov vetama teem amar lehu kabbelna alay deyahevna leh ika deamri hadar challa vahava chamra veika deamri iyakkar challa veizdevan bidme dechamra

Tanya abba binyamin omer al shene devarim hayiti mitztaer kol yamay al tefillati shettehe lifne mittati veal mittati shettehe netuna ben tzafon ledarom al tefillati shettehe lifne mittati may lifne mittati ilema lifne mittati mammash vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav veitema rabbi yehoshua ben levi minnayin lammitpallel shello yehe davar chotzetz beno leven hakkir shenneemar vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir vayyitpallel la tema lifne mittati ella ema samuch lemittati
Veal mittati shettehe netuna ben tzafon laddarom
Deamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina amar rabbi yitzchak kol hannoten mittato ben tzafon ledarom haveyin leh banim zecharim shenneemar utzfuncha temalle vitnam yisbeu vanim
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar af en ishto mappelet nefalim ketiv hacha utzfuncha temalle bitnam uchtiv hatam vayyimleu yameha laledet vehinne tomim bevitnah

Tanya abba binyamin omer shenayim shennichnesu lehitpallel vekadam echad mehem lehitpallel velo himtin et chavero veyatza torfin lo tefillato befanav shenneemar toref nafsho beappo halmaancha teazav aretz
Velo od ella sheggorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael shenneemar veyetak tzur mimkomo veen tzur ella hakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar tzur yeladcha teshi
Veim himtin lo ma secharo

a: Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina zoche labberachot hallalu shenneemar lu hikshavta lemitzotay vayehi channahar shelomecha vetzidkatcha kegalle hayyam vayehi chachol zarecha vetzeetzae meecha vego
Tanya abba binyamin omer ilmale nittena reshut laayin lirot en kol beriyya yechola laamod mippene hammazzikin
Amar abbaye inhu nefishi minan vekayemi alan ki kisla leugya
Amar rav huna kol chad vechad minan alfa missemaleh urvavta miyyammineh
Amar rava hay duchka dehave bechalla minnayehu have hane birche deshalhi minnayehu hane mane derabbanan devalu mechufya didhu hane kare deminnakfan minnayehu

Hay man devae lemida lehu layete kitma nehila venahdar appuryeh uvtzafra chaze ki kare detarnegola hay man devae lemechezinhu layete shilyeta deshunnarta ukkamta bat ukkamta buchreta bat buchreta velikleyeh benura velishchakeh velimle eneh minneh vechaze lehu velishdeyeh beguvta defarzela velachtemeh begushpanka defarzela dilma ganvi minneh velachtom pummeh ki hechi dela litazzak rav bivi bar abbaye avad hachi chaza veittazzak beo rabbanan rachame aleh veittassi
Tanya abba binyamin omer en tefilla shel adam nishmaat ella bevet hakkeneset shenneemar lishmoa el harinna veel hattefilla bimkom rinna sham tehe tefilla
Amar ravin bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu matzuy bevet hakkeneset shenneemar elohim nitztzav baadat el
Uminnayin laasara shemmitpallelin sheshshechina immahem shenneemar elohim nitztzav baadat el
Uminnayin lishlosha sheyyoshvin baddin sheshshechina immahem shenneemar bekerev elohim yishpot
Uminnayin lishnayim sheyyoshvin veoskin battora sheshshechina immahem shenneemar az nidberu yire ish el reehu vayyakshev vego
May ulchoshve shemo amar rav ashe chashav adam laasot mitzva veneenas velo asaah maale alav hakkatuv keilu asaah
Uminnayin sheafilu echad sheyyoshev veosek battora sheshshechina immo shenneemar bechal hammakom asher azkir et shemi avo elecha uverachticha
Vechi meachar daafilu chad tere mibbaya tere mikkatvan millayehu besefer hazzichronot chad la mikkatvan milleh besefer hazzichronot
Vechi meachar daafilu tere telata mibbaya mahu detema dina shelama bealma hu vela atya shechina kamashma lan dedina name hayenu tora
Vechi meachar daafilu telata asara mibbaya asara kadma shechina veatya telata ad deyatvi
Amar rabbi avin bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu manniach tefilin shenneemar nishba bimino uvizroa uzzo
Bimino zo tora shenneemar mimino esh dat lamo uvizroa uzzo ellu tefilin shenneemar oz leammo yitten
Uminnayin shehattefilin oz hem leyisrael dichtiv verau kol amme haaretz ki shem nikra alecha veyaru mimmekka vetanya rabbi eliezer haggadol omer ellu tefilin shebbarosh
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav chiyya bar avin hane tefilin demare alma ma ketiv behu amar leh umi keammecha yisrael goy echad baaretz

Umi mishtabbach kudsha berich hu beshivchayehu deyisrael in dichtiv et heemarta hayyom uchtiv va heemircha hayyom amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael attem asituni chativa achat baolam vaani eese etchem chativa achat baolam
Attem asituni chativa achat baolam shenneemar shema yisrael elohenu echad vaani eese etchem chativa achat baolam shenneemar umi keammecha yisrael goy echad baaretz
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe tinach bechad beta bishar batte may
Amar leh ki mi goy gadol umi goy gadol ashrecha yisrael o hanissa elohim ultittecha elon

I hachi nefishi lehu tuve batte ella ki mi goy gadol umi goy gadol dedomyan lahadade bechad beta ashrecha yisrael umi keammecha yisrael bechad beta o hanissa elohim bechad beta ultittecha elon bechad beta
b: Vechullehu ketivi beedraeh

Amar ravin bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak kol haragil lavo levet hakkeneset velo ba yom echad hakkadosh baruch hu meshael bo shenneemar mi vachem yere shomea bekol avdo asher halach chashechim veen nogah lo
Im lidvar mitzva halach nogah lo veim lidvar harshut halach en nogah lo
Yivtach beshem may tama mishshum dahava leh livtoach beshem vela betach
Amar rabbi yochanan beshaa shehakkadosh baruch hu ba bevet hakkeneset velo matza bah asara miyyad hu koes shenneemar maddua bati veen ish karati veen one
Amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna kol hakkovea makom litfillato elohe avraham beezro
Uchshemmet omrim lo e anav e chasid mittalmidav shel avraham avinu
Veavraham avinu mena lan dikva makom dichtiv vayyashkem avraham babboker el hammakom asher amad sham veen amida ella tefilla shenneemar vayyaamod pinchas vayefallel
Amar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna hayyotze mibbet hakkeneset al yafsia pesia gassa amar abbaye la amaran ella lemipak aval lemeal mitzva lemirhat shenneemar nirdefa ladaat et

Amar rabbi zera meresh ki hava chazena lehu lerabbanan deka rahati lefirka beshabbeta amena ka mechallayin rabbanan shabbeta kevan dishmana leha derabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi leolam yarutz adam lidvar halacha vaafilu beshabbat shenneemar achare yelchu kearye yishag vego ana name rahetna
Amar rabbi zera agra defirka rihata
Amar abbaye agra dechalla duchka
Amar rava agra dishmata sevara
Amar rav pappa agra deve tamya shetikuta
Amar mar zutra agra detaanita tzidketa
Amar rav sheshet agra dehespeda dalloye
Amar rav ashe agra deve hillule mile
Amar rav huna kol hammitpallel achore bet hakkeneset nikra rasha shenneemar saviv reshaim yithallachun
Amar abbaye la amaran ella dela mahdar appeh leve kenishta aval mahdar appeh leve kenishta let lan bah
Hahu gavra deka metzalle achore be kenishta vela mahdar appeh leve kenishta chalaf eliyyahu chazyeh idmi leh ketayyaa amar leh kedu var kayematte kamme marach shelaf safsera vekatleh
Amar leh hahu merabbanan lerav bivi bar abbaye veamri lah rav bivi lerav nachman bar yitzchak may kerum zullut livne adam
Amar leh ellu devarim sheomdim berumo shel olam uvne adam mezalzelin bahen
Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayehu kevan shennitztarech adam labberiyyot panav mishtannot kichrum shenneemar kerum zullut livne adam
May kerum ki ata rav dimi amar of echad yesh bichrakke hayyam uchrum shemo vechevan shechamma zorachat mithappech lechamma geonin
Rabbi amme verabbi assi deamri tarvayehu keillu niddon bishne dinim esh umayim shenneemar hirkavta enosh leroshenu banu vaesh uvammayim

Veamar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna leolam yehe adam zahir bitfillat hammincha shehare eliyyahu lo naana ella bitfillat hammincha shenneemar vayehi baalot hammincha vayyiggash eliyyahu hannavi vayyomar vego aneni aneni
Aneni shettered esh min hashshamayim vaaneni shello yomru maase cheshafim hem

Rabbi yochanan amar af bitfillat arvit shenneemar tikkon tefillati ketoret lefanecha masat kappay minchat arev rav nachman bar yitzchak amar af tefillat shacharit shenneemar boker tishma koli boker eeroch lecha vaatzappe
Veamar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna kol hannehene misseudat chatan veeno mesammecho over bachamishsha kolot shenneemar kol sason vekol simcha kol chatan vekol kalla kol omrim hodu et tzevaot

Veim mesammecho ma secharo amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi zoche lattora shennittena bachamishsha kolot shenneemar vayehi vayyom hashshelishi bihot habboker vayehi kolot uvrakim veanan kaved al hahar vekol shofar vego vayehi kol hashshofar vego vehaelohim yaanennu vekol
Ini veha ketiv vechol haam roim et hakkolot
Otan kolot dekodem mattan tora hao
Rabbi avahu amar keilu hikriv toda shenneemar meviim toda bet rav nachman bar yitzchak amar keilu bana achat mechurvot yerushalayim shenneemar ki ashiv et shevut haaretz kevarishona amar
Veamar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna kol adam sheyyesh bo yirat shamayim devarav nishmain shenneemar sof davar hakkol nishma et haelohim yera vego
May ki ze kol haadam amar rabbi elazar amar hakkadosh baruch hu kol haolam kullo lo nivra ella bishvil ze
Rabbi abba bar kahana amar shakul ze keneged kol haolam kullo rabbi shimon ben azzay omer veamri lah rabbi shimon ben zoma omer kol haolam kullo lo nivra ella litzot laze

Veamar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna kol sheyyodea bachavero shehu ragil liten lo shalom yakdim lo shalom shenneemar bakkesh shalom verodfehu veim natan lo velo hechezir nikra gazlan shenneemar veattem biartem hakkerem gezelat heani bevattechem

a: Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu mitpallel shenneemar vahaviotim el har kadshi vesimmachtim bevet tefillati tefillatam lo neemar ella tefillati mikkan shehakkadosh baruch hu mitpallel
May metzalle

Amar rav zutra bar toviyya amar rav yehi ratzon millefanay sheyyichbeshu rachamay et kaasi veyiggollu rachamay al middotay veetnaheg im banay bemiddat rachamim veekkanes lahem lifnim mishshurat haddin

Tanya amar rabbi yishmael ben elisha paam achat nichnasti lehaktir ketoret lifnay velifnim veraiti achteriel yah tzevaot shehu yoshev al kisse ram venissa veamar li yishmael beni barcheni amarti lo yehi ratzon millefanecha sheyyichbeshu rachamecha et kaascha veyiggollu rachamecha al middotecha vetitnaheg im banecha bemiddat harachamim vetikkanes lahem lifnim mishshurat haddin venina li berosho vekamashma lan shello tehe birkat hedot kalla beenecha

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose minnayin sheen meratztzin lo leadam bishat kaso dichtiv panay yelechu vahanichoti lach amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe hamten li ad sheyyaavru panim shel zaam veaniach lecha
Umi ika ritcha kammeh dekudsha berich hu
In detanya veel zoem bechal yom

Vechamma zamo rega vechamma rega echad mechameshet ribbo ushmonat alafim ushmone meot ushmonim ushmona beshaa vezo hi rega veen kal beriyya yechola lechaven otah shaa chutz mibbilam harasha dichtiv beh veodea daat elon
Hashta daat behemto lo hava yada daat elon hava yada
Ella melammed shehaya yodea lechaven otah shaa shehakkadosh baruch hu koes bah
Vehayenu deamar lehu navi leyisrael ammi zechar na ma yaatz balak melech moav vego may lemaan daat tzidkot
Amar rabbi elazar amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael deu kamma tzedakot asiti immachem shello kaasti bime bilam harasha sheilmale kaasti lo nishtayyer missonehem shel yisrael sarid ufalit
Vehayenu dekaamar leh bilam levalak ma ekkov lo kabbo el uma ezom lo zaam melammed shekkal otan hayyamim lo zaam
Vechamma zamo rega vechamma rega amar rabbi avin veitema rabbi avina rega kememreh
Umna lan derega ratach shenneemar ki rega beappo chayyim birtzono vei baet ema mehacha chavi kimat rega ad yaavor zaam
Veemat ratach amar abbaye behanach telat shae kammayata ki chivara karbalta detarnegola vekae achad kara
Kol shata veshata name kae hachi
Kol shata it beh shuryake summake behahi shata let beh shuryake summake

Hahu mina dahava beshivvuteh derabbi yehoshua ben levi hava ka metzaer leh tuva bikrae yoma chad shekal tarnegola veokmeh ben kareh dearsa veayyen beh sevar ki mata hahi shata elteyeh ki meta hahi shata nayem amar shema minah lav orach ara lemebad hachi verachamav al kal maasav ketiv
Uchtiv gam anosh latztzaddik lo tov
Tana mishshemeh derabbi meir beshaa shehachamma zorachat vechal malche mizrach umaarav mannichim kitrehem berashehem umishtachavim lachamma miyyad koes hakkadosh baruch hu

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose tova mardut achat belibbo shel adam yoter mikkamma malkuot shenneemar veriddefa et meahaveha vego veamra elcha veashuva el ishi harishon ki tov li az meatta veresh lakish amar yoter mimmea malkuot shenneemar techat geara vemevin mehakkot kesil mea
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose shelosha devarim bikkesh moshe millifne hakkadosh baruch hu venatan lo bikkesh shettishre shechina al yisrael venatan lo shenneemar halo belechtecha immanu
Bikkesh shello tishre shechina al ovde kochavim venatan lo shenneemar veniflinu ani veammecha

Bikkesh lehodio derachav shel hakkadosh baruch hu venatan lo shenneemar hodieni na et derachecha amar lefanav ribbono shel olam mippene ma yesh tzaddik vetov lo veyesh tzaddik vera lo yesh rasha vetov lo veyesh rasha vera lo amar lo moshe tzaddik vetov lo tzaddik ben tzaddik tzaddik vera lo tzaddik ben rasha rasha vetov lo rasha ben tzaddik rasha vera lo rasha ben rasha
Amar mar tzaddik vetov lo tzaddik ben tzaddik tzaddik vera lo tzaddik ben rasha ini veha ketiv poked aon avot al banim uchtiv uvanim lo yumtu al avot veramenan kerae ahadade
Umshannenan la kashya ha kesheochazin maase avotehem bidehem ha kesheen ochazin maase avotehem bidehem
Ella hachi kaamar leh tzaddik vetov lo tzaddik gamur tzaddik vera lo tzaddik sheeno gamur rasha vetov lo rasha sheeno gamur rasha vera lo rasha gamur
Ufliga derabbi meir deamar rabbi meir shettayim natnu lo veachat lo natnu lo shenneemar vechannoti et asher achon af al pi sheeno hagun verichamti et asher arachem af al pi sheeno hagun
Vayyomer lo tuchal lirot et panay tana mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben karcha kach amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe kesheratziti lo ratzita achshav sheatta rotze eni rotze
Ufliga derabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan bischar shalosh zacha leshalosh
Bischar vayyaster moshe panav zacha liklaster panim bischar ki yare zacha levayyiru miggeshet elav bischar mehabbit zacha leutmunat yabbit
Vahasiroti et kappi veraita et achoray amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida melammed shehera hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe kesher shel tefilin
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose kal dibbur vedibbur sheyyatza mippi hakkadosh baruch hu letova afilu al tenay lo chazar bo

Mena lan mimmoshe rabbenu shenneemar heref mimmenni veashmidem vego veeese otcha legoy atzum af al gav diva moshe rachame alah demilleta uvattelah afilu hachi okmah bezareh shenneemar bene moshe gershom veeliezer vayyihu vene eliezer rechavya harosh vego uvne rechavya ravu lemala vego
Vetane rav yosef lemala mishshishshim ribbo atya reviyya reviyya ketiv hacha ravu lemala uchtiv hatam uvne yisrael paru vayyishretzu vayyirbu
b: Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay miyyom shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu et haolam lo haya adam shekkerao lehakkadosh baruch hu adon ad shebba avraham ukrao adon shenneemar vayyomar adonay elohim bamma eda ki irashenna
Amar rav af daniel lo naana ella bishvil avraham shenneemar veatta shema elohenu el tefillat avdecha veel tachanunav vehaer panecha al mikdashcha hashshamem lemaan adonay lemaancha mibbee leh
Ella lemaan avraham shekkeraacha adon
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay minnayin sheen meratztzin lo laadam bishat kaaso shenneemar panay yelechu vahanichoti lach
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay miyyom shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu et olamo lo haya adam shehoda lehakkadosh baruch hu ad shebbata lea vehodattu shenneemar happaam ode et

Reuven amar rabbi elazar amra lea reu ma ben beni leven chami deilu ben chami af al gav demiddateh zabbenah livcheruteh dichtiv vayyimkor et bechorato leyaakov chazo ma ketiv beh vayyistom esav et yaakov
Uchtiv vayyomer hachi kara shemo yaakov vayyakeveni ze faamayim vego

Veilu beni af al gav deal kurcheh shakleh yosef livcheruteh minneh dichtiv uvchallelo yetzue aviv nittena bechorato livne yosef afilu hachi la ikkanne beh dichtiv vayyishma reuven vayyatztzilehu miyyadam
Rut may rut amar rabbi yochanan shezzachta veyatza mimmenna david sherivahu lehakkadosh baruch hu beshirot vetishbachot
Mena lan dishma garem amar rabbi eliezer deamar kera lechu chazu mifalot asher sam shammot baaretz al tikre shammot ella shemot

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay kasha tarbut raa betoch beto shel adam yoter mimmilchemet gog umagog shenneemar mizmor ledavid bevarcho mippene avshalom beno uchtiv batreh ma rabbu tzaray rabbim kamim alay veilu gabbe milchemet gog umagog ketiv lamma ragshu goyim ulummim yehgu rik veilu ma rabbu tzaray la ketiv
Mizmor ledavid bevarcho mippene avshalom beno mizmor ledavid kina ledavid mibe leh
Amar rabbi shimon ben avishalom mashal lema haddavar dome leadam sheyyatza alav shetar chov kodem shepperao haya atzev leachar shepperao samach

May en tzur kelohenu en tzayyar kelohenu

Ma asa hakkadosh baruch hu hevi yissurim al chizkiyyahu veamar lo lishayahu lech uvakker et hachole shenneemar bayyamim hahem chala chizkiyyahu lamut vayyavo elav yeshayahu ben amotz hannavi vayyomer elav ko amar tzevaot tzav levetecha ki met atta velo tichye vego may ki met atta velo tichye met atta baolam hazze velo tichye laolam habba
Amar leh may kulle hay amar leh mishshum dela asakte bifriyya urviyya amar leh mishshum dachazay li beruach hakkodesh denafki minay benin dela meallu
Amar leh bahade kavshe derachamana lema lach may demippakkedatte ibi lach lemebad uma denicha kammeh kudsha berich hu laaved
Amar leh hashta hav li berattach efshar degarma zechuta didi vedidach venafki minnay benin dimallu amar leh kevar nigzera alecha gezera amar leh ben amotz kalle nevuatcha vatze
Kach mekkubbelani mibbet avi abba afilu cherev chadda munnachat al tzavaro shel adam al yimna atzmo min harachamim
Ittemar name rabbi yochanan verabbi eliezer deamri tarvayehu afilu cherev chadda munnachat al tzavaro shel adam al yimna atzmo min harachamim shenneemar hen yikteleni lo ayachel
b: Amar rabbi chanan afilu baal hachalomot omer lo leadam lemachar hu met al yimna atzmo min harachamim shenneemar ki verov chalomot vahavalim udvarim harbe ki et haelohim yera
Miyyad vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir vayyitpallel el
May kir amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mikkirot libbo shenneemar meay meay ochila kirot libbi vego

Rabbi levi amar al iske hakkir amar lefanav ribbono shel olam uma shunammit shello asta ella kir achat ketanna hecheyeta et benah avi abba shechippa et hahechal kullo bechesef uvzahav al achat kamma vechamma zechar na et asher hithallachti lefanecha beemet uvlev shalem vehattov beenecha asiti
May vehattov beenecha asiti amar rav yehuda amar rav shessamach geulla litfilla rabbi levi amar shegganaz sefer refuot
Tanu rabbanan shishsha devarim asa chizkiyyahu hammelech al shelosha hodu lo veal shelosha lo hodu lo
Al shelosha hodu lo ganaz sefer refuot vehodu lo kittet nechash hannechoshet vehodu lo gerar atzmot aviv al mitta shel chavalim vehodu lo
Veal shelosha lo hodu lo satam me gichon velo hodu lo kitztzetz daltot hechal veshiggeram lemelech ashshur velo hodu lo ibber nisan benisan velo hodu lo
Umi let leh lechizkiyyahu hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim ze nisan veen acher nisan
Ella tea bedishmuel deamar shemuel en meabberin et hashshana beom sheloshim shel adar hoil verauy lekovo nisan savar hoil verauy la amrinan
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra kal hattole bizchut atzmo tolin lo bizchut acherim vechal hattole bizchut acherim tolin lo bizchut atzmo

Moshe tala bizchut acherim shenneemar zechor leavraham leyitzchak ulyisrael avadecha talu lo bizchut atzmo shenneemar vayyomer lehashmidam lule moshe vechiro amad bapperetz lefanav lehashiv chamato mehashchit

Chizkiyyahu tala bizchut atzmo dichtiv zechar na et asher hithallachti lefanecha talu lo bizchut acherim shenneemar vegannoti el hair hazzot lehoshiah lemaani ulmaan david avdi vehayenu derabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi may dichtiv hinne leshalom mar li mar afilu beshaa sheshshiger lo hakkadosh baruch hu shalom mar hu lo

Bishlama leman deamar aliyya hayenu dichtiv aliyyat ella leman deamar achsadra may aliyyat

Amar abbaye veitema rabbi yitzchak harotze lehanot yehane keelisha vesheeno rotze lehanot al yehane kishmuel haramati shenneemar utshuvato haramata ki sham beto veamar rabbi yochanan shekkal makom shehalach sham beto immo
Vattomer el ishah hinne na yadati ki ish elohim kadosh hu amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mikkan shehaishsha makkeret beorchin yoter min haish
Kadosh hu mena yada rav ushmuel chad amar shello raata zevuv over al shulchano vechad amar sadin shel pishtan hitztzia al mittato velo raata keri alav
Kadosh hu amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina hu kadosh umsharto eno kadosh shenneemar vayyiggash gechazi lehadfah amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina sheachazah behod yafyah
Over alenu tamid amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov kal hamareach talmid chacham betoch beto umhannehu minnechasav maale alav hakkatuv keilu makriv temidin
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov al yaamod adam bemakom gavoha veyitpallel ella bemakom namuch veyitpallel shenneemar mimmaamakkim keraticha

Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hammitpallel tzarich sheyechaven et raglav shenneemar veraglehem regel yeshara
Amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mishshum rabbi eliezer ben yaakov may dichtiv lo tochlu al haddam lo tochlu kodem shettitpallelu al dimchem

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukva uvilvad shello yomar yotzer or

Amar rabbi mani gadol hakkore keriat shema beonatah yoter mehaosek battora middekatane hakkore mikkan veelach lo hifsid keadam hakkore battora mikkelal dekore beonatah adif

Uvet hillel omrim kal adam kore kedarko shenneemar uvlechtecha vadderech
Im ken lamma neemar uvshachbecha uvkumecha beshaa shebbene adam shochvim uvshaa shebbene adam omdim

Amru lo keday hayita lachuv beatzmecha sheavarta al divre bet hillel

Rav yosef amar asa kedivre bet shammay lo asa velo chelum ditnan mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin

Amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay maase shehalchu zikne bet shammay vezikne bet hillel levakker et rabbi yochanan ben hachoranit metzauhu shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulchano betoch habbayit velo amru lo kelum
Amru lahem umishsham reaya af hem amru lo im ken hayita noheg lo kiyamta mitzvat sukka miyyamecha

Verabbi yochanan amar af lammishna name tzarich levarech aval lattalmud eno tzarich levarech
Verava amar af lattalmud tzarich lachazor ulvarech levarech

May mevarech amar rav yehuda amar shemuel asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu laasok bedivre tora

Hilkach lemrinhu lechullehu

Tenan hatam amar lahem hammunne barchu beracha achat vehem berchu vekaru aseret haddibberot shema vehaya im shamoa vayyomer uverchu et haam shalosh berachot emet veyatztziv vaavoda uvirkat kohanim uvshabbat mosifin beracha achat lammishmar hayyotze

Amemar sevar lemikbeinhu binhardea amar leh rav ashe kevar bittelum mippene taromet hamminin

Uvshabbat mosifin beracha achat lammishmar hayyotze may beracha achat amar rabbi chelbo mishmar hayyotze omer lammishmar hannichnas mi sheshshikken et shemo babbayit hazze hu yashkin benechem ahava veachva veshalom vereut

La leetuye nahama vetamre hechi dame ilema daachal nahama vekasavar detamre achal uftach addata detamre vesayyem bidnahama hayenu bayan

Vela vehatanya maase bechasid echad shennatan dinar leani beerev rosh hashshana bishne vatztzoret vehiknitattu ishto vehalach velan bevet hakkevarot veshama shette ruchot shemsapperot zo lazo amra chada lachavertah chaverti boi venashut baolam venishma meachore happargod ma puranut ba laolam amra lah chavertah eni yechola sheani kevura bemachtzelet shel kanim ella lechi atte uma sheatte shomaat imri li halcha hi veshata uvaa veamra lah chavertah chaverti ma shamate meachore happargod amra lah shamati shekkal hazzorea birvia rishona barad malke oto halach hu vezara birvia sheniyya shel kal haolam kullo laka shello lo laka

Lashshana haacheret halach velan bevet hakkevarot veshama otan shette ruchot shemsapperot zo im zo amra chada lachavertah boi venashut baolam venishma meachore happargod ma puranut ba laolam amra lah chaverti lo kach amarti lach eni yechola sheani kevura bemachtzelet shel kanim ella lechi atte uma sheatte shomaat boi veimri li halcha veshata uvaa veamra lah chavertah chaverti ma shamate meachore happargod amra lah shamati shekkal hazzorea birvia sheniyya shiddafon malke oto halach vezara birvia rishona shel kal haolam kullo nishdaf veshello lo nishdaf

Amra lo ishto mippene ma eshtakad shel kal haolam kullo laka veshellecha lo laka veachshav shel kal haolam kullo nishdaf veshellecha lo nishdaf sach lah kal haddevarim hallalu amru lo hau yamim muatim ad shennafla ketata ben ishto shel oto chasid uven immah shel otah riva amra lah lechi vearech bittech shehi kevura bemachtzelet shel kanim

Lashshana haacheret halach velan bevet hakkevarot veshama otan ruchot shemsapperot zo im zo amra lah chaverti boi venashut baolam venishma meachore happargod ma puranut ba laolam amra lah chaverti hanichini devarim shebbeni levenech kevar nishmeu ben hachayyim alma yadi
Dilma inish acharina shachev veazel veamar lehu

Ta shema dizeri hava mafked zuze gabbe ushpizchateh ad deate veazel leve rav shechiva azal batrah lachatzar mavet amar lah zuze hecha amara leh zil shaklinhu mittute tzinnora dedasha beduch pelan veema lah leima teshaddar li masrekay veguvtay dechuchla bahade pelanita deatya limchar alma yadi
Dilma duma kadem umachrez lehu

Ta shema daavuh dishmuel hao ka mafkedi gabbeh zuze deyatme ki nach nafsheh la hava shemuel gabbeh hao ka karu leh bar achel zuze deyatme azal abbatreh lachatzar mavet amar lehu baena abba amaru leh abba tuva ika hacha amar lehu baena abba bar abba amaru leh abba bar abba name tuva ika hacha amar lehu baena abba bar abba avuh dishmuel hecha amaru leh selek limtivta dirkia addehachi chazyeh lelevi deyatev abbaray amar leh ammay yatvatte abbaray may tama la salkatte amar leh deamri li kal ki hanach shene dela selekte limtivta derabbi appas veachleshteh ledateh la meayelinan lach limtivta dirkia

Addehachi vehachi ata avuh chazyeh dahava ka vache veachech amar leh may tama ka vachet amar leh delaagal ka atet may tama achechte dachashivatte behay alma tuva amar leh i chashivna neayeluh lelevi veayeluhu lelevi

Amar leh zuze deyatme hecha amar leh zil shaklinhu beamta derichya ilae vetattae didan umitze deyatme amar leh may tama avadte hachi amar leh i ganvi gannave migganvu middidan i achla ara achla middidan alma deyadi dilma shane shemuel kevan dachashiv kadmi umachrezi pannu makom

Veaf rabbi yonatan hadar beh deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan minnayin lammetim shemsapperim ze im ze shenneemar vayyomer elav zot haaretz asher nishbati leavraham leyitzchak ulyaakov lemor may lemor amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe lech emor lahem leavraham leyitzchak ulyaakov shevua shennishbati lachem kevar kiyamtiha livnechem

a: Vei salka datach dela yadi ki amar lehu may have ella may deyadi lema leh lememar lehu leachzoke leh tevuta lemoshe
Amar rabbi yitzchak kol hamsapper achare hammet keillu mesapper achare haeven ika deamri dela yadi veika deamri deyadi vela ichpat lehu
Ini veha amar rav pappa chad ishtai milta batreh demar shemuel unfal kanya mittelala uvzaa learneka democheh
Shane tzorva merabbanan dekudsha berich hu tava bikareh

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol hamsapper achar mittatan shel talmide chachamim nofel begehinnam shenneemar vehammattim akalkallotam yolichem et poale haaven shalom al yisrael afilu beshaa sheshshalom al yisrael yolichem et poale haaven

Tana deve rabbi yishmael im raita talmid chacham sheavar avera ballayela al teharher acharav bayyom shemma asa teshuva shemma salka datach ella vadday asa teshuva vehane mile bidvarim shebbegufo aval bemamona ad demahdar lemareh
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi beesrim vearbaa mekomot bet din menaddin al kevod harav vechullan shaninu bemishnatenu amar leh rabbi elazar hecha amar leh lechi tashkach
Nefak dak veashkach telat hamzalzel bintilat yadayim vehamsapper achar mittatan shel talmide chachamim vehammegis dato kelappe mala

Hamsapper achar mittatan shel talmide chachamim may hi ditnan hu haya omer en mashkin lo et haggiyyoret velo et hamshuchreret vachachamim omrim mashkin veamru lo maase becharkemit shifcha meshuchreret birushalayim vehishkuha shemaya veavtalon veamar lahem dugma hishkuha venidduhu umet benidduo vesaklu bet din et arono

Vehamzalzel bintilat yadayim may hi ditnan amar rabbi yehuda chas veshalom sheakavya ben mahalalel nitnadda sheen azara ninelet al kol adam beyisrael bechochma uvtohora uvyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel ella et mi niddu et elazar ben chanoch sheppikpek bintilat yadayim uchshemmet shalchu bet din vehinnichu even gedola al arono lelammedcha shekkal hammitnadde umet benidduo bet din soklin et arono

Hammegis dato kelappe mala may hi ditnan shalach lo shimon ben shetach lechoni hamaggel tzarich atta lehitnaddot veilmale choni atta gozrani alecha nidduy aval ma eese sheatta mitchatte lifne hammakom veose lecha retzoncha keven shemmitchatte lifne aviv veose lo retzono vealecha hakkatuv omer yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha

Vetu leka veha ika detane rav yosef todos ish romi hinhig et bene romi lehaachilan gedayim mekullasin belele pesachim shelach leh shimon ben shatach ilmale todos atta gozrani alecha nidduy sheatta maachil et yisrael kodashim bachutz
Bemishnatenu kaamrinan veha barayeta hi
Uvmatnitin leka veha ika ha ditnan chatacho chulot venatan chol ben chulya lechulya rabbi eliezer metaher vachachamim metammeim vezehu tannuro shel achnay
May achnay amar rav yehuda amar shemuel melammed shehikkifuhu halachot keachnay ze vetimmeuhu
Vetanya oto hayyom heviu kol teharot shettiher rabbi eliezer usrafum lefanav ulvassof berchuhu
Afilu hachi nidduy bematnitin la tenan ella beesrim vearbaa mekomot hecha mashkachatte lah rabbi yehoshua ben levi medamme milta lemilta verabbi elazar la medamme milta lemilta
Nose hammitta vechillufehen tanu rabbanan en motziin et hammet samuch likriat shema veim hitchilu en mafsikin ini veha rav yosef appekuhu samuch likriat shema adam chashuv shane

Shellifne hammitta veshelleachar hammitta tanu rabbanan haoskim behesped bizman shehammet mutal lifnehem nishmatin echad echad vekorin en hammet mutal lifnehem hen yoshvin vekorin vehu yoshev vedomem hem omdim umitpallelin vehu omed umatzdik alav et haddin veomer ribbon haolamim harbe chatati lefanecha velo nifrata mimmenni echad minni elef yehi ratzon millefanecha elohenu shettigdor pirtzotenu ufirtzot kol ammecha bet yisrael berachamim
Amar abbaye la mibbee leh leinash lememar hachi deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish vechen tana mishshemeh derabbi yose leolam al yiftach adam piv lassatan
Veamar rav yosef may keraa shenneemar kimat kisdom hayinu may ahadar lehu navi shimu devar ketzine sedom

Kavru et hammet vechazru vechu im yecholim lehatchil veligmor et kullah in aval perek echad o pasuk echad la urminhu kavru et hammet vechazru im yecholin lehatchil veligmor afilu perek echad o pasuk echad
Hachi name kaamar im yecholin lehatchil veligmor afilu perek echad o afilu pasuk echad ad shello yaggiu lashshura yatchilu veim lav lo yatchilu
b: Haomdim bashshura vechu tanu rabbanan shura haroa penima petura vesheenah roa penima chayyevet rabbi yehuda omer habbaim mechamat haavel peturin mechamat atzman chayyavin
Amar rav yehuda amar rav hammotze kilayim bevigdo poshtan afilu bashshuk may tama en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged kol makom sheyyesh chillul hashshem en cholkin kavod larav

Metivi kavru et hammet vechazru velifnehem shette derachim achat tehora veachat temea ba battehora bain immo battehora ba battemea bain immo battemea mishshum kevodo ammay lema en chochma veen tevuna leneged
Targemah rabbi abba bevet happeras derabbanan
Deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel menappeach adam bet happeras veholech veamar rav yehuda bar ashe mishshemeh derav bet happeras shenniddash tahor

Ta shema deamar rabbi elazar bar tzadok medallegin hayinu al gabbe aronot shel metim likrat malche yisrael velo likrat malche yisrael bilvad amru ella afilu likrat malche ummot haolam sheim yizke yavchin ben malche yisrael lemalche ummot haolam ammay lema en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged
Kidrava deamar rava devar tora ohel kol sheyyesh bo chalal tefach chotzetz bifne hattuma vesheen bo chalal tefach eno chotzetz bifne hattuma
Verov aronot yesh bahen chalal tefach vegazru al sheyyesh bahen mishshum sheen bahen umishshum kevod melachim la gezaru behu rabbanan
Ta shema gadol kevod habberiyyot sheddoche et lo taase shebbattora
Veammay lema en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged targemah rav bar sheva kammeh derav kahana belav delo tasur achichu aleh lav delo tasur deorayeta hi
Amar rav kahana gavra rabba amar milta la techichu aleh kol mile derabbanan asmechinhu al lav delo tasur umishshum kevodo shero rabbanan
Ta shema vehitallamta mehem peamim sheatta mitallem mehem ufamim sheen atta mitallem mehem

Ha ketzad im haya kohen vehi bevet hakkevarot o haya zaken veenah lefi chevodo o shehayeta melachto merubba mishshel chavero lechach neemar vehitallamta ammay lema en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged
Shane hatam dichtiv vehitallamta mehem veligmar minah isura mimmamona la yalfinan
Ta shema
Ulachoto ma talmud lomar hare shehaya holech lishchot et pischo velamul et beno veshama shemmet lo met yachol yachzor veyittamma amarta lo yittamma
Yachol keshem sheeno mittamme lahem kach eno mittamme lemet mitzva talmud lomar ulachoto laachoto hu deeno mittamme

a: Aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva ammay lema en chochma veen tevuna veen etza leneged
Shane hatam dichtiv velaachoto
Veligmar minah shev veal taase shane

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye may shena rishonim deitrechish lehu nisa umay shena anan dela mitrechish lan nisa i mishshum tannoye bishne derav yehuda kulle tannoye binzikin hava vaanan ka matninan shita sidre vechi hava mate rav yehuda beuktzin haishsha shekkoveshet yarak bakkedera veamri lah zetim shekkevashan betarfehen tehorim amar havaot derav ushmuel ka chazena hacha vaanan ka matninan beuktzin telesar metivata veilu rav yehuda ki hava shalef chad mesaneh ate mitra vaanan ka metzaarinan nafshin umitzvach ka tzavechinan velet demashgach ban

Amar leh kammae hao ka masri nafshayehu akkedushshat hashshem anan la masrinan nafshin akkedushshat hashshem ki ha derav adda bar ahava chazyah lehahi kutit dahavat levisha karbalta beshuka sevar devat yisrael hi kam kareh minah iggallay milta dechutit hi shayemuha bearba mea zuze amar lah ma shemich amara leh matun amar lah matun matun arba mea zuze shaveya
Rav gidel hava regil dahava ka azel veyatev ashshaare ditvila amar lehu hachi tevilu vehachi tevilu amri leh rabbanan la ka mistefe mar miyyetzer hara amar lehu damyan beappay ki kake chivare

Rabbi yochanan hava regil dahava ka azel veyatev ashshaare ditvila amar ki salkan benot yisrael veatyan mittevila mistakkelan bi veneheve lehu zara deshappire keoti amri leh rabbanan la ka mistefe mar meena bisha amar lehu ana mizzara deosef ka atena dela shalta beh ena bisha dichtiv ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin veamar rabbi avahu al tikre ale ayin ella ole ayin
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar mehacha veyidgu larov bekerev haaretz ma dagim shebbayyam mayim mechassin alehem veen ayin hara sholetet bahem af zaro shel yosef en ayin hara sholetet bahem
Vei baet ema ayin shello ratzta lizzon mimma sheeno shello en ayin hara sholetet bo
Matni nashim vaavadim uktannim peturin mikkeriat shema
b: Umin hattefilin vechayyavin bitfila uvimzuza uvvirkat hammazon
Gema keriat shema peshita mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot
Mahu detema hoil veit bah malchut shamayim kamashma lan
Umin hattefillin peshita mahu detema hoil veittakkash limzuza kamashma lan
Vechayyavin bitfilla derachame ninhu mahu detema hoil uchtiv bah erev vavoker vetzahorayim kemitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama dame kamashma lan
Uvimzuza peshita mahu detema hoil veittakkash letalmud tora kamashma lan
Uvvirkat hammazon peshita mahu detema hoil uchtiv betet lachem baerev basar leechol velechem babboker lisboa kemitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama dame kamashma lan
Amar rav adda bar ahava nashim chayyavot bekiddush hayyom devar tora ammay mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama hu vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot amar abbaye midderabbanan
Amar leh rava veha devar tora kaamar veod kol mitzvat ase nechayevinhu midderabbanan
Ella amar rava amar kera zachor veshamor kol sheyyeshno bishmira yeshno bizchira vehane neshe hoil veitanhu bishmira itanhu bizchira

Amar leh ravina lerava nashim bevirkat hammazon deorayeta o derabbanan lemay nafka minah leappoke rabbim yede chovatan i amratte bishlama deorayeta ate deorayeta umappek deorayeta ella i amratte derabbanan have sheeno mechuyyav baddavar vechol sheeno mechuyyav baddavar eno motzi et harabbim yede chovatan may
Ta shema beemet amru ben mevarech leaviv veeved mevarech lerabbo veishsha mevarechet levaalah aval amru chachamim tavo meera leadam sheishto uvanav mevarchin lo
I amratte bishlama deorayeta ate deorayeta umappek deorayeta ella i amratte derabbanan ate derabbanan umappek deorayeta
Ultamach katan bar chiyyuva hu ella hacha bemay askinan kegon sheachal shiura derabbanan deate derabbanan umappek derabbanan

Daresh rav avira zimnin amar lah mishshemeh derabbi amme vezimnin amar lah mishshemeh derabbi assi amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam katuv betoratecha asher lo yissa fanim velo yikkach shochad vahalo atta nose panim leyisrael dichtiv yissa panav elecha amar lahem vechi lo essa panim leyisrael shekkatavti lahem battora veachalta vesavata uverachta et elohecha vehem medakdekim al atzmam ad kezayit vead kevetza
Matni baal keri meharher belibbo veeno mevarech lo lefaneha velo leachareha veal hammazon mevarech leacharav veeno mevarech lefanav rabbi yehuda omer mevarech lifnehem ulacharehem
Gema amar ravina zot omeret hirhur kedibbur dame dei salka datach lav kedibbur dame lamma meharher
Ella may hirhur kedibbur dame yotzi bisfatav
Kidashkechan besinay
Verav chisda amar hirhur lav kedibbur dame dei salka datach hirhur kedibbur dame yotzi bisfatav
Ella may hirhur lav kedibbur dame lamma meharher amar rabbi elazar kede shello yehu kol haolam oskin bo vehu yoshev uvatel
Venigros befirka acharina amar rav adda bar ahava bedavar shehatztzibbur oskin bo

a: Vahare tefilla dedavar shehatztzibbur asukin bo utnan haya omed bitfilla venizkar shehu baal keri lo yafsik ella yekatztzer tama deatchel ha la atchel lo yatchil

Shane tefilla delet bah malchut shamayim vahare birkat hammazon leacharav delet bah malchut shamayim utnan al hammazon mevarech leacharav veeno mevarech lefanav ella keriat shema uvirkat hammazon deorayeta utfilla derabbanan
Amar rav yehuda minnayin levirkat hammazon leachareha min hattora shenneemar veachalta vesavata uverachta
Minnayin levirkat hattora lefaneha min hattora shenneemar ki shem ekra havu godel lelohenu

Amar rabbi yochanan lamadnu birkat hattora leachareha min birkat hammazon mikkal vachomer uvirkat hammazon lefaneha min birkat hattora mikkal vachomer birkat hattora leachareha min birkat hammazon mikkal vachomer uma mazon sheen taun lefanav taun leacharav tora shetteuna lefaneha eno din shetteuna leachareha uvirkat hammazon lefaneha min birkat hattora mikkal vachomer uma tora sheen teuna leachareha teuna lefaneha mazon shehu taun leacharav eno din sheyehe taun lefanav
Ika lemifrach ma lemazon shekken nehene uma letora shekken chayye olam veod tenan al hammazon mevarech leacharav veeno mevarech lefanav teuvta

Amar rav yehuda safek kara keriat shema safek lo kara eno chozer vekore safek amar emet veyatztziv safek lo amar chozer veomer emet veyatztziv may tama keriat shema derabbanan emet veyatztziv deorayeta
Metiv rav yosef uvshachbecha uvkumecha amar leh abbaye hahu bedivre tora ketiv
Tenan baal keri meharher belibbo veeno mevarech lo lefaneha velo leachareha veal hammazon mevarech leacharav veeno mevarech lefanav
Vei salka datach emet veyatztziv deorayeta livroch leachareha
May tama mevarech i mishshum yetziat mitzrayim ha adkar leh bikriat shema
Venema ha vela live ha keriat shema adifa deit bah tarte

Verabbi elazar amar safek kara keriat shema safek lo kara chozer vekore keriat shema safek hitpallel safek lo hitpallel eno chozer umitpallel verabbi yochanan amar ulvay sheyyitpallel adam kol hayyom kullo

Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel haya omed bitfilla venizkar shehitpallel posek vaafilu beemtza beracha ini vehaamar rav nachman ki havenan be rabba bar avuh bean mineh hane bene ve rav detau umadkeri dechol beshabbat mahu sheyyigmeru vaamar lan gomrin kol otah beracha
Hachi hashta hatam gavra bar chiyyuva hu verabbanan hu dela atrechuhu mishshum kevod shabbat aval hacha ha tzalli leh
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel hitpallel venichnas levet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur shemmitpallelin im yachol lechaddesh bah davar yachzor veyitpallel veim lav al yachzor veyitpallel
Utzricha dei ashmeinan kammayeta hane mile yachid veyachid
b: O tzibbur vetzibbur aval yachid legabbe tzibbur keman dela tzalli dame kamashma lan vei ashmeinan hacha mishshum dela atchel bah aval hatam deatchel bah ema la tzericha

Amar rav huna hannichnas levet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur shemmitpallelin im yachol lehatchil veligmor ad shello yaggia sheliach tzibbur lemodim yitpallel veim lav al yitpallel rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar im yachol lehatchil veligmor ad shello yaggia sheliach tzibbur likdushsha yitpallel veim lav al yitpallel
Bemay ka mippalgi mar savar yachid omer kedushsha umar savar en yachid omer kedushsha
Vechen amar rav adda bar ahava minnayin sheen hayyachid omer kedushsha shenneemar venikdashti betoch bene yisrael kol davar shebbikdushsha lo yehe pachot measara
May mashma detane ravnay achuh derabbi chiyya bar abba atya toch toch ketiv hacha venikdashti betoch bene yisrael uchtiv hatam hibbadlu mittoch haeda hazzot ma lehallan asara af kan asara
Udchulle alma mihat mifsak la pasek

Ibaya lehu mahu lehafsik lihe shemo haggadol mevorach ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon talmide derabbi yochanan amri lakkol en mafsikin chutz min yehe shemo haggadol mevorach sheafilu osek bemaase merkava posek velet hilcheta kevateh

Rabbi yehuda omer mevarech lifnehem ulacharehem lememra dekasavar rabbi yehuda baal keri muttar bedivre tora vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi minnayin levaal keri sheasur bedivre tora shenneemar vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha usmich leh yom asher amadta vego ma lehallan baale kerayin asurin af kan baale kerayin asurin

Vechi tema rabbi yehuda la daresh semuchim vehaamar rav yosef afilu man dela daresh semuchim bechal hattora bemishne tora daresh deha rabbi yehuda la daresh semuchin bechal hattora kullah uvmishne tora daresh

Uvchol hattora kullah mena lan dela daresh detanya ben azzay omer neemar mechashshefa lo techayye veneemar kol shochev im behema mot yumat semacho inyan lo lomar ma shochev im behema biskila af mechashshefa name biskila

Amar lo rabbi yehuda vechi mippene shessemacho inyan lo notzi laze liskila ella ov veyiddeoni bichlal kol hamchashshefim hau velamma yatzu lehakkish lahen velomar lach ma ov veyiddeoni biskila af mechashshefa biskila
Uvmishne tora mena lan dedaresh detanya rabbi eliezer omer nose adam anusat aviv umfuttat aviv anusat beno umfuttat beno
Rabbi yehuda oser baanusat aviv uvimfuttat aviv veamar rav gidel amar rav may tama derabbi yehuda dichtiv lo yikkach ish et eshet aviv velo yegalle et kenaf aviv kanaf sheraa aviv lo yegalle
Umimmay devaanusat aviv ketiv dismich leh venatan haish hashshochev immah vego

Amri in bemishne tora daresh vehane semuchin mibbee leh leidach derabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol hamlammed livno tora maale alav hakkatuv keillu kibbelah mehar chorev shenneemar vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha uchtiv batreh yom asher amadta lifne elohecha bechorev
Tenan zav sheraa keri venidda sheppalta shichvat zera hamshammeshet veraata dam tzerichin tevila verabbi yehuda poter
Ad kan lo patar rabbi yehuda ella bezav sheraa keri demeikara lav bar tevila hu aval baal keri gereda mechayyav
Vechi tema hu haddin daafilu baal keri gereda name patar rabbi yehuda vehay deka mippallegi bezav sheraa keri lehodiacha kochan derabbanan ema sefa hamshammeshet veraata dam tzericha tevila

Leman katane lah ilema lerabbanan peshita hashta uma zav sheraa keri demeikara lav bar tevila hu mechayevi rabbanan hamshammeshet veraata dam demeikara bat tevila hi lo kol shekken ella lav rabbi yehuda hi vedaveka katane lah

Umi it leh lerabbi yehuda hirhur vehatanya baal keri sheen lo mayim litbol kore keriat shema veeno mevarech lo lefaneha velo leachareha veochel pitto umvarech leachareha veeno mevarech lefaneha aval meharher belibbo veeno motzi bisfatav divre rabbi meir rabbi yehuda omer ben kach uven kach motzi bisfatav

Mikkan amru hazzavim vehamtzoraim uvain al niddot muttarim likrot battora uvanneviim uvakketuvim lishnot bammishna ugmara uvahalachot uvaaggadot aval baale kerayin asurim

Kerabbi ilay bereshit haggez detanya rabbi ilay omer reshit haggez eno noheg ella baaretz
Kerabbi yoshiyya bechilayim kedichtiv lo tizra karmecha kilayim rabbi yoshiyya omer leolam eno chayyav ad sheyyizra chitta usora vechartzan bemappolet yad

Tanu rabbanan baal keri shennatnu alav tisha kabbin mayim tahor bamme devarim amurim leatzmo aval laacherim arbaim sea rabbi yehuda omer arbaim sea mikkol makom

Vechad mehay zuga vechad mehay zuga assefa chad amar ha deamar rabbi yehuda arbaim sea mikkol makom lo shanu ella bekarka aval bechelim lo vechad amar afilu bechelim name
Bishlama leman deamar afilu bechelim hayenu dekatane rabbi yehuda omer arbaim sea mikkol makom ella leman deamar bekarka in bechelim la mikkol makom leetuye may
Leetuye mayim sheuvin

Rav chama tavel bemaale yoma defischa lehotzi rabbim yede chovatan velet hilcheta keoteh
Matni haya omed bitfilla venizkar shehu baal keri lo yafsik ella yekatztzer

Yarad litbol im yachol laalot ulhitkassot velikrot ad shello tehe hanetz hachamma yaale veyitkasse veyikra veim lav yitkasse bemayim veyikra velo yitkasse lo bammayim haraim velo beme hammishra ad sheyyatil letochan mayim vechamma yarchik mehen umin hatztzoa arba ammot

Gema tanu rabbanan haya omed bitfilla venizkar shehu baal keri lo yafsik ella yekatztzer haya kore battora venizkar shehu baal keri eno mafsik veole ella megamgem vekore rabbi meir omer en baal keri rashshay likrot battora yoter mishshelosha pesukim
Tanya idach haya omed bitfilla veraa tzoa kenegdo mehallech lefanav ad sheyyizrekenna laachorav arba ammot vehatanya litzdadin la kashya ha deefshar ha dela efshar
Haya mitpallel umatza tzoa bimkomo amar rabba af al pi shechata tefillato tefilla matkif leh rava veha zevach reshaim toeva ella amar rava hoil vechata af al pi shehitpallel tefillato toeva

Tanu rabbanan haya omed bitfilla umayim shottin al birkav posek ad sheyyichlu hammayim vechozer umitpallel lehechan chozer rav chisda verav hamnuna chad amar chozer larosh vechad amar lemakom sheppasak
Lema beha kamipalgi

a: Mar savar im shaha kede ligmor et kullah chozer larosh umar savar lemakom sheppasak

Amar rav ashe hay im shaha im lo shaha mibe leh ella dechulle alma im shaha kede ligmor et kullah chozer larosh vehatam bidlo shaha kamipalgi demar savar gavra dechuya hu veen rauy veen tefillato tefilla umar savar gavra chazya hu utfillato tefilla

Tanu rabbanan hannitzrach linkavav al yitpallel veim hitpallel tefillato toeva amar rav zevid veitema rav yehuda lo shanu ella sheeno yachol lishhot beatzmo aval im yachol lishhot beatzmo tefillato tefilla
Vead kamma amar rav sheshet ad parsa ika dematne lah ammatnita bamme devarim amurim kesheen yachol laamod al atzmo aval im yachol laamod al atzmo tefillato tefilla vead kamma amar rav zevid ad parsa
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan hannitzrach linkavav hare ze lo yitpallel mishshum shenneemar hikkon likrat elohecha yisrael

Veamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan may dichtiv shemor raglecha kaasher telech el bet haelohim shemor atzmecha shello techta veim techta have korban lefanay vekarov lishmoa divre chachamim amar rava heve karov lishmoa divre chachamim sheim chotim meviim korban veosim teshuva mittet hakkesilim zavach al tehi kakkesilim shechotim umviim korban veen osim teshuva

Ki enam yodim laasot ra i hachi tzaddikim ninhu ella al tehi kakkesilim shechotim umviim korban veenam yodim im al hattova hem meviim im al haraa hem meviim amar hakkadosh baruch hu ben tov lera enan mavchinim vehem meviim korban lefanay
Rav ashe veitema rabbi chanina bar pappa amar shemor nekavecha beshaa sheatta omed bitfilla lefanay

Tanu rabbanan hannichnas levet hakkisse choletz tefilav berichuk arba ammot venichnas amar rav acha bar rav huna amar rav sheshet lo shanu ella bet hakkisse kavua aval bet hakkisse aray choletz venifne lealtar uchshehu yotze marchik arba ammot umannichan mippene sheasao bet hakkisse kavua

Ibaya lehu mahu sheyyikkanes adam bitfilin levet hakkisse kavua lehashtin mayim ravina share rav adda bar matna asar ato shayeluh lerava amar lehu asur chayeshinan shemma yippane bahen veamri lah shemma yafiach bahen

Tanya idach hannichnas levet hakkisse kavua choletz tefilav berichuk arba ammot umannichan bachallon hassamuch lirshut harabbim venichnas uchshehu yotze marchik arba ammot umannichan divre bet shammay uvet hillel omrim ochazan beyado venichnas rabbi akiva omer ochazan bevigdo venichnas

Umannicham bachorin hassemuchim levet hakkisse velo yannichem bachorin hassemuchim lirshut harabbim shemma yittelu otam ovre derachim veyavo lide chashad

Umaase betalmid echad shehinniach tefilav bachorin hassemuchim lirshut harabbim uvat zona achat untalatan uvat levet hammidrash veamra reu ma natan li peloni bischari kevan sheshshama oto talmid kach ala lerosh haggag venafal vamet beotah shaa hitkinu sheyehe ochazan bevigdo uvyado venichnas

Tanu rabbanan barishona hau mannichin tefilin bachorin hassemuchim levet hakkisse uvain achbarim venotlin otan hitkinu sheyehu mannichin otan bachallonot hassemuchot lirshut harabbim uvain ovre derachim venotlin otan hitkinu sheyehe ochazan beyado venichnas

Amar rabbi meyasha bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha gollan kemin sefer veochazan bimino keneged libbo amar rav yosef bar minome amar rav nachman uvilvad shello tehe retzua yotzet mittachat yado tefach

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan bayyom gollan kemin sefer umannichan beyado keneged libbo uvallayela ose lahen kemin kis tefach umannichan

Amar rava amar rav sheshet let hilcheta ki ha matnita devet shammay hi dei bet hillel hashta bet hakkisse kavua shere bet hakkisse aray mibaya

Ki tanya hahi leinyan tefach vetifchayim detane chada keshehu nifne megalle leacharav tefach ulfanav tifchayim vetanya idach leacharav tefach ulfanav velo chelum
May lav ide veide beish vela kashya kan ligdolim kan liktannim

Tane chada tzorer adam tefilav im meotav baafarkesuto vetanya idach lo yatzor

Ulabbaye deamar hazmana milta hi azmeneh af al gav dela tzar beh tzar beh i azmeneh asir i la azmeneh la

Teuvta dishmuel teuvta

a: Kol lenattorinhu tefe adif vehecha mannach lehu amar rabbi yirmeya ben kar lecheset shello keneged rosho

Bar kappara tzayar lehu bechilta umappik lemurshehon levar rav shisha bereh derav ide mannach lehu ashsharshifa ufares sudara ilavayehu

Bea mineh rav yosef bereh derav nechunya merav yehuda shenayim sheyeshenim bemitta achat mahu shezze yachazir panav veyikra keriat shema veze yachazir panav veyikra keriat shema amar leh hachi amar shemuel vaafilu ishto immo
Matkif lah rav yosef ishto vela mibaya acher adderabba ishto kegufo acher lav kegufo

Ella beishto velikriat shema

La kashya ha birtzua ha biktzitza
Veibaet ema la shena retzua vela shena ketzitza asur vechi tela rabbi bechista tela

b: Ummashmesh bevigdo aval lo haya mitattef uchshehu mefahek haya manniach yado al santero
Metivi hammashmia kolo bitfillato hare ze mikketanne amana hammagbiha kolo bitfillato hare ze minnevie hashsheker
Megahek umfahek hare ze miggasse haruach hammitattesh bitfillato siman ra lo veyesh omrim nikar shehu mechoar harak bitfillato keilu rak bifne hammelech
Bishlama megahek umfahek la kashya kan leonso kan lirtzono ella mitattesh ammitattesh kashya

Mitattesh ammitattesh name la kashya kan millemala kan millematta deamar rav zera ha milta ibbala li be rav hamnuna utkila li ki kulle talmuday hammitattesh bitfillato siman yafe lo keshem sheosim lo nachat ruach millematta kach osim lo nachat ruach millemala

Ella rak arak kashya rak arak name la kashya efshar kidrav yehuda deamar rav yehuda haya omed bitfila venizdammen lo rok mavlio betallito veim tallit nae hu mavlio baafarkesuto ravina hava kae achore rav ashe nizdammen lo rok patkeh laachoreh amar leh la savar lah mar leha derav yehuda mavlio baafarkesuto amar leh ana anina datay

Hammashmia kolo bitfillato hare ze mikketanne amana amar rav huna lo shanu ella sheyyachol lechaven et libbo belachash aval en yachol lechaven et libbo belachash muttar vehane mile beyachid aval betzibur ate lemitrad tzibura

Rabbi abba hava ka mishtemit mineh derav yehuda dahava ka bae lemisak leara deyisrael deamar rav yehuda kol haole mibbavel leeretz yisrael over baase shenneemar bavela yuvau veshamma yihu ad yom pokdi otam neum amar ezil veeshma mineh milta mibbet vaada vahadar eppok

Umi amar rav huna hachi vehaamar rav huna talmid chacham asur lo laamod bimkom hattinnofet lefi shei efshar lo laamod beli hirhur tora la kashya kan beomed kan bimhallech

Hachi kaamar leh ledidi la sevira li ledidach disvira lach im shahita kede ligmor et kullah chazor larosh

a: Aval litfilla ad sheyechasse et libbo

Veamar rav huna shachach venichnas bitfilin levet hakkisse manniach yado alehen ad sheyyigmor ad sheyyigmor salka datach ella kidamar rav nachman bar yitzchak ad sheyyigmor ammud rishon velifsok lealtar velekum mishshum derabban shimon ben gamliel detanya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ammud hachozer mevi et haadam lide hidrokan silon hachozer mevi et haadam lide yerakon

Ittemar tzoa al besaro o yado munnachat bevet hakkisse rav huna amar muttar likrot keriat shema rav chisda amar asur likrot keriat shema amar rava may tama derav huna dichtiv kol hanneshama tehallel yah halluyah
Verav chisda amar asur likrot keriat shema may tama derav chisda dichtiv kol atzmotay tomarna mi chamocha
Ittemar reach ra sheyyesh lo ikar rav huna amar marchik arba ammot vekore keriat shema verav chisda amar marchik arba ammot mimmekom sheppasak hareach vekore keriat shema

Beo mineh merav sheshet reach ra sheen lo ikar mahu amar lehu ato chazo hane tzipe deve rav dehane ganu vehane garsi vehane mile bedivre tora aval bikriat shema la vedivre tora name la amaran ella dechavreh aval dideh la

Verava amar lach hatam bikviuta talya milta dichtiv badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo hacha vehaya machanecha kadosh amar rachamana veha leka
Amar rav pappa pi chazir ketzoa overet dame peshita la tzericha af al gav desalek minnahara

Savar lah ki ha derav hamnuna deamar rav hamnuna lo asra tora ella keneged ammud bilvad
Vechidrabbi yonatan derabbi yonatan rame ketiv veyad tihye lecha michutz lammachane veyatzata shamma chutz uchtiv veyated tihye lecha vego vechissita et tzeatecha
Ha ketzad kan bigdolim kan biktannim alma ketannim lo asra tora ella keneged ammud bilvad ha neful leara shere verabbanan hu digzaru behu vechi gezaru behu rabbanan bevaddaan aval bisfekan la gezur
