Amar rav yosef shera leh mareh ligniva hashta tzoa amar rav yehuda amar rav kevan shekkarmu paneha muttar me raglayim mibaya
Amar leh abbaye may chazet desamchatte aha semoch aha deamar rabba bar rav huna amar rav tzoa afilu kecheres asura
Vehechi dame tzoa kecheres amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan kol zeman shezzorka veenah nifrechet veika deamri kol zeman sheggollah veenah nifrechet
Amar ravina hava kaemna kammeh derav yehuda middifti chaza tzoa amar li ayyen i karmu paneha i la ika deamri hachi amar leh ayyen i mippelay ippeloye
May have alah ittemar tzoa kecheres amemar amar asura umar zutra amar mutteret amar rava hilcheta tzoa kecheres asura ume raglayim kol zeman shemmatpichin

Metivi me raglayim kol zeman shemmatpichin asurin nivleu o yavshu muttarim may lav nivleu dumya deyavshu ma yavshu deen rishshuman nikar af nivleu deen rishshuman nikar ha rishshuman nikar asur af al gav deen matpichin
Ultamach ema resha kol zeman shemmatpichin hu deasur ha rishshuman nikar shere ella meha leka lemishma minah

b: Vehacha betofeach al menat lehatpiach ika benayehu
Yarad litbol im yachol laalot chu lema tanna setama kerabbi eliezer deamar ad hanetz hachamma
Afilu tema rabbi yehoshua vedilma kevatikin deamar rabbi yochanan vatikin hau gomrin otah im hanetz hachamma
Veim lav yitkasse bemayim veyikra vahare libbo roe et haerva
Amar rabbi elazar vei tema rabbi acha bar abba bar acha mishshum rabbenu bemayim achurin shanu dedamu keara semichta shello yire libbo ervato
Tanu rabbanan mayim tzelulin yshev bahen ad tzavaro vekore veyesh omrim ochran beraglo
Vetana kamma vahare libbo roe et haerva kasavar libbo roe et haerva muttar vahare akevo roe et haerva kasavar akevo roe et haerva muttar

Ittemar akevo roe et haerva muttar nogea abbaye amar asur verava amar muttar rav zevid matni lah leha shemata hachi rav chinana bereh derav ika matni lah hachi nogea divre hakkol asur roe abbaye amar asur rava amar muttar lo nittena tora lemalache hashsharet vehilcheta nogea asur roe muttar

Amar rava tzoa baashashit muttar likrot keriat shema kenegdah erva baashashit asur likrot keriat shema kenegdah tzoa baashashit muttar likrot keriat shema kenegdah detzoa bechisuy talya milta veha mikasseya erva baashashit asur likrot keriat shema kenegdah velo yire vecha ervat davar amar rachamana veha kamitchazya
Amar abbaye tzoa kol shehu mevattelah berok amar rava uvrok ave amar rava tzoa begumma manniach sandalo aleha vekore keriat shema bea mar bereh deravina tzoa devuka besandalo may teku

Amar rav yehuda goy arom asur likrot keriat shema kenegdo may irya goy afilu yisrael name yisrael peshita leh deasur ella goy itztericha leh mahu detema hoil uchtiv behu asher besar chamorim besaram ema kachamor bealma hu ka mashma lan deinhu name ikru erva dichtiv veervat avihem lo rau

Velo yitkasse lo bammayim haraim velo beme hammishra ad sheyyatil letochan mayim vechamma mayya rame veazel ella hachi kaamar lo yitkasse lo bemayim haraim velo beme hammishra kelal ume raglayim ad sheyyatil letochan mayim veyikra
Tanu rabbanan kamma yatil letochan mayim kol shehu rabbi zakkay omer reviit
Amar rav nachman machaloket levassof aval battechila kol shehen
Verav yosef amar machaloket lechattechila aval levassof divre hakkol reviit amar leh rav yosef leshammaeh ayeti li revieta demayya kerabbi zakkay

Tanu rabbanan geraf shel rei veavit shel me raglayim asur likrot keriat shema kenegdan veaf al pi sheen bahen kelum ume raglayim atzman ad sheyyatil letochan mayim vechamma yatil letochan mayim kol shehu rabbi zakkay omer reviit ben lifne hammitta ben leachar hammitta rabban shimon ben gamliel omer leachar hammitta kore lifne hammitta eno kore aval marchik hu arba ammot vekore rabbi shimon ben elazar omer afilu bet mea amma lo yikra ad sheyyotziem o sheyyannichem tachat hammitta
Ibaya lehu hechi kaamar achar hammitta kore miyyad lifne hammitta marchik arba ammot vekore o dilma hachi kaamar leachar hammitta marchik arba ammot vekore lifne hammitta eno kore kelal

Ta shema detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer achar hammitta kore miyyad lifne hammitta marchik arba ammot rabban shimon ben gamliel omer afilu bet mea amma lo yikra ad sheyyotziem o sheyyannichem tachat hammitta
Bayan ipshita lan matneyata kashyan ahadade efoch batrayeta

Man shamatte leh deamar kulleh bayit kearba ammot dame rabbi shimon ben elazar hi

Amar rav yosef beay mineh merav huna mitta pachot mishshelosha peshita li dichlavud dame shelosha arbaa chamishsha shishsha shiva shemona tisha mahu amar leh la yadana asara vadday la mibe li amar abbaye shappir avadte dela ibaya lecha kol asara reshuta achariti hi

Rav achay iassak leh livreh be rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta ayeleh lechuppa vela hava mistayea milta azal batreh leayyone chaza sefer tora demannecha amar lehu echu hashta la atay sakkentun livri detanya bayit sheyyesh bo sefer tora o tefilin asur leshammesh bo et hammitta ad sheyyotziem o sheyyannichem keli betoch keli

Kamma yarchik mehen umin hatztzoa arba ammot amar rava amar rav sechora amar rav huna lo shanu ella laachorav aval lefanav marchik melo enav vechen litfilla
Ini veha amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda omed adam keneged bet hakkisse umitpallel hacha bemay askinan bevet hakkisse sheen bo tzoa

Matni zav sheraa keri venidda sheppalta shichvat zera vehamshammeshet sheraata nidda tzerichin tevila verabbi yehuda poter

Matni tefillat hashshachar ad chatzot rabbi yehuda omer ad arba shaot tefillat hammincha ad haerev rabbi yehuda omer ad pelag hammincha
Tefillat haerev en lah keva veshel musafim kol hayyom rabbi yehuda omer ad sheva shaot

Ki tanya hahi levatikin deamar rabbi yochanan vatikin hau gomrim otah im hanetz hachamma

Kulle yoma metzalle veazel ad chatzot yahavi leh sechar tefilla bizmannah mikkan veelach sechar tefilla yahavi leh sechar tefilla bizmannah la yahavi leh

Yitzchak tikken tefillat mincha shenneemar vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade lifnot arev veen sicha ella tefilla shenneemar tefilla leani chi yaatof velifne yishpoch sicho
Yaakov tikken tefillat arvit shenneemar vayyifga bammakom vayyalen sham veen pegia ella tefilla shenneemar veatta al titpallel bead haam hazze veal tissa vaadam rinna utfilla veal tifga bi

Vetanya keoteh derabbi yehoshua ben levi mippene ma amru tefillat hashshachar ad chatzot shehare tamid shel shachar karev veholech ad chatzot verabbi yehuda omer ad arba shaot shehare tamid shel shachar karev veholech ad arba shaot

Umippene ma amru tefillat hammincha ad haerev shehare tamid shel ben haarbayim karev veholech ad haerev rabbi yehuda omer ad pelag hammincha shehare tamid shel ben haarbayim karev veholech ad pelag hammincha
Umippene ma amru tefillat haerev en lah keva shehare evarim ufdarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev kerevim veholchim kol hallayela
Umippene ma amru shel musafin kol hayyom shehare korban shel musafin karev kol hayyom rabbi yehuda omer ad sheva shaot shehare korban musaf karev veholech ad sheva shaot
Veezo hi mincha gedola mishshesh shaot umechetza ulmala veezo hi mincha ketanna mittesha shaot umechetza ulmala
Ibaya lehu rabbi yehuda pelag mincha kamma kaamar o pelag mincha acharona kaamar ta shema detanya rabbi yehuda omer pelag hammincha acharona amru vehi achat esre shaot chaser revia

Nema tehve teuvteh derabbi yose berabbi chanina amar lecha rabbi yose berabbi chanina leolam ema lach tefillot avot tikkenum veasmechinhu rabbanan akkorbanot dei la tema hachi tefillat musaf lerabbi yose berabbi chanina man takkenah ella tefillot avot tikkenum veasmechinhu rabbanan akkorbanot

Rabbi yehuda omer ad arba shaot ibaya lehu ad vead bakkelal o dilma ad velo ad bakkelal ta shema rabbi yehuda omer ad pelag hammincha i amratte bishlama ad velo ad bakkelal hayenu deika ben rabbi yehuda lerabbanan ella i amratte ad vead bakkelal rabbi yehuda

a: Hayenu rabbanan

Ella may ad velo ad bakkelal ema sefa veshel musafin kol hayyom rabbi yehuda omer ad sheva shaot vetanya hau lefanav shette tefillot achat shel musaf veachat shel mincha mitpallel shel mincha veachar kach shel musaf shezzo tedira vezo enah tedira rabbi yehuda omer mitpallel shel musaf veachar kach shel mincha shezzo overet vezo enah overet

I amratte bishlama ad vead bakkelal hayenu demashkachatte lehu shette tefillot bahade hadade ella i amratte ad velo ad bakkelal hechi mashkachatte lehu shette tefillot bahade hadade kevan deatya lah shel mincha azla lah shel musafin

Ella may ad vead bakkelal kashya resha may ika ben rabbi yehuda lerabbanan mi savratte dehay pelag mincha pelag acharona kaamar pelag rishona kaamar vehachi kaamar emat nafek pelag rishona veayel pelag acharona mikki nafki achat esre shaot chaser revia
Amar rav nachman af anan name tenena

Rabbi yehuda ben bava heid chamishsha devarim shemmaanin et hakketanna veshemmassiin et haishsha al pi ed echad veal tarnegol shenniskal birushalayim al sheharag et hannefesh veal yayin ben arbaim yom shennitnassech al gabbe hammizbeach veal tamid shel shachar shekkarev bearba shaot
Shema minah ad vead bakkelal shema minah
Amar rav kahana halacha kerabbi yehuda hoil utnan bivchirata keoteh
Veal tamid shel shachar shekkarev bearba shaot man tena leha ditnan vecham hashshemesh venamas bearba shaot

Atta omer bearba shaot o eno ella beshesh shaot keshehu omer kechom hayyom hare shesh shaot amur ha ma ani mekayyem vecham hashshemesh venamas bearba shaot manni la rabbi yehuda vela rabbanan i rabbi yehuda ad arba shaot name tzafra hu i rabbanan ad chatzot name tzafra hu

I baet ema rabbi yehuda i baet ema rabbanan i baet ema rabbanan amar kera babboker babboker challekehu lishne bekarim vei baet ema rabbi yehuda hay boker yattira lehakdim lo shaa achat dechulla alma miha vecham hashshemesh venamas bearba shaot
May mashma amar rabbi acha bar yaakov amar kera vecham hashshemesh venamas ezo hi shaa shehashshemesh cham vehatztzel tzonen heve omer bearba shaot

Tefillat hammincha ad haerev vechu amar leh rav chisda lerav yitzchak hatam amar rav kahana halacha kerabbi yehuda hoil utnan bivchirata keoteh hacha may ishtik vela amar leh vela mide amar rav chisda nechze anan midderav metzalle shel shabbat beerev shabbat mibbeod yom shema minah halacha kerabbi yehuda
Adderabba midderav huna verabbanan la hao metzallu ad urta shema minah en halacha kerabbi yehuda hashta dela ittemar hilcheta la kemar vela kemar daavad kemar avad vedaavad kemar avad

Rav ikla leve geniva vetzalli shel shabbat beerev shabbat vahava metzalle rabbi yirmeya bar abba laachore derav vesayyem rav vela paskeh litzloteh derabbi yirmeya shema minah telat shema minah mitpallel adam shel shabbat beerev shabbat ushma minah mitpallel talmid achore rabbo ushma minah asur laavor keneged hammitpallelin
Mesayya leh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi asur laavor keneged hammitpallelin ini veha rabbi amme verabbi assi chalfi rabbi amme verabbi assi chutz learba ammot hu dechalfi
Verabbi yirmeya hechi aved hachi veha amar rav yehuda amar rav leolam al yitpallel adam

Vetauta mi hadra veha amar avidan paam achat nitkashsheru shamayim beavim kisvurim haam lomar chashecha hu nichnesu levet hakkeneset vehitpallelu shel motzae shabbat beshabbat venitpazzeru heavim vezarcha hachamma
Uvau veshaalu et rabbi veamar hoil vehitpallelu hitpallelu shane tzibbur dela matrechinan lehu

Amar rabbi chiyya bar avin rav tzalli shel shabbat beerev shabbat rabbi yoshiyya metzalle shel motzae shabbat beshabbat rav tzalli shel shabbat beerev shabbat omer kedushsha al hakkos o eno omer kedushsha al hakkos ta shema deamar rav nachman amar shemuel mitpallel adam shel shabbat beerev shabbat veomer kedushsha al hakkos vehilcheta keoteh

Rabbi yoshiyya metzalle shel motzae shabbat beshabbat omer havdala al hakkos o eno omer havdala al hakkos ta shema deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel mitpallel adam shel motzae shabbat beshabbat veomer havdala al hakkos
Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi assi amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina amar rav betzad ammud ze hitpallel rabbi yishmael berabbi yose shel shabbat beerev shabbat

Ki ata ulla amar betzad temara hava velo betzad ammud hava velo rabbi yishmael berabbi yose hava ella rabbi elazar berabbi yose hava velo shel shabbat beerev shabbat hava ella shel motzae shabbat beshabbat hava
Tefillat haerev en lah keva may en lah keva ilema dei bae metzalle kulleh lelya litne tefillat haerev kol hallayela ella may en lah keva

Keman deamar tefillat arvit reshut deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel tefillat arvit rabban gamliel omer chova rabbi yehoshua omer reshut amar abbaye halacha kedivre haomer chova verava amar halacha kedivre haomer reshut
Tanu rabbanan maase betalmid echad shebba lifne rabbi yehoshua amar lo tefillat arvit reshut o chova amar leh reshut
Ba lifne rabban gamliel amar lo tefillat arvit reshut o chova amar lo chova amar lo vahalo rabbi yehoshua amar li reshut amar lo hamten ad sheyyikkansu baale terisin levet hammidrash

Keshennichnesu baale terisin amad hashshoel veshaal tefillat arvit reshut o chova amar lo rabban gamliel chova amar lahem rabban gamliel lachachamim kelum yesh adam shecholek bedavar ze amar leh rabbi yehoshua lav amar lo vahalo mishshimcha amru li reshut

Amar leh yehoshua amod al raglecha veyaidu becha amad rabbi yehoshua al raglav veamar ilmale ani chay vehu met yachol hachay lehachchish et hammet veachshav sheani chay vehu chay heach yachol hachay lehachchish et hachay
Haya rabban gamliel yoshev vedoresh verabbi yehoshua omed al raglav ad sherinnenu kol haam veamru lechutzpit hatturgeman amod veamad
Amri ad kamma netzaareh venezil berosh hashshana eshtakad tzaareh bivchorot bemaase derabbi tzadok tzaareh hacha name tzaareh ta venabereh
Man nokem leh nokmeh lerabbi yehoshua baal maase hu nokmeh lerabbi akiva dilma anesh leh delet leh zechut avot

Ella nokmeh lerabbi elazar ben azarya dehu chacham vehu ashir vehu asiri leezra hu chacham dei makshe leh mefarek leh vehu ashir dei it leh lefalloche leve kesar af hu azel ufalach vehu asiri leezra deit leh zechut avot vela matze anesh leh ato vaamaru leh nicha leh lemar delehve resh metivta amar lehu ezil veimlich beinashe beti azal veimmelich bidvethu amara leh

a: Dilma meabberin lach amar lah lishtammash inash yoma chada bechasa demokra velimchar litvar amara leh let lacha chivarata hahu yoma bar tamne sere shene hava itrechish leh nisa veihaddaru leh tamne sere dare chivarata hayenu dekaamar rabbi elazar ben azarya hare ani keven shivim shana velo ben shivim shana
Tana oto hayyom sillekuhu leshomer happetach venittena lahem reshut lattalmidim likanes shehaya rabban gamliel machriz veomer kol talmid sheen tocho kevaro lo yikkanes levet hammidrash

Hahu yoma ittosfu kamma safsalle amar rabbi yochanan peligi bah abba yosef ben dostay verabbanan chad amar ittosfu arba mea safsalle vechad amar sheva mea safsalle hava ka chalsha dateh derabban gamliel amar dilma chas veshalom manati tora miyyisrael achzo leh bechelmeh chatzve chivare demalyin kitma vela hi hahi leyattove dateh hu deachzo leh

Tana eduot bo bayyom nishnet vechol hecha deamrinan bo bayyom hahu yoma hava velo hayeta halacha shehayeta teluya bevet hammidrash shello pershuha veaf rabban gamliel lo mana atzmo mibbet hammidrash afilu shaa achat
Ditnan bo bayyom ba yehuda ger ammoni lifnehem bevet hammidrash amar lahem ma ani lavo bakkahal

Amar lo rabban gamliel asur atta lavo bakkahal amar lo rabbi yehoshua muttar atta lavo bakkahal amar lo rabban gamliel vahalo kevar neemar lo yavo ammoni umoavi bikhal amar lo rabbi yehoshua vechi ammon umoav bimkoman hen yoshvin kevar ala sancheriv melech ashshur uvilbel et kol haummot shenneemar veasir gevulot ammim vaatudotehem shoseti veorid kabbir yoshvim vechol defaresh merubba paresh
Amar lo rabban gamliel vahalo kevar neemar veachare chen ashiv et shevut bene ammon neum uchvar shavu
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua vahalo kevar neemar veshavti et shevut ammi yisrael vaadayin lo shavu miyyad hittiruhu lavo bakkahal

Amar rabban gamliel hoil vehachi hava ezil vaafayeseh lerabbi yehoshua ki meta leveteh chazinhu leashyata deveteh demashcharan amar leh mikkotle vetcha atta nikar sheppechami atta amar lo oy lo laddor sheatta parnaso shei atta yodea betzaaran shel talmide chachamim bamme hem mitparnesim uvamme hem nizzonim
Amar lo naaneti lecha mechol li la ashgach beh ase bishvil kevod abba payyes

Amaru man nezil velema lehu lerabbanan amar lehu hahu koves ana azelna shelach lehu rabbi yehoshua leve midresha man delavesh madda yilbash madda uman dela lavesh madda yemar leh leman delavesh madda shelach maddach vaana elbesheh amar lehu rabbi akiva lerabbanan teruku galle dela letu avde derabban gamliel ultzaaru lerabbanan

Amar rabbi yehoshua mutav deekum veezil ana legabbayehu ata teraf abbava amar lehu mazze ben mazze yazze vesheeno lo mazze velo ben mazze yomar lemazze ben mazze memecha me meara veefrecha efer mikle amar lo rabbi akiva rabbi yehoshua nitpayyasta kelum asinu ella bishvil kevodcha lemachar ani veatta nashkim lefitcho

Amri hechi naaved nabereh gemiri maalin bakkodesh veen moridin nidrosh mar chada shabbeta umar chada shabbeta ate lekannooye ella lidrosh rabban gamliel telata shabbate verabbi elazar ben azarya chada shabbeta vehayenu deamar mar shabbat shel mi hayeta shel rabbi elazar ben azarya hayeta veoto talmid rabbi shimon ben yochay hava
Veshel musafin kol hayyom amar rabbi yochanan venikra poshea

Tanu rabbanan hau lefanav shette tefillot achat shel mincha veachat shel musaf mitpallel shel mincha veachar kach mitpallel shel musaf shezzo tedira vezo enah tedira rabbi yehuda omer mitpallel shel musaf veachar kach mitpallel shel mincha shezzo mitzva overet vezo mitzva sheenah overet amar rabbi yochanan halacha mitpallel shel mincha veachar kach mitpallel shel musaf

Rabbi zera ki hava chalish miggirseh hava azel veyatev appitcha deve rabbi natan bar tovi amar ki chalfi rabbanan az ekum mikkammayehu vaakabbel agra nefak ata rabbi natan bar tovi amar leh man amar halacha be midresha amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan en halacha kerabbi yehuda deamar mitpallel adam shel musaf veachar kach mitpallel shel mincha
Amar leh rabbi yochanan amrah amar leh in tena mineh arbein zimnin amar leh chada hi lach o chadat hi lach amar leh chadat hi li mishshum dimsappeka li berabbi yehoshua ben levi

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kol hammitpallel tefilla shel musafin leachar sheva shaot lerabbi yehuda alav hakkatuv omer nuge mimmoed asafti mimmech hau may mashma dehay nuge lishana ditvara hu kedimtargem rav yosef tevara ate al sanehon devet yisrael al deacharu zimne moadayya devirushlem

Amar rabbi elazar kol hammitpallel tefilla shel shacharit leachar arba shaot lerabbi yehuda alav hakkatuv omer nuge mimmoed asafti mimmech hau may mashma dehay nuge lishana detzaara hu dichtiv dalfa nafshi mittuga rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha betuloteha nugot vehi mar lah
b: Rav aveya chalash vela ata lefirka derav yosef limchar ki ata bea abbaye leannoche dateh derav yosef amar leh may tama la ata mar lefirka amar leh dahava chalish libbay vela matzena amar leh ammay la teamte mide vaatet amar leh la savar lah mar leha derav huna deamar rav huna asur lo leadam sheyyitom kelum kodem sheyyitpallel tefillat hammusafin amar leh ibi leh lemar letzalloye tzelota demusafin beyachid velitom mide ulmete amar leh vela savar lah mar leha deamar rabbi yochanan asur lo laadam sheyyakdim tefillato litfillat hatztzibbur amar leh lav ittemar alah amar rabbi abba betzibbur shanu

Velet hilcheta la kerav huna vela kerabbi yehoshua ben levi kerav huna ha daamaran kerabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi kevan shehiggia zeman tefillat mincha asur lo leadam sheyyitom kelum kodem sheyyitpallel tefillat hammincha

Matni rabbi nechunya ben hakkana haya mitpallel bichnisato levet hammidrash uvitziato tefilla ketzara amru lo ma makom litfilla zo amar lahem bichnisati ani mitpallel shello yeera devar takkala al yadi uvitziati ani noten hodaa al chelki

Gema tanu rabbanan bichnisato mahu omer yehi ratzon millefanecha elohay shello yeera devar takkala al yadi velo ekkashel bidvar halacha veyismechu bi chaveray velo omar al tame tahor velo al tahor tame velo yikkashlu chaveray bidvar halacha veesmach bahem

Bitziato mahu omer mode ani lefanecha elohay shessamta chelki miyyoshve bet hammidrash velo samta chelki miyyoshve keranot sheani mashkim vehem mashkimim ani mashkim ledivre tora vehem mashkimim lidvarim betelim ani amel vehem amelim ani amel umkabbel sachar vehem amelim veenam mekabbelim sachar ani ratz vehem ratzim ani ratz lechayye haolam habba vehem ratzim liver shachat
Tanu rabbanan keshechala rabbi eliezer nichnesu talmidav levakkero amru lo rabbenu lammedenu orchot chayyim venizke bahen lechayye haolam habba
Amar lahem hizzaharu bichvod chavrechem uminu benechem min hahiggaon vehoshivum ben birke talmide chachamim uchsheattem mitpallelim deu lifne mi attem omdim uvishvil kach tizku lechayye haolam habba
Uchshechala rabbi yochanan ben zakkay nichnesu talmidav levakkero kevan sheraa otam hitchil livkot amru lo talmidav ner yisrael ammud hayemani pattish hechazak mippene ma atta boche

Amar lahem ilu lifne melech basar vadam hau molichin oti shehayyom kan umachar bakkever sheim koes alay en kaaso kaas olam veim osreni en isuro isur olam veim memiteni en mitato mitat olam vaani yachol lefayeso bidvarim ulshachado bemamon af al pi chen hayiti boche veachshav shemmolichim oti lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu shehu chay vekayyam leolam ulolme olamim sheim koes alay kaaso kaas olam veim osreni isuro isur olam veim memiteni mitato mitat olam veeni yachol lefayeso bidvarim velo leshachado bemamon velo od ella sheyyesh lefanay shene derachim achat shel gan eden veachat shel gehinnam veeni yodea beezo molichim oti velo evke
Amru lo rabbenu barchenu amar lahem yehi ratzon shettehe mora shamayim alechem kemora basar vadam amru lo talmidav ad kan amar lahem ulvay tedu kesheadam over avera omer shello yirani adam
Bishat petirato amar lahem pannu kelim mippene hattuma vehachinu kisse lechizkiyyahu melech yehuda shebba

Matni rabban gamliel omer bechal yom veom mitpallel adam shemone esre rabbi yehoshua omer meen shemone esre rabbi akiva omer im shegura tefillato befiv mitpallel shemone esre veim lav meen shemone esre
Rabbi eliezer omer haose tefillato keva en tefillato tachanunim
Rabbi yehoshua omer haholech bimkom sakkana mitpallel tefilla ketzara veomer hosha et ammecha et sheerit yisrael bechal parashat haibbur yihu tzorchehem lefanecha baruch atta shomea tefilla

Haya rochev al hachamor yered veyitpallel veim eno yachol lered yachazir et panav veim eno yachol lehachazir et panav yechaven et libbo keneged bet kodshe hakkodashim haya mehallech bisfina o beasda yechaven et libbo keneged bet kodshe hakkodashim
Gema hane shemone esre keneged mi

Amar rabbi hillel bereh derabbi shemuel bar nachmani keneged shemone esre azkarot sheamar david behavu la bene elim rav yosef amar keneged shemone esre azkarot shebbikriat shema amar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi keneged shemone esre chulot shebbashshidra
Veamar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi hammitpallel tzarich sheyyichra ad sheyyitpakkeku kol chulot shebbashshidra
Ulla amar ad kede sheyyire isar keneged libbo rabbi chanina amar kevan shennina rosho shuv eno tzarich amar rava vehu dimtzaar nafsheh umichze keman dechara
Hane tamne sere teshasre haveyan
Amar rabbi levi birkat hamminim beyavne tikkenuha keneged mi tikkenuha

Amar rabbi levi lerabbi hillel bereh derabbi shemuel bar nachmani keneged el hakkavod hirim lerav yosef keneged echad shebbikriat shema lerabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi keneged chulya ketanna shebbashshidra

Tanu rabbanan shimon happakoli hisdir shemone esre berachot lifne rabban gamliel al hasseder beyavne amar lahem rabban gamliel lachachamim kelum yesh adam sheyyodea letakken birkat hamminim amad shemuel hakkatan vetikkenah

a: Vehishkif bah shettayim veshalosh shaot velo heeluhu
Ammay lo heeluhu vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav taa bechal habberachot kullan en maalin oto bevirkat hamminim maalin oto chayeshinan shemma min hu
Shane shemuel hakkatan deihu takkenah
Venechush dilma hadar beh amar abbaye gemiri tava la have bisha
Vela vehachtiv uvshuv tzaddik mitztzidkato veasa avel hahu rasha meikaro aval tzaddik meikaro la
Vela veha tenan al taamin beatzmecha ad yom motcha shehare yochanan kohen gadol shimmesh bichhunna gedola shemonim shana ulvassof naasa tzadoki
Amar abbaye hu yannay hu yochanan rava amar yannay lechud veochanan lechud yannay rasha meikaro veochanan tzaddik meikaro hannicha leabbaye ella lerava kashya
Amar lach rava tzaddik meikaro name dilma hadar beh i hachi ammay la assekuhu
Shane shemuel hakkatan deatchel bah deamar rav yehuda amar rav veitema rabbi yehoshua ben levi lo shanu ella shello hitchil bah aval hitchil bah gomrah
Hane sheva deshabbeta keneged mi amar rabbi chalafta ben shaul keneged shiva kolot sheamar david al hammayim
Hane tesha derosh hashshana keneged mi amar rabbi yitzchak demin kartignin keneged tisha azkarot sheamra channa bitfillatah deamar mar berosh hashshana nifkeda sara rachel vechanna

Hane esrim vearba detaanita keneged mi amar rabbi chelbo keneged esrim vearba renanot sheamar shelomo beshaa shehichnis aron levet kodshe hakkodashim i hachi kol yoma name nemrinhu emat amrinhu shelomo beoma derachame anan name beoma derachame amrinan lehu

Rabbi yehoshua omer meen shemone esre may meen shemone esre rav amar meen kol beracha uvracha ushmuel amar havinenu elohenu ladaat derachecha umol et levavenu leyiratecha vetislach lanu lihot geulim verachakenu mimmachovenu vedashshenenu binot artzecha unfutzotenu mearba tekabbetz vehattoim al datecha yishpetu veal harshaim tanif yadecha veyismechu tzaddikim bevinyan irecha uvtikkun hechalecha uvitzmichat keren ledavid avdecha uvaarichat ner leven yishay meshichecha terem nikra atta taane baruch atta shomea tefilla
Layet alah abbaye amman dimtzalle havinenu
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel kol hashshana kullah mitpallel adam havinenu chutz mimmotzae shabbat umimmotzae yamim tovim mippene shetztzarich lomar havdala bechonen haddaat
Matkif lah rabba bar shemuel venemrah beracha reviit bifne atzmah mi la tenan rabbi akiva omer omrah beracha reviit bifne atzmah rabbi eliezer omer bahodaa

Attu kol hashshana kullah mi avdinan kerabbi akiva dehashta name naaved kol hashshana kullah may tama la avdinan kerabbi akiva tamne sere takkun teshasre la takkun hacha name sheva takkun tamne la takkun
Matkif lah mar zutra venichlela michlal havinenu elohenu hammavdil ben kodesh lechol kashya

Amar rav bivi bar abbaye kol hashshana kullah mitpallel adam havinenu chutz mimot haggeshamim mippene shetztzarich lomar sheela bevirkat hashshanim matkif lah mar zutra venichlela michlal vedashshenenu binot artzecha veten tal umatar
Ate leitterode i hachi havdala bechonen haddaat name ate leitterode
Amri hatam kevan deatya bitchillat tzelota la mitterid hacha kevan deatya beemtza tzelota mitterid

Matkif lah rav ashe venemrah beshomea tefilla deamar rabbi tanchum amar rav assi taa velo hizkir gevurot geshamim bitchiyyat hammetim machazirin oto sheela bevirkat hashshanim en machazirin oto mippene sheyyachol leomrah beshomea tefilla vehavdala bechonen haddaat en machazirin oto mippene sheyyachol leomrah al hakkos taa shane

Gufa amar rabbi tanchum amar rav assi taa velo hizkir gevurot geshamim bitchiyyat hammetim machazirin oto sheela bevirkat hashshanim en machazirin oto mippene sheyyachol leomrah beshomea tefilla vehavdala bechonen haddaat en machazirin oto mippene sheyyachol leomrah al hakkos
Metivi taa velo hizkir gevurot geshamim bitchiyyat hammetim machazirin oto sheela bevirkat hashshanim machazirin oto vehavdala bechonen haddaat en machazirin oto mippene sheyyachol leomrah al hakkos
La kashya ha beyachid ha betzibbur
Betzibbur may tama la mishshum deshamah mishsheliach tzibbur i hachi hay mippene sheyyachol leomrah beshomea tefila mippene sheshshomea mishsheliach tzibur mibe leh
Ella ide veide beyachid vela kashya ha deiddechar kodem shomea tefilla
b: Ha deiddechar batar shomea tefilla

Amar rabbi tanchum amar rav assi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi taa velo hizkir shel rosh chodesh baavoda chozer laavoda nizkar bahodaa chozer laavoda besim shalom chozer laavoda veim siyem chozer larosh
Amar rav pappa bereh derav acha bar adda ha daamaran siyem chozer larosh la amaran ella sheakar raglav aval lo akar raglav chozer laavoda
Amar leh mena lach ha amar leh meabba mari shemia li veabba mari merav
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ha daamaran akar raglav chozer larosh la amaran ella sheeno ragil lomar tachanunim achar tefillato aval ragil lomar tachanunim achar tefillato chozer laavoda

Ika deamri amar rav nachman bar yitzchak ha daamaran ki lo akar raglav chozer laavoda la amaran ella sheragil lomar tachanunim achar tefillato aval im eno ragil lomar tachanunim achar tefillato chozer larosh

Vehilcheta havinenu meummad tefilla ketzara ben meummad ben mehallech

Amar rava veitema rabbi yehoshua ben levi halacha kerabbi
Tanu rabbanan some umi sheeno yachol lechaven et haruchot yechaven libbo keneged aviv shebbashshamayim shenneemar vehitpallu el

Haya omed bechutz laaretz yechaven et libbo keneged eretz yisrael shenneemar vehitpallu elecha derech artzam haya omed beeretz yisrael yechaven et libbo keneged yerushalayim shenneemar vehitpallu el derech hair asher bacharta haya omed birushalayim yechaven et libbo keneged bet hammikdash shenneemar vehitpallu el habbayit hazze haya omed bevet hammikdash yechaven et libbo keneged bet kodshe hakkodashim shenneemar vehitpallu el hammakom hazze haya omed bevet kodshe hakkodashim yechaven et libbo keneged bet hakkapporet haya omed achore bet hakkapporet yire atzmo keilu lifne hakkapporet nimtza omed bammizrach machazir panav lammaarav bammaarav machazir panav lammizrach baddarom machazir panav latztzafon batztzafon machazir panav laddarom nimtzeu kol yisrael mechavvenin et libbam lemakom echad
Amar rabbi avin veitema rabbi avina may keraa kemigdal david tzavarech banuy letalpiyyot tel shekkal piyyot ponim bo
Avuh dishmuel velevi ki hao bau lemipak leorcha hao mekaddemi umtzalli vechi hava mate zeman keriat shema karu

Keman ki hay tanna detanya hishkim latzet ladderech meviin lo shofar vetokea lulav umnanea megila vekore bah uchsheyyaggia zeman keriat shema kore hishkim leshev bakkaron o bisfina mitpallel uchsheyyaggia zeman keriat shema kore
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer ben kach uven kach kore keriat shema umitpallel kede sheyyismoch geulla litfilla
Bemay kamipalgi mar savar tefilla meummad adif umar savar mismach geulla litfilla adif
Marimar umar zutra hao mechannefi be asra beshabbeta derigla umtzallu vahadar nafki lefirka

Rav ashe metzalle bahade tzibbura beyachid meushshav ki hava ate leveteh hadar umtzalle meummad amri leh rabbanan velaaved mar kemarimar umar zutra amar lehu tericha li milleta velaaved mar kaavuh dishmuel velevi amar lehu la chazena lehu lerabbanan kashshishe minan deavdi hachi

Matni rabbi elazar ben azarya omer en tefillat hammusafin ella bechever ir vachachamim omrim bechever ir veshello bechever ir rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo kol makom sheyyesh sham chever ir yachid patur mittefillat hammusafin
Gema rabbi yehuda hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu yachid shello bechever ir tanna kamma savar patur verabbi yehuda savar chayyav

Amar rav huna bar chinana amar rav chiyya bar rav halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya amar leh rav chiyya bar avin shappir kaamratte deamar shemuel mimay la metzallena tzelota demusafin beyachid
b: Binhardea levar mehahu yoma daata pulmusa demalka lemata veitteridu rabbanan vela tzallo vetzalli li beyachid vahavay yachid shello bechever ir

Yatev rabbi chanina kara kammeh derabbi yannay veyatev vekaamar halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya amar leh puk kere keraach levara deen halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya

Amar rabbi yochanan ani raiti et rabbi yannay detzalli vahadar tzalli amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera vedilma meikara la kaven dateh ulvassof kaven dateh amar leh chazi man gavra rabba dekamashed aleh
Rabbi amme verabbi assi af al gav dahao lehu telesar be chenishta bitverya la hao metzallu ella bene ammude hecha dahao garsi

Itmar rav yitzchak bar avdimi mishshum rabbenu amar halacha kerabbi yehuda sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya rabbi chiyya bar abba tzalli vahadar tzalli amar leh rabbi zera may tama aved mar hachi ilema mishshum dela kaven mar dateh vehaamar rabbi eliezer leolam yamod adam et atzmo im yachol lechaven et libbo yitpallel veim lav al yitpallel ella dela adkar mar deresh yarcha

Vehatanya taa velo hizkir shel rosh chodesh bearvit en machazirin oto mippene sheyyachol leomrah beshacharit beshacharit en machazirin oto mippene sheyyachol leomrah bemusafin bemusafin en machazirin oto mippene sheyyachol leomrah bemincha
Amar leh lav itmar alah amar rabbi yochanan betzibbur shanu
Kamma yishhe ben tefilla litfilla rav huna verav chisda chad amar kede shettitchonen dato alav vechad amar kede shettitcholel dato alav
Man deamar kede shettitchonen dato alav dichtiv vaetchannan el uman deamar kede shettitcholel dato alav dichtiv vayechal moshe
Amar rav anan amar rav taa velo hizkir shel rosh chodesh arvit en machazirin oto lefi sheen bet din mekaddeshin et hachodesh ella bayyom
Amar ammemar mistabbera milta derav bechodesh male aval bechodesh chaser machazirin oto
Amar leh rav ashe leammemar mikkede rav tama kaamar ma li chaser uma li male ella la shena

Matni en omdin lehitpallel ella mittoch koved rosh chasidim harishonim hau shohin shaa achat umitpallelin kede sheyechavvenu libbam laavihem shebbashshamayim afilu hammelech shoel bishlomo lo yeshivennu vaafilu nachash karuch al akevo lo yafsik
Gema mena hane mile amar rabbi elazar deamar kera vehi marat nafesh
Mimmay dilma channa shane dahavat merira libba tuva
Ella amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina mehacha vaani berov chasdecha avo vetecha eshtachave el hechal kodshecha beyiratecha
Mimmay dilma david shane dahava metzaar nafsheh berachame tuva ella amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mehacha hishtachau la behadrat kodesh al tikre behadrat ella becherdat
Mimmay dilma leolam ema lecha hadrat mammash ki ha derav yehuda hava metzayyen nafsheh vahadar metzalle ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak mehacha ivdu et beyira vegilu birada
May vegilu birada amar rav adda bar matna amar rabba bimkom gila sham tehe reada
Abbaye hava yatev kammeh derabba chazyeh dahava ka vadach tuva amar vegilu birada ketiv
Amar leh ana tefilin mannachna
Rabbi yirmeya hava yatev kammeh derabbi zera chazyeh dahava ka vadach tuva amar leh bechol etzev yihye motar ketiv
Amar leh ana tefilin mannachna
Mar bereh deravina avad hilula livreh chazanhu lerabbanan dahao kavadchi tuva

a: Ayeti kasa demokra bat arba mea zuzi vetabbar kammayehu veiatzivu
Rav ashe avad hilula livreh chazanhu lerabbanan dahao ka vadchi tuva ayeti kasa dezuggita chivarta vetabbar kammayehu veiatzivu

Amaru leh rabbanan lerav hamnuna zute behillula demar bereh deravina lishre lan mar amar lehu vay lan demitnan vay lan demitnan amri leh anan ma naane batrach amar lehu he tora vehe mitzva demaggenu alan

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay asur leadam sheyemalle sechok piv baolam hazze shenneemar az yimmale sechok pinu ulshonenu rinna ematay bizman sheyyomru vaggoyim higdil laasot im elle amru alav al resh lakish shemmiyyamav lo mille sechok piv baolam hazze mikki shamah merabbi yochanan rabbeh
Tanu rabbanan en omdin lehitpallel lo mittoch din velo mittoch devar halacha ella mittoch halacha pesuka
Vehechi dame halacha pesuka
Amar abbaye ki ha derabbi zera deamar rabbi zera benot yisrael hechemiru al atzman sheafilu root tipat dam kechardal yoshvot aleha shiva nekiyyim
Rava amar ki ha derav hoshaya deamar rav hoshaya maarim adam al tevuato umachnisah bammotz shellah kede shettehe behemto ochelet uftura min hammaaser
Veibaet ema ki ha derav huna deamar rav huna amar rabbi zeera hammakkiz dam bevehemat kodashim asur bahanaa umoalin bo
Rabbanan avdi kematnitin rav ashe aved kevarayeta
Tanu rabbanan en omdin lehitpallel lo mittoch atzvut velo mittoch atzlut velo mittoch sechok velo mittoch sicha velo mittoch kallut rosh velo mittoch devarim betelim ella mittoch simcha shel mitzva

Vechen lo yippater adam mechavero lo mittoch sicha velo mittoch sechok velo mittoch kallut rosh velo mittoch devarim betelim ella mittoch devar halacha shekken matzinu banneviim harishonim shessiyemu divrehem bedivre shevach vetanchumim
Vechen tena mari bar bereh derav huna bereh derabbi yirmeya bar abba al yippater adam mechavero ella mittoch devar halacha shemmittoch kach zochrehu
Ki ha derav kahana alveyeh lerav shimi bar ashe mippum nahara ad be tzinyata devavel ki meta lehatam amar leh mar vadday deamri inashe hane tzinyata devavel itanhu meadam harishon vead hashta

Amar leh adkartan milta derabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina may dichtiv beeretz asher lo avar bah ish velo yashav adam sham vechi meachar delo avar heach yashav ella lomar lach kol eretz sheggazar aleha adam harishon leyishshuv nityashsheva vechol eretz shello gazar aleha adam harishon leyishshuv lo nityashsheva
Rav mardechay alveyeh lerav shimi bar ashe mehagronya vead be chefe veamri lah ad be dura
Tanu rabbanan hammitpallel tzarich sheyechaven et libbo lashshamayim abba shaul omer siman laddavar tachin libbam takshiv oznecha

Tanya amar rabbi yehuda kach haya minhago shel rabbi akiva keshehaya mitpallel im hatztzibur haya mekatztzer veole mippene torach tzibbur uchshehaya mitpallel beno leven atzmo adam mannicho bezavit zo umotzo bezavit acheret vechol kach lamma mippene keriot vehishtachavaot
Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba leolam yitpallel adam bevayit sheyyesh bo challonot shenneemar vechavin petichan leh vego
Yachol yitpallel adam kol hayyom kullo kevar meforash al yede daniel vezimnin telata vego
Yachol mishshebba laggola huchalla kevar neemar di hava aved min kadmat dena
Yachol yitpallel adam lechol ruach sheyyirtze talmud lomar lakovel neged yerushlem
Yachol yehe kollan bevat achat kevar meforash al yede david dichtiv erev vavoker vetzahorayim vego
Yachol yashmia kolo bitfillato kevar meforash al yede channa shenneemar vekolah lo yishshamea

Yachol yishal adam tzerachav veachar kach yitpallel kevar meforash al yede shelomo shenneemar lishmoa el harinna veel hattefilla rinna zo tefilla tefilla zo bakkasha en omer devar bakkasha achar emet veyatztziv aval achar hattefilla afilu keseder vidduy shel yom hakkippurim omer
Itmar name amar rav chiyya bar ashe amar rav af al pi sheamru shoel adam tzerachav beshomea tefilla im ba lomar achar tefillato afilu keseder shel yom hakkippurim omer

Amar rav hamnuna kamma hilcheta gibbaraota ika lemishma mehane kerae dechanna vechanna hi medabberet al libbah mikkan lammitpallel tzarich sheyechaven libbo rak sefateha naot mikkan lammitpallel sheyyachtoch bisfatav vekolah lo yishshamea mikkan sheasur lehagbiha kolo bitfillato vayyachsheveha eli leshikkora mikkan sheshshikkor asur lehitpallel
Vayyomer eleha eli ad matay tishtakkarin vego amar rabbi elazar mikkan laroe bachavero
b: Davar sheeno hagun tzarich lehochicho vattaan channa vattomer lo adoni amar ulla veitema rabbi yose berabbi chanina amara leh lo adon atta bedavar ze velo ruach hakkodesh shora alecha sheatta choshdeni bedavar ze
Ika deamri hachi amara leh lo adon atta lav ika shechina veruach hakkodesh gabbach sheddantani lechaf chova velo dantani lechaf zechut mi la yadatte deishsha keshat ruach anochi
Veyayin veshechar lo shatiti amar rabbi elazar mikkan lannechshad bedavar sheen bo shetztzarich lehodio

Al titten et amatcha lifne bat beliyyaal amar rabbi elazar mikkan leshikkor shemmitpallel keilu oved avoda zara ketiv hacha lifne bat beliyyaal uchtiv hatam yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal mikkirbecha ma lehallan avoda zara af kan avoda zara

Vayyaan eli vayyomer lechi leshalom amar rabbi elazar mikkan lachoshed et chavero bedavar sheen bo shetztzarich lefayeso velo od ella shetztzarich levarcho shenneemar velohe yisrael yitten et shelatech
Vattiddor neder vattomar tzevaot amar rabbi elazar miyyom shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu et olamo lo haya adam shekkerao lehakkadosh baruch hu tzevaot ad shebbata channa ukraattu tzevaot
Amra channa lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam mikkol tzive tzevaot shebbarata beolamcha kashe beenecha shettitten li ben echad

Mashal lamma haddavar dome lemelech basar vadam sheasa seuda laavadav ba ani echad veamad al happetach amar lahem tenu li perusa achat velo hishgichu alav dachak venichnas etzel hammelech amar lo adoni hammelech mikkol seuda sheasita kashe beenecha liten li perusa echat
Im rao tire amar rabbi elazar amra channa lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam im rao mutav veim lav tire
Elech veestatter bifne elkana baali vechevan demistattarna mashku li me sota vei atta ose toratcha pelaster shenneemar venikketa venizrea zara

Hanicha leman deamar im hayeta akara nifkedet shappir ella leman deamar im hayeta yoledet betzaar yoledet berevach nekevot yoledet zecharim shechorim yoledet levanim ketzarim yoledet arukkim may ika lememar

Detanya venikketa venizrea zara melammed sheim hayeta akara nifkedet divre rabbi yishmael amar leh rabbi akiva im ken yelchu kol haakarot kullan veyistatteru vezo shello kilkela nifkedet ella melammed sheim hayeta yoledet betzaar yoledet berevach ketzarim yoledet arukkim shechorim yoledet levanim echad yoledet shenayim
May im rao tire dibbera tora kilshon bene adam
Baoni amatecha al tishkach et amatecha venatatta laamatcha

Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina shalosh amatot hallalu lamma amra channa lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam shelosha bidke mita barata baishsha veamri lah shelosha divke mita veellu hen nidda vechalla vehadlakat hanner kelum avarti al achat mehen
Venatatta laamatcha zera anashim

May zera anashim amar rav gavra beguvrin ushmuel amar zera shemmosheach shene anashim uman inun shaul vedavid verabbi yochanan amar zera sheshshakul kishne anashim uman inun moshe veaharon shenneemar moshe veaharon bechohanav ushmuel bekore shemo verabbanan amri zera anashim zera shemmuvla ben anashim
Ki ata rav dimi amar lo aroch velo gutz velo katan velo allam velo tzachor velo gichor velo chacham velo tippesh
Ani haishsha hannitztzevet immecha baze amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mikkan sheasur leshev betoch arba ammot shel tefilla

El hannaar hazze hitpallalti amar rabbi elazar shemuel more halacha lifne rabbo haya shenneemar vayyishchatu et happar vayyaviu et hannaar el eli mishshum devayyishchatu et happar heviu hannaar el eli

Ella amar lahen eli kiru kohen lete velishchot chazanhu shemuel dahao mehadderi batar kohen lemishchat amar lehu lema lechu leahdore batar kohen lemishchat shechita bezar keshera ayetuhu lekammeh deeli amar leh mena lach ha amar leh mi ketiv veshachat hakkohen vehikrivu hakkohanim ketiv mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna mikkan lashshechita shekkeshera bezar

Amar leh memar shappir ka amratte mihu more halacha bifne rabbach atte vechol hammore halacha bifne rabbo chayyav mita atya channa veka tzavecha kammeh ani haishsha hannitztzevet immecha baze vego amar lah shivki li deeensheh uvena rachame veyahev lach rabba mineh amara leh el hannaar hazze hitpallalti

Vechanna hi medabberet al libbah amar rabbi elazar mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra al iske libbah amra lefanav ribbono shel olam kol ma shebbarata baishsha lo barata davar echad levattala enayim lirot veoznayim lishmoa chotem lehariach pe ledabber yadayim laasot bahem melacha raglayim lehallech bahen daddim lehanik bahen daddim hallalu shennatatta al libbi lamma lo lehanik bahen ten li ben veanik bahen
Veamar rabbi elazar mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra kol hayyoshev betaanit beshabbat korim lo gezar dino shel shivim shana veaf al pi chen chozrin venifrain mimmennu din oneg shabbat
May takkanteh amar rav nachman bar yitzchak litev taanita letaanita
Veamar rabbi elazar channa heticha devarim kelappe mala shenneemar vetitpallel al melammed sheheticha devarim kelappe mala

Veamar rabbi elazar eliyyahu hetiach devarim kelappe mala shenneemar veatta hasibbota et libbam achorannit amar rabbi shemuel bar rabbi yitzchak minnayin shechazar hakkadosh baruch hu vehoda lo leeliyyahu

a: Dichtiv vaasher hareoti
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina ilmale shalosh mikraot hallalu nitmottu raglehem shel sone yisrael
Chad dichtiv vaasher hareoti vechad dichtiv hinne chachomer beyad hayyotzer ken attem beyadi bet yisrael vechad dichtiv vahasiroti et lev haeven mibbesarchem venatatti lachem lev basar
Rav pappa amar mehacha veet ruchi etten bekirbechem veasiti et asher bechukkay telechu
Veamar rabbi elazar moshe hetiach devarim kelappe mala shenneemar vayyitpallel moshe el al tikre el ella al
Shekken deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov korin laalfin ayenin velaayenin alfin
Deve rabbi yannay amri mehacha vedi zahav
May vedi zahav amri deve rabbi yannay kach amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam bishvil kesef vezahav shehishpata lahem leyisrael ad sheamru day hu garam sheasu et haegel
Amri deve rabbi yannay en ari nohem mittoch kuppa shel teven ella mittoch kuppa shel basar
Amar rabbi oshaya mashal leadam shehayeta lo para kechusha uvaalat evarim heechilah karshinin vehayeta mevaetet bo amar lah mi garam lich shettehe mevaetet bi ella karshinin sheheechaltich

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan mashal leadam echad shehaya lo ben hirchitzo vesacho veheechilo vehishkahu vetala lo kis al tzavaro vehoshivo al petach shel zonot ma yaase oto habben shello yecheta

Amar rav acha bereh derav huna amar rav sheshet hayenu deamri inashe mele kereseh zene bishe shenneemar kemaritam vayyisbau savu vayyarom libbam al ken shechechuni rav nachman amar mehacha veram levavecha veshachachta et verabbanan amri mehacha veachal vesava vedashen ufana

Vei baet ema mehacha vayyishman yeshurun vayyivat amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan minnayin shechazar hakkadosh baruch hu vehoda lo lemoshe shenneemar vechesef hirbeti lahem vezahav asu labbaal

Vayedabber el moshe lech red may lech red amar rabbi elazar amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe moshe red miggedullatcha kelum natatti lecha gedulla ella bishvil yisrael veachshav yisrael chatu atta lamma li miyyad tashash kocho shel moshe velo haya lo koach ledabber vechevan sheamar heref mimmenni veashmidem amar moshe davar ze taluy bi miyyad amad venitchazzek bitfilla uvikkesh rachamim

Mashal lemelech shekkaas al beno vehaya makkehu makka gedola vehaya ohavo yoshev lefanav umityare lomar lo davar amar hammelech ilmale ohavi ze sheyyoshev lefanay haragticha amar davar ze taluy bi miyyad amad vehitztzilo

Veatta hannicha li veyichar appi vahem vaachallem veeese otcha legoy gadol vego amar rabbi avahu ilmale mikra katuv i efshar leomro melammed shettefaso moshe lehakkadosh baruch hu keadam shehu tofes et chavero bevigdo veamar lefanav ribbono shel olam en ani mannichacha ad shettimchol vetislach lahem

Veeese otcha legoy gadol vego amar rabbi elazar amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam uma kisse shel shalosh raglayim eno yachol laamod lefanecha bishat kasech kisse shel regel echad al achat kamma vechamma
Velo od ella sheyyesh bi boshet panim meavotay achshav yomru reu parnas sheheemid alehem bikkesh gedulla leatzmo velo bikkesh alehem rachamim

Vayechal moshe et pene amar rabbi elazar melammed sheamad moshe bitfilla lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ad shehechelahu verava amar ad shehefer lo nidro ketiv hacha vayechal uchtiv hatam lo yachel devaro veamar mar hu eno mechel aval acherim mechillin lo
Ushmuel amar melammed shemmasar atzmo lemita alehem shenneemar veim ayin mecheni na missifrecha
Amar rava amar rav yitzchak melammed shehuchala alehem middat rachamim
Verabbanan amri melammed sheamar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam chullin hu lecha measot kaddavar hazze

Vayechal moshe et pene tanya rabbi eliezer haggadol omer melammed sheamad moshe bitfilla lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ad sheachazattu achilu may achilu amar rabbi elazar esh shel atzamot may esh shel atzamot amar abbaye ishshata degarme

Zechor leavraham leyitzchak ulyisrael avadecha asher nishbata lahem bach may bach amar rabbi elazar amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam ilmale nishbata lahem bashshamayim uvaaretz hayiti omer keshem sheshshamayim vaaretz betelim kach shevuatcha betela veachshav shennishbata lahem beshimcha haggadol ma shimcha haggadol chay vekayyam leolam ulolme olamim kach shevuatcha kayyemet leolam ulolme olamim
Vattedabber alehem arbe et zarachem kechochve hashshamayim vechol haaretz hazzot asher amarti hay asher amarti asher amarta mibe leh

Amar rabbi elazar ad kan divre talmid mikkan veelach divre harav verabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar ellu vaellu divre talmid ella kach amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam devarim sheamarta li lech emor lahem leyisrael bishmi halachti veamarti lahem bishmecha achshav ma ani omer lahem
Mibbilti yecholet yachol mibe leh

Amar rabbi elazar amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu ribbono shel olam achshav yomru ummot haolam tashash kocho kinkeva veeno yachol lehatztzil amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe vahalo kevar rau nissim ugvurot sheasiti lahem al hayyam amar lefanav ribbono shel olam adayin yesh lahem lomar lemelech echad yachol laamod lishloshim veechad melachim eno yachol laamod
Amar rabbi yochanan minnayin shechazar hakkadosh baruch hu vehoda lo lemoshe shenneemar vayyomer salachti kidvarecha tane deve rabbi yishmael kidvarecha atidim ummot haolam lomar ken
Ashre talmid sherabbo mode lo
Veulam chay ani amar rava amar rav yitzchak melammed sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe moshe hecheyitani bidvarecha

Darash rabbi simlay leolam yesadder adam shivcho shel hakkadosh baruch hu veachar kach yitpallel menalan mimmoshe dichtiv vaetchannan el baet hahi uchtiv elohim atta hachillota leharot et avdecha et godlecha veet yadcha hachazaka asher mi el bashshamayim uvaaretz asher yaase chemaasecha vechigvurotecha uchtiv batreh ebera na veere et haaretz hattova vego

Netalo al ketefo vehevio levet hammidrash amar lahem reu banay en arvad memit ella hachet memit
Beotah shaa amru oy lo laadam sheppaga bo arvad veoy lo laarvad sheppaga bo rabbi chanina ben dosa

Veamar rav kahana chatzif alay man dimfaresh chiteh shenneemar ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa

a: Matni ketzad mevarchin al happerot al perot hailan hu omer bore peri haetz chutz min hayyayin sheal hayyayin hu omer bore peri haggefen veal perot haaretz hu omer bore peri haadama chutz min happat sheal happat hu omer hammotzi lechem min haaretz veal hayerakot hu omer bore peri haadama rabbi yehuda omer bore mine deshaim
Gema mena hane mile detanu rabbanan kodesh hillulim la melammed shetteunim beracha lifnehem ulacharehem mikkan amar rabbi akiva asur leadam sheyyitom kelum kodem sheyevarech

Vehay kodesh hillulim lehachi hu daata hay mibe leh chad deamar rachamana achaleh vahadar ichleh veidach davar hattaun shira taun chillul vesheeno taun shira en taun chillul vechidrabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan minnayin sheen omrim shira ella al hayyayin shenneemar vattomer lahem haggefen hechodalti et tiroshi hamsammeach elohim vaanashim im anashim mesammeach elohim bamme mesammeach mikkan sheen omrim shira ella al hayyayin
Hanicha leman detane neta revai ella leman detane kerem revai may ika lememar deittemar rabbi chiyya verabbi shimon berabbi chad tane kerem revai vechad tane neta revai

Ulman detane kerem revai hanicha i yalef gezera shava detanya rabbi omer neemar kan lehosif lachem tevuato veneemar lehallan utvuat hakkarem ma lehallan kerem af kan kerem iyattar leh chad hillul livracha
Vei la yalef gezera shava beracha mena leh vei name yalef gezera shava ashkechan leacharav lefanav minnayin
Ha la kashya deatya bekal vachomer keshehu savea mevarech keshehu raev lo kol shekken
Ashkechan kerem shear minin minnayin
Deyalef mikkerem ma kerem davar shennehene vetaun beracha af kol davar shennehene taun beracha
Ika lemifrach ma lecherem shekken chayyav beolelot
Kama tochiach ma lekama shekken chayyevet bechalla
Kerem yochiach vechazar haddin lo rei ze kiri ze velo rei ze kiri ze hatztzad hashshave shebbahen davar shennehene vetaun beracha af kol davar shennehene taun beracha
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bo tzad mizbeach veate name zayit deit beh tzad mizbeach
Vezayit mitztzad mizbeach ate veha behedya ketiv beh kerem dichtiv vayyaver miggadish vead kama vead kerem zayit amar rav pappa kerem zayit ikkere kerem setama la ikkere

Mikkol makom kashya ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shekken yesh bahen tzad mizbeach ella deyalef lah mishshivat hamminin ma shivat hamminin davar shennehene vetaun beracha af kol davar shennehene taun beracha
Ma leshivat hamminin shekken chayyavin bevikkurim veod hatinach leacharav lefanav minnayin
Ha la kashya deate bekal vachomer keshehu savea mevarech keshehu raev lo kol shekken
Ulman detane neta revai ha tinach kol devar netia delav bar netia kegon basar betzim vedagim mena leh ella sevara hu asur lo laadam sheyyehane min haolam hazze belo beracha
Tanu rabbanan asur lo laadam sheyyehane min haolam hazze belo beracha vechol hannehene min haolam hazze belo beracha maal may takkanteh yelech etzel chacham
Yelech etzel chacham may aved leh ha avad leh isura ella amar rava yelech etzel chacham meikara vilammedennu berachot kede shello yavo lide meila

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel kol hannehene min haolam hazze belo beracha keilu nehena mikkodshe shamayim shenneemar la haaretz umloah rabbi levi rame ketiv la haaretz umloah uchtiv hashshamayim shamayim la vehaaretz natan livne adam la kashya kan kodem beracha
b: Kan leachar beracha

Amar rabbi chanina bar pappa kol hannehene min haolam hazze belo beracha keilu gozel lehakkadosh baruch hu uchneset yisrael shenneemar gozel aviv veimmo veomer en pasha chaver hu leish mashchit veen aviv ella hakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar halo hu avich kanecha veen immo ella keneset yisrael shenneemar shema beni musar avicha veal tittosh torat immecha
May chaver hu leish mashchit amar rabbi chanina bar pappa chaver hu leyarovam ben nevat shehishchit et yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim
Rabbi chanina bar pappa rame ketiv velakachti degani beitto vego uchtiv veasafta deganecha vego
La kashya kan bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom kan bizman sheen yisrael osin retzono shel makom

Tanu rabbanan veasafta deganecha ma talmud lomar lefi shenneemar lo yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha yachol devarim kichtavan talmud lomar veasafta deganecha hanheg bahen minhag derech eretz divre rabbi yishmael

Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer efshar adam choresh bishat charisha vezorea bishat zeria vekotzer bishat ketzira vedash bishat disha vezore bishat haruach tora ma tehe aleha ella bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom melachtan naaset al yede acherim shenneemar veamdu zarim verau tzonchem vego uvizman sheen yisrael osin retzono shel makom melachtan naaset al yede atzman shenneemar veasafta deganecha velo od ella shemmelechet acherim naaset al yadan shenneemar veavadta et oyevecha vego
Amar abbaye harbe asu kerabbi yishmael vealta beyadan kerabbi shimon ben yochay velo alta beyadan
Amar lehu rava lerabbanan bematuta minayechu beome nisan uvome tishre la titchazo kammay ki hechi dela tittardu bimzonayechu kulla shatta

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay bo ure shello kedorot harishonim dorot haacharonim dorot harishonim asu toratan keva umlachtan aray zo vazo nitkayema beyadan dorot haacharonim sheasu melachtan keva vetoratan aray zo vazo lo nitkayema beyadan

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay bo ure shello kedorot harishonim dorot haacharonim dorot harishonim hau machnisin perotehen derech teraksemon kede lechayevan bemaaser dorot haacharonim machnisin perotehen derech gaggot derech chatzerot derech karpefot kede lefotran min hammaaser deamar rabbi yannay en hattevel mitchayyev bemaaser ad sheyyire pene habbayit shenneemar biarti hakkodesh min habbayit
Verabbi yochanan amar afilu chatzer kovaat shenneemar veachlu visharecha vesaveu

Chutz min hayyayin vechu may shena yayin ilema mishshum deishtanni leilluya ishtanni livracha vahare shemen deishtanni leilluya vela ishtanni livracha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel vechen amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan shemen zayit mevarchin alav bore peri haetz
Amri hatam mishshum dela efshar hechi nevarech nevarech bore peri hazzayit pera gufeh zayit ikkeri
Unvarech aleh bore peri etz zayit ella amar mar zutra chamra zayen mishcha la zayen
Umishcha la zayen vehatnan hannoder min hammazon muttar bammayim uvammelach vehavenan bah mayim umelach hu dela ikkeri mazon ha kol mile ikkeri mazon
Nema tehve teuvta derav ushmuel deamri en mevarchin bore mine mezonot ella bachameshet hamminin bilvad veamar rav huna beomer kol hazzan alay
Alma mishcha zayen ella chamra saed umishcha la saed vechamra mi saed veha rava hava shate chamra kol maale yoma defischa ki hechi denigrereh lelibbeh venechol matztza tefe tuva garer purta saed
Umi saed kelal vehachtiv veyayin yesammach levav enosh velechem levav enosh yisad vego nahama hu desaed chamra la saed ella chamra it beh tarte saed umsammach nahama misad saed sammoche la mesammach
I hachi nevarech aleh shalosh berachot la kavi inashe seodtayehu illaveh
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava i kava illaveh seodteh may amar leh lichsheyyavo eliyyahu veyomar i have keviuta hashta miha batla dato etzel kol adam

Gufa amar rav yehuda amar shemuel vechen amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan shemen zayit mevarchin alav bore peri haetz hechi dame ilema deka shate leh mishta ozoke mazzik leh detanya hashshote shemen shel teruma meshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh hassach shemen shel teruma meshallem et hakkeren umshallem et hachomesh

Ella deka achel leh al yede pat i hachi haveya leh pat ikar vehu tafel utnan ze hakkelal kol shehu ikar veimmo tefela mevarech al haikar ufoter et hattefela ella deka shate leh al yede anigron deamar rabba bar shemuel anigron mayya desilka ansigron mayya

a: Dechullehu shilke
Im ken have leh anigron ikar veshemen tafel utnan ze hakkelal kol shehu ikar veimmo tefela mevarech al haikar ufoter et hattefela
Hacha bemay askinan bechoshesh bigrono detanya hachoshesh bigrono lo yearennu beshemen techilla beshabbat aval noten shemen harbe letoch anigron uvolea
Peshita mahu detema kevan delirfua ka mechaven la levarech aleh kelal ka mashma lan kevan deit leh hanaa mineh bae baroche
Kimcha dechite rav yehuda amar bore peri haadama verav nachman amar shehakkol nihye bidvaro

Amar leh rava lerav nachman la tiflog aleh derav yehuda derabbi yochanan ushmuel kayemi keoteh deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel vechen amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan shemen zayit mevarchin alav bore peri haetz alma af al gav deishtanni bemilleteh kae ha name af al gav deishtanni bemilleteh kae
Mi dame hatam let leh illuya acharina hacha it leh illuya acharina befat

Vechi it leh illuya acharina la mevarchinan aleh bore peri haadama ella shehakkol veha amar rabbi zera amar rav matna amar shemuel akkara chayya vekimcha disare mevarchinan alayehu shehakkol nihya bidvaro may lav dechite bore peri haadama
La dechite name shehakkol nihya bidvaro
Velashmeinan dechite vechol shekken disare
I ashmeinan dechite hava amena hane mile dechite aval disare la levarech aleh kelal ka mashma lan

Umi gara mimmelach vezamit ditnan al hammelach veal hazzamit omer shehakkol nihye bidvaro itzterich salka datach amena melach vezamit aved inash deshade lefummeh aval kimcha disare hoil vekashe lekukyane la levarech aleh kelal ka mashma lan kevan deit leh hanaa mineh bae baroche
Kora rav yehuda amar bore peri haadama ushmuel amar shehakkol nihye bidvaro
Rav yehuda amar bore peri haadama pera hu ushmuel amar shehakkol nihya bidvaro hoil vesofo lehakshot
Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda shinana keotach mistabbera deha tzenon sofo lehakshot umvarchinan aleh bore peri haadama vela hi tzenon nati inashe addata defugla dikla la nati inashe addata dekora

Vechol hecha dela nati inashe addata dehachi la mevarchinan aleh vahare tzalaf denati inashe addata defircha utnan al mine nitzpa al healin veal hattemarot omer bore peri haadama veal haaviyyonot veal hakkafresin omer bore peri haetz
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak tzalaf nati inashe addata deshuta dikla la nati inashe addata dekora veaf al gav dekalleseh shemuel lerav yehuda hilcheta keoteh dishmuel

Amar rav yehuda amar rav tzalaf shel orla bechutza laaretz zorek et haaviyyonot veochel et hakkafresin lememra daaviyyonot pere vekafresin lav pere urminhu al mine nitzpa al healim veal hattemarot omer bore peri haadama veal haaviyyonot veal hakkafresin omer bore peri haetz
Hu deamar kerabbi akiva ditnan rabbi eliezer omer tzalaf mitasser temarot vaaviyyonot vekafresin rabbi akiva omer en mitasser ella aviyyonot bilvad mippene shehu peri
Venema halacha kerabbi akiva i amar halacha kerabbi akiva hava amena afilu baaretz ka mashma lan kol hammekel baaretz halacha kemoto bechutza laaretz aval baaretz la

Venema halacha kerabbi akiva bechutza laaretz dechol hammekel baaretz halacha kemoto bechutza laaretz i amar hachi hava amena hane mile gabbe masar ilan devaaretz gufa midderabbanan aval gabbe orla devaaretz middeorayeta ema bechutza laaretz name nigzor ka mashma lan

Ravina ashkecheh lemar bar rav ashe deka zarek aviyyonot vekaachel kafresin amar leh may datach kerabbi akiva demekel veleeved mar kevet shammay dimkili tefe ditnan tzalaf bet shammay omrim kilayim bakkerem uvet hallel omrim en kilayim bakkerem ellu veellu modim shechayyav beorla
Ha gufa kashya amratte tzalaf bet shammay omrim kilayim bakkerem alma min yarak hu vahadar tane ellu veellu modim shechayyav beorla alma min ilan hu

Ha la kashya bet shammay sappoke mesappeka lehu veavdi hacha lechumra vehacha lechumra mikkol makom levet shammay have leh safek orla utnan safek orla beeretz yisrael asur uvsurya muttar uvchutza laaretz yored
b: Velokeach uvilvad shello yirennu loket
Rabbi akiva bimkom rabbi eliezer avdinan kevateh uvet shammay bimkom bet hillel enah mishna
Vetipok leh denaasa shomer lapperi verachamana amar vaaraltem orlato et piro et hattafel lefiro umay nihu shomer lapperi
Amar rava hecha amrinan denaasa shomer lapperi hecha deiteh ben betalush ben bimchubbar hacha bimchubbar iteh betalush leteh

Etiveh abbaye pitma shel rimmon mitztarefet vehannetz shello en mitztaref middekaamar hannetz shello en mitztaref alma delav ochel hu utnan gabbe orla kelipe rimmon vehannetz shello kelipe egozim vehaggarinin chayyavin beorla
Ella amar rava hecha amrinan denaasa lehu shomer lefere hecha deiteh bishat gemar pera hay kafres leteh bishat gemar pera
Ini vehaamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avuh hane metachale deorla asiri hoil venaasu shomer lefere veshomer lefere imat have bechufra veka kare leh shomer lefere
Rav nachman savar lah kerabbi yose ditnan rabbi yose omer semadar asur mippene shehu peri ufligi rabbanan aleh

Matkif lah rav shimi minnehardea uvishar ilane mi peligi rabbanan aleh vehatnan meematay en kotztzin et hailanot bashsheviit bet shammay omrim kol hailanot mishsheyyotziu uvet hillel omrim hecharuvin mishsheyesharsheru vehaggefanim mishsheyegaru vehazzetim mishsheyyanetzu ushar kol hailanot mishsheyyotziu

Veamar rav assi hu boser hu gerua hu pol hallavan pol hallavan salka datach ella ema shiuro kefol hallavan man shamatte leh deamar boser in semadar la rabbanan vekatane shear kol hailanot mishsheyyotziu
Ella amar rava hecha amrinan dehave shomer lefere hecha dechi shaklatte leh leshomer mayet pera hacha ki shaklatte leh la mayet pera
Hava ovada veshakluh lenetz derimmona vivash rimmona veshakluh lefircha devitita veikayyam bitita

Vehilcheta kemar bar rav ashe dezarek et haaviyyonot veachel et hakkafresin umiddilgabbe orla lav pera ninhu legabbe berachot name lav pera ninhu vela mevarchinan aleh bore peri haetz ella bore peri haadama
Pilpele rav sheshet amar shehakkol rava amar la chelum veazda rava letameh deamar rava kas pilpele beoma dechippure patur kas zangevila beoma dechippure patur

Metivi haya rabbi meir omer mimmashma shenneemar vaaraltem orlato et piro eni yodea sheetz maachal hu ella ma talmud lomar etz maachal lehavi etz shettaam etzo ufiro shave veezehu ze happilpelin lelammedcha shehappilpelin chayyavin beorla ullammedcha sheen eretz yisrael chasera kelum shenneemar eretz asher lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem lo techsar kol bah
La kashya ha berattivta ha beyabbishta
Amri leh rabbanan lemarimar kas zangevila beoma dechippure patur veha amar rava hay himleta deatya mibbe hindue sharya umvarchinan alah bore peri haadama la kashya ha berattivta ha beyabbishta

Chavitz kedera vechen dayesa rav yehuda amar shehakkol nihye bidvaro rav kahana amar bore mine mezonot bedayesa gereda kulle alma la peligi devore mine mezonot ki peligi bedayesa keen chavitz kedera rav yehuda amar shehakkol savar duvsha ikar rav kahana amar bore mine mezonot savar semida ikar amar rav yosef kevateh derav kahana mistabbera derav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu kol sheyyesh bo mechameshet hamminin mevarchin alav bore mine mezonot

Gufa rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu kol sheyyesh bo mechameshet hamminin mevarchin alav bore mine mezonot veitmar name rav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu kol shehu mechameshet hamminin mevarchin alav bore mine mezonot
Utzricha dei ashmeinan kol shehu hava amena mishshum deiteh beeneh aval al yede taarovot la

a: Ka mashma lan kol sheyyesh bo vei ashmeinan kol sheyyesh bo have amena kol sheyyesh bo chameshet hamminim in aval orez vedochan la mishshum deal yede taarovet aval iteh beeneh nema afilu orez vedochan name mevarchin alav bore mine mezonot ka mashma lan kol shehu mechameshet hamminim hu dimvarchin alav bore mine mezonot leappoke orez vedochan daafilu iteh beeneh la mevarchinan bore mine mezonot

Veorez vedochan la mevarchinan bore mine mezonot vehatanya heviu lefanav pat orez ufat dochan mevarech alav techilla vasof kemaase kedera vegabbe maase kedera tanya battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot ulvassof mevarech alav beracha achat meen shalosh

Kemaase kedera vela kemaase kedera kemaase kedera dimvarchin alav techilla vasof vela kemaase kedera deilu bemaase kedera battechilla bore mine mezonot ulvassof beracha meen shalosh veilu hacha battechilla mevarech alav shehakkol nihye bidvaro ulvassof bore nefashot rabbot vechesronan al kal ma shebbarata
Veorez lav maase kedera hu vehatanya ellu hen maase kedera chilka targis solet zariz vearsan veorez
Ha manni rabbi yochanan ben nuri hi detanya rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer orez min dagan hu vechayyavin al chimmutzo karet veadam yotze bo yede chovato bappesach aval rabbanan la

Verabbanan la vehatanya hakkoses et hachitta mevarech aleha bore peri haadama techanah afaah uvishshelah bizman shehapperusot kayyamot battechilla mevarech aleha hammotzi lechem min haaretz ulvassof mevarech aleha shalosh berachot im en happerusot kayyamot battechilla mevarech aleha bore mine mezonot ulvassof mevarech aleha beracha achat meen shalosh

Hakkoses et haorez mevarech alav bore peri haadama techano afao uvishshelo af al pi shehapperusot kayyamot battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot ulvassof mevarech alav beracha achat meen shalosh
Manni ilema rabbi yochanan ben nuri hi deamar orez min dagan hu hammotzi lechem min haaretz veshalosh berachot bae baroche
Ella lav rabbanan hi utuvta derav ushmuel
Teuvta

Amar mar hakkoses et hachitta mevarech aleha bore peri haadama vehatanya bore mine zeraim la kashya ha rabbi yehuda veha rabbanan ditnan veal yerakot omer bore peri haadama rabbi yehuda omer bore mine deshaim
Amar mar hakkoses et haorez mevarech alav bore peri haadama techano afao uvishshelo af al pi shehapperusot kayyamot battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot ulvassof beracha achat meen shalosh

Vehatanya levassof vela chelum amar rav sheshet la kashya ha rabban gamliel veha rabbanan detanya ze hakkelal kol shehu mishshivat hamminim rabban gamliel omer shalosh berachot vachachamim omrim beracha achat meen shalosh

Umaase berabban gamliel vehazzekenim shehau mesubbin baaliyya biricho veheviu lifnehem kotavot veachlu venatan rabban gamliel reshut lerabbi akiva levarech kafatz uverach rabbi akiva beracha achat meen shalosh amar leh rabban gamliel akiva ad matay atta machnis roshcha ben hammachaloket amar lo rabbenu af al pi sheatta omer ken vachaverecha omrim ken limmadtanu rabbenu yachid verabbim halacha karabbim
Rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo kol shehu mishshivat hamminim
b: Velo min dagan hu o min dagan velo asao pat rabban gamliel omer shalosh berachot vachachamim omrim beracha achat kol sheeno lo mishshivat hamminin velo min dagan kegon pat orez vedochan rabban gamliel omer beracha achat meen shalosh vachachamim omrim velo chelum

Bemay okimta kerabban gamliel ema sefa deresha im en happerusot kayyamot battechilla mevarech aleha bore mine mezonot ulvassof mevarech aleha beracha achat meen shalosh manni i rabban gamliel hashta akkotavot veaddayesa amar rabban gamliel shalosh berachot im en happerusot kayyamot mibaya
Ella peshita rabbanan i hachi kashya derabbanan adderabbanan ella leolam rabbanan utni gabbe orez ulvassof eno mevarech alav velo kelum

Amar rava hay rihata dechaklae demappeshi beh kimcha mevarech bore mine mezonot may tama dismida ikar demachoza dela mappeshi beh kimcha mevarech alav shehakkol nihya bidvaro may tama duvsha ikar vahadar amar rava ide veide bore mine mezonot derav ushmuel deamri tarvayehu kol sheyyesh bo mechameshet hamminim mevarchin alav bore mine mezonot

Amar rav yosef hay chavitza deit beh perurin kezayit battechilla mevarech alav hammotzi lechem min haaretz ulvassof mevarech alav shalosh berachot delet beh perurin kezayit battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot ulvassof beracha achat meen shalosh

Amar rav yosef mena amena lah detanya haya omed umakriv menachot birushalayim omer baruch shehecheyanu vekiyyamnu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze netalan leochlan mevarech hammotzi lechem min haaretz vetane alah vechullan pottan kezayit

Amar leh abbaye ella meatta letanna deve rabbi yishmael deamar porchan ad shemmachziran lesoltan hachi name dela bae baroche hammotzi lechem min haaretz vechi tema hachi name vehatanya lakat mikkullan kezayit vaachalan im chametz hu anush karet veim matztza hu adam yotze bo yede chovato bappesach

Ella hacha bemay askinan beva millechem gadol
May have alah amar rav sheshet hay chavitza af al gav delet beh perurin kezayit mevarech alav hammotzi lechem min haaretz amar rava vehu deika aleh torita denahma
Teroknin chayyavin bachalla vechi ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan teroknin peturin min hachalla may teroknin amar abbaye kubba deara
Veamar abbaye terita petura min hachalla may terita ika deamri gevil merattach veika deamri nahama dehindeka veika deamri lechem heasuy lechuttach
Tane rabbi chiyya lechem heasuy lechuttach patur min hachalla veha tanya chayyav bachalla hatam kidkatane tama rabbi yehuda omer maaseha mochichin aleha asaan

Amar mar bar rav ashe veadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach may tama lechem oni karenan beh

Amar leh mi savratte kezayit gadol baenan kezayit benoni baenan veha ika vehahu deayeto lekammeh derabbi yochanan zayit gadol hava deaf al gav deshakluha legarinuteh pash leh shiura

La dechulle alma shelakot ufargiyyot shehakkol nihya bidvaro vehacha behay sevara ka mipalgi mar savar chabbiv adif umar savar keruv adif dezayen

Matni berach al perot hailan bore peri haadama yatza veal perot haaretz bore peri haetz lo yatza veal kullam im amar shehakkol nihye bidvaro yatza

Salka datach amena hoil veamar rabbi yehuda chitta min ilan hi livarech aleh bore peri haetz ka mashma lan hecha mevarchinan bore peri haetz hecha dechi shaklatte leh lefere iteh ligoza vahadar mappek
b: Aval hecha dechi shaklatte leh lefere leteh ligoza dahadar mappek la mevarchinan aleh bore peri haetz ella bore peri haadama

Amar lach rav huna ana daamari afilu lerabbi meir ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella hecha deka madkar shemeh defat aval hecha dela ka madkar shemeh defat afilu rabbi meir mode

Verabbi yochanan amar lach ana daamari afilu lerabbi yose ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose hatam ella mishshum dekaamar beracha dela takkinu rabbanan aval amar shehakkol nihye bidvaro detakkinu rabbanan afilu rabbi yose mode
Binyamin raaya kerach rifta vaamar berich mareh dehay pita amar rav yatza vehaamar rav kol beracha sheen bah hazkarat hashshem enah beracha deamar berich rachamana mareh dehay pita

Hau lefanav minin harbe rabbi yehuda omer im yesh benehen min shiva alav hu mevarech vachachamim omrim mevarech al eze mehen sheyyirtze

Ashsheara
Ika deamri bishlama leman deamar bushle chamra hayenu dimvarchinan alayehu shehakkol ella leman deamar tamre dezika shehakkol bore peri haetz mibbee leh levaroche

Ella benovlot setama kulle alma la peligi devushle chamra ninhu ki peligi benovlot temara ditnan hakkallin shebbaddemay hashshitin veharimin vehauzradin benot shuach uvnot shikma vegufnin venitzpa venovlot temara

Bishlama leman deamar bushle chamra hayenu dekatane hakkallin shebbaddemay sefekan hu defatur ha vaddaan chayyav ella leman deamar tamre dezika vaddaan chayyav hefkera ninhu

Ika deamri

a: Bishlama leman deamar tamre dezika hayenu dehacha kare lah novlot setama vehatam kare lah temara ella leman deamar bushle chamra nitne ide veide novlot temara o ide veide novlot setama kashya

Bishlama leman deamar beshebbirchotehen shaot machaloket shappir ella leman deamar besheen birchotehen shaot peligi bemay peligi amar rabbi yirmeya lehakdim
Deamar rav yosef veitema rabbi yitzchak kol hammukdam befasuk ze mukdam livracha shenneemar eretz chitta usora vegefen utena verimmon eretz zet shemen udvash

b: Ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo achar hammazon echad mevarech lechullam vehu omer al hammugmar veaf al pi sheen meviin et hammugmar ella leachar seuda

Berach al happat patar et happarperet al happarperet lo patar et happat bet shammay omrim af lo maase kedera

Amar rav adda bar ahava hay kesharta mevarchin illaveh bore atze besamim aval mishcha kevisha la verav kahana amar afilu mishcha kevisha aval mishcha techina la nehardae amri afilu mishcha techina
b: Amar rav gidel amar rav hay simlak mevarchin illaveh bore atze besamim amar rav chananel amar rav hane chilfe deyamma mevarchin alayehu bore atze besamim amar mar zutra may keraa vehi heelatam haggaga vattitmenem befishte haetz

Veamar rav zutra bar toviyya amar rav atidim bachure yisrael sheyyittenu reach tov kallevanon shenneemar yelchu yonkotav vihi chazzayit hodo vereach lo kallevanon
Veamar rav zutra bar toviyya amar rav may dichtiv et hakkol asa yafe veitto melammed shekkal echad veechad yippa lo hakkadosh baruch hu ummanuto befanav

Tanu rabbanan heviu lefanav shemen vahadas bet shammay omrim mevarech al hashshemen veachar kach mevarech al hahadas uvet hillel omrim mevarech al hahadas veachar kach mevarech al hashshemen amar rabban gamliel ani achria shemen zachinu lerecho vezachinu lesichato hadas lerecho zachinu lesichato lo zachinu amar rabbi yochanan halacha kedivre hammachria

Veal yetze yechidi ballayela mishshum chashada vela amaran ella dela kevia leh idana aval kevia leh idana mida yedia dilidaneh ka azel
