a: Dachanakteh umtza
Rabbi tarfon omer bore nefashot rabbot vechesronan amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye veamri lah lerav yosef hilcheta may amar leh pok chazi may amma davar
Matni shelosha sheachlu keachat chayyavin lezammen achal demay umaaser rishon shennittela terumato maaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu vehashshammash sheachal kezayit vehakkuti mezammenin alav

Achal tevel umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu vehashshammash sheachal pachot mikkazzayit vehannochri en mezammenin alav nashim vaavadim uktannim en mezammenin alehen ad kamma mezammenin ad kezayit rabbi yehuda omer ad kevetza
Gema mena hane mile amar rav assi deamar kera gaddelu la itti unromma shemo yachdav rabbi avahu amar mehacha ki shem ekra havu godel lelohenu
Amar rav chanan bar abba minnayin laone amen shello yagbiha kolo yoter min hamvarech shenneemar gaddelu la itti unromma shemo yachdav

Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi minnayin sheen hamtargem rashshay lehagbiha kolo yoter min hakkore shenneemar moshe yedabber vehaelohim yaanennu vekol sheen talmud lomar vekol uma talmud lomar vekol bekolo shel moshe
Tanya name hachi en hamtargem rashshay lehagbiha kolo yoter min hakkore veim i efshar lamtargem lehagbiha kolo keneged hakkore yemaech hakkore kolo veyikra
Ittemar shenayim sheachlu keachat peligi rav verabbi yochanan chad amar im ratzu lezammen mezammenin vechad amar im ratzu lezammen en mezammenin
Tenan shelosha sheachlu keachat chayyavin lezammen shelosha in shenayim la
Hatam chova hacha reshut
Ta shema shelosha sheachlu keachat chayyavin lezammen veen rashshain lechalek shelosha in shenayim la
Shane hatam dekavu lehu bechova meikara
Ta shema hashshammash shehaya meshammesh al hashshenayim hare ze ochel immahem af al pi shello natnu lo reshut haya meshammesh al hashshelosha hare ze eno ochel immahem ella im ken natnu lo reshut
Shane hatam
b: Denicha lehu demakba lehu bechova meikara

Ta shema nashim mezammenot leatzman vaavadim mezammenim leatzman nashim vaavadim uktannim im ratzu lezammen en mezammenin veha nashim afilu mea veha mea nashe kitre gavre damyan vekatane nashim mezammenot leatzman vaavadim mezammenin leatzman
Shane hatam deika deot
I hachi ema sefa nashim vaavadim im ratzu lezammen en mezammenin ammay la veha ika deot
Shane hatam mishshum peritzuta

Tistayyem derav deamar im ratzu lezammen en mezammenin deamar rav dimi bar yosef amar rav shelosha sheachlu keachat veyatza echad mehem lashshuk korin lo umzammenin alav tama dekorin lo ha lo korin lo la
Shane hatam deikkevau lehu bechova meikara
Ella tistayyem derabbi yochanan hu deamar im ratzu lezammen en mezammenin deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan shenayim sheachlu keachat echad mehen yotze bevirkat chavero
Vahavenan bah may ka mashma lan tenena shama velo ana yatza veamar rabbi zera lomar sheen birkat hazzimun benehem tistayyem
Amar leh rava bar rav huna lerav huna veha rabbanan daato mimmareva amri im ratzu lezammen mezammenin may lav dishmia lehu merabbi yochanan la dishmia lehu merav mikkamme dinchet levavel
Gufa amar rav dimi bar yosef amar rav shelosha sheachlu keachat veyatza echad mehem lashshuk korin lo umzammenin alav amar abbaye vehu dekaru leh veane
Amar mar zutra vela amaran ella bishlosha aval baasara ad denete
Matkef lah rav ashe adderabba ipcha mistabbera tisha nirin kaasara shenayim en nirin kishlosha
Vehilcheta kemar zutra may tama kevan devae leadkore shem shamayim betzir measara lav orach ara

Amar abbaye nekitinan shenayim sheachlu keachat mitzva lechalek tanya name hachi shenayim sheachlu keachat mitzva lechalek bamme devarim amurim kesheshshenehem sofrim aval echad sofer veechad bur sofer mevarech uvur yotze
Amar rava ha milta amrita ana veitamra mishshemeh derabbi zera keoti shelosha sheachlu keachat echad mafsik lashshenayim veen shenayim mafsikin laechad
Vela veha rav pappa afsek leh leabba mar bereh ihu vechad shane rav pappa delifnim mishshurat haddin hu daavad

Yehuda bar marimar umar bar rav ashe verav acha middifti karchi rifta bahade hadade la hava behu chad dahava muflag mechavreh levaroche lehu yatvi veka mibaya lehu ha ditnan shelosha sheachlu keachat chayyavin lezammen hane mile hecha deika adam gadol aval hecha dechi hadade ninhu chilluk berachot adif
Barech inish lenafsheh ato lekammeh demarimar amar lehu yede beracha yetzatem yede zimun lo yetzatem vechi temru nehdar unzammen en zimun lemafrea
Ba umtzaan keshehen mevarchim mahu omer acharehem rav zevid amar baruch umvorach rav pappa amar one amen
Vela peligi ha deashkechinhu deka amri nevarech veha deashkechinhu deka amri baruch ashkechinhu deka amri nevarech omer baruch umvorach ashkechinhu deka amri baruch one amen
Tane chada haone amen achar birchotav hare ze meshubbach vetanya idach hare ze megunne
La kashya ha bevone yerushalayim ha bishar berachot
Abbaye ane leh bekala ki hechi delishmeu poalim velekumu dehattov vehammetiv lav deorayeta rav ashe ane leh bilchisha ki hechi dela nezalzelu behattov vehammetiv

a: Rabbi zera chalash al legabbeh rabbi avahu kabbel aleh i mittefach kattina charich shake avedna yoma tava lerabbanan ittefach avad seodta lechullehu rabbanan ki meta lemishre amar leh lerabbi zera lishre lan mar amar leh la savar lah mar leha derabbi yochanan deamar baal habbayit botzea shera lehu
Ki meta levaroche amar leh nevarech lan mar amar leh la savar lah mar leha derav huna demin bavel deamar botzea mevarech
Veihu keman sevira leh
Ki ha deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay baal habbayit botzea veoreach mevarech baal habbayit botzea kede sheyyivtza beayin yafa veoreach mevarech kede sheyevarech baal habbayit
May mevarech yehi ratzon shello yevosh baal habbayit baolam hazze velo yikkalem leolam habba

Verabbi mosif bah devarim veyitzlach meod bechal nechasav veyihu nechasav unchasenu mutzlachim ukrovim lair veal yishlot satan lo bemaase yadav velo bemaase yadenu veal yizdakker lo lefanav velo lefanenu shum devar hirhur chet vaavera veaon meatta vead olam
Ad hechan birkat hazzimmun
Rav nachman amar ad nevarech verav sheshet amar ad hazzan

Nema ketannae detane chada birkat hammazon shenayim ushlosha vetanya idach shelosha vearbaa savruha dechulle alma hattov vehammetiv lav deorayeta hi may lav beha kamipalgi man deamar shettayim veshalosh kasavar ad hazzan uman deamar shalosh vearba kasavar ad nevarech
La rav nachman metaretz letameh verav sheshet metaretz letameh

Rav nachman metaretz letameh dechulle alma ad nevarech man deamar shalosh vearba shappir uman deamar shettayim veshalosh amar lach hacha bevirkat poalim askinan deamar mar poteach behazzan vecholel bone yerushalayim bevirkat haaretz
Rav sheshet metaretz letameh dechulle alma ad hazzan man deamar shettayim veshalosh shappir uman deamar shalosh vearba kasavar hattov vehammetiv deorayeta hi
Amar rav yosef tidda dehattov vehammetiv lav deorayeta shehare poalim okrim otah

Amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta mishshemeh derav tidda dehattov vehammetiv lav deorayeta shehare poteach bah bevaruch veen chotem bah bevaruch kidtanya kol habberachot kullan poteach bahen bevaruch vechotem bahen bevaruch chutz mibbirkat happerot uvirkat hammitzot uvracha hassemucha lachavertah uvracha acharona shebbikriat shema yesh mehen sheppoteach bahen bevaruch veen chotem bevaruch
b: Veyesh mehen shechotem bahen bevaruch veen poteach bevaruch vehattov vehammetiv poteach bevaruch veen chotem bevaruch mikkelal divracha bifne atzmah hi

Veamar rav nachman bar yitzchak tidda dehattov vehammetiv lav deorayeta shehare okrin otah bevet haevel kidtanya ma hem omrim bevet haevel baruch hattov vehammetiv rabbi akiva omer baruch dayyan haemet
Hattov vehammetiv in dayyan emet la ella ema af hattov vehammetiv

Mar zutra ikla leve rav ashe itra beh milleta petach uvarech hattov vehammetiv el emet dayyan emet shofet betzedek lokeach bammishpat veshallit beolamo laasot bo kirtzono ki chol derachav mishpat shehakkol shello vaanachnu ammo vaavadav uvakkol anachnu chayyavim lehodot lo ulvarcho goder peratzot beyisrael hu yigdor et happirtza hazzot beyisrael lechayyim
Lehechan hu chozer rav zevid mishshemeh deabbaye amar chozer larosh verabbanan amri lammakom sheppasak vehilcheta lammakom sheppasak

Amar leh resh galuta lerav sheshet af al gav derabbanan kashshishe attun parsae betzorche seuda bekii minayechu bizman shehen shette mittot gadol mesev barosh vesheni lo lemala hemennu uvizman shehem shalosh gadol mesev baemtza sheni lo lemala hemennu shelishi lo lematta hemennu
Amar leh vechi bae ishtaoye bahadeh metaretz tarotze veyatev umishtae bahadeh amar leh shane parsae demachve leh bemachog
Mayim rishonim mehechan matchilin amar leh min haggadol
Yeshev gadol veyishmor yadav ad shennotlin kullan amar leh lealtar mayetu takka kammeh
Mayim acharonim mehechan matchilin amar leh min hakkatan
Vegadol yatev veyadav mezohamot ad shennotlin kullan amar leh la mesalleki takka mikkammeh ad denimte mayya legabbeh

Amar rav sheshet ana matnita yadana detanya ketzad seder hasibba bizman shehen shette mittot gadol mesev barosh vesheni lo lematta hemennu bizman shehen shalosh mittot gadol mesev barosh sheni lo lemala hemennu shelishi lo lematta hemennu mayim harishonim matchilin min haggadol mayim acharonim bizman shehem chamishsha matchilin min haggadol uvizman shehem mea matchilin min hakkatan ad shemmaggiim etzel chamishi vechozrin umatchilin min haggadol velimkom shemmayim acharonim chozrin lesham beracha chozeret
Mesayya leh lerav deamar rabbi chiyya bar ashe amar rav kol hannotel yadav baacharona techilla hu mezumman livracha
Rav verabbi chiyya hao yatvi bisodta kammeh derabbi amar leh rabbi lerav kum meshi yedach chazyeh deka merattet amar leh bar pachate ayyen bevirkat mezona kaamar lach
Tanu rabbanan en mechabbedin lo bidrachim velo bigsharim

a: Velo beyadayim mezohamot

Ravin veabbaye hao ka azli beorcha kadmeh chamareh derabbin lidabbaye vela amar leh nezil mar amar middislik hay merabbanan mimmareva gas leh dateh ki meta lefitcha deve chenishta amar leh neal mar amar leh vead hashta lav mar ana amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan en mechabbedin ella befetach sheyyesh bah mezuza
Deit bah mezuza in delet bah mezuza la ella meatta bet hakkeneset uvet hammidrash delet behu mezuza hachi name deen mechabbedin ella ema befetach harauy limzuza
Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav en hamsubbin rashshain leechol kelum ad sheyyitom habbotzea yatev rav safra vekaamar litom itmar
Lemay nafka minah shechayyav adam lomar bilshon rabbo
Tanu rabbanan shenayim mamtinin ze laze bakkeara shelosha en mamtinin habbotzea hu poshet yado techilla veim ba lachalok kavod lerabbo o lemi sheggadol hemennu harshut beyado

Rabba bar bar chana hava asek leh livreh be rav shemuel bar rav kattina kadem veyatev vekamatne leh livreh en habbotzea rashshay livtzoa ad sheyyichle amen mippi haonim rav chisda amar mippi rov haonim
Amar lo rame bar chama may shena rubba deakkatti la kalya beracha miuta name la kalya beracha
Amar leh sheani omer kol haone amen yoter midday eno ella toe
Tanu rabbanan en onin lo amen chatufa velo amen ketufa velo amen yetoma velo yizrok beracha mippiv
Ben azzay omer kol haone amen yetoma yihu banav yetomim chatufa yitchattefu yamav ketufa yitkattefu yamav vechol hammaarich beamen maarichin lo yamav ushnotav

Rav ushmuel hao yatvi bisodta ata rav shimi bar chiyya hava kamsarhev veachel amar leh rav ma datach leitzterofe bahadan anan achilna lan amar leh shemuel illu mayetu li ardilayya vegozalayya leabba mi la achlinan
Talmide derav hao yatvi bisodta al rav acha amri ata gavra rabba dimvarech lan amar lehu mi savritu degadol mevarech ikar shebbasseuda mevarech vehilcheta gadol mevarech af al gav daata levassof

Achal demay vechu ha la chaze leh kevan dei bae mafkar lehu lenichseh vehave ani vachaze leh ditnan maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet haachsanya demay veamar rav huna tana bet shammay omrim en maachilin et haaniyyim veet haachsanya demay

Maaser rishon shennittela terumato peshita la tzericha ella shehikdimo bashshibbolim vehifrish mimmennu terumat maaser velo hifrish mimmennu teruma gedola vechidrabbi avahu deamar rabbi avahu amar resh lakish maaser rishon shehikdimo bashshibbolim patur mitteruma gedola shenneemar vaharemotem mimmennu terumat maaser min hammaaser maaser min hammaaser amarti lecha velo teruma gedola utrumat maaser min hammaaser
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye i hachi afilu hikdimo bichri name amar leh alecha amar kera
b: Mikkol maserotechem tarimu uma raita hay idgan vehay la idgan
Maaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu peshita hacha bemay askinan kegon shennatan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh veha ka mashma lan deen chomesh meakkev
Hashshammash sheachal kezayit peshita mahu detema shammash la kava ka mashma lan
Vehakkuti mezammenin alav ammay lo yehe ella am haaretz vetanya en mezammenin al am haaretz

Abbaye amar bechuti chaver rava amar afilu tema bechuti am haaretz vehacha beam haaretz derabbanan difligi aleh derabbi meir askinan detanya ezehu am haaretz kol sheeno ochel chullav betahora divre rabbi meir vachachamim omrim kol sheeno measser perotav karauy vehane kutae assore measseri kedachaze divmay dichtiv beorayeta mizhar zehiri deamar mar kol mitzva shehecheziku bah kutim harbe medakdekin bah yoter miyyisrael

Tanu rabbanan ezehu am haaretz kol sheeno kore keriat shema arvit veshacharit divre rabbi eliezer rabbi yehoshua omer kol sheeno manniach tefilin ben azzay omer kol sheen lo tzitzit bevigdo rabbi natan omer kol sheen mezuza al pitcho rabbi natan bar yosef omer kol sheyyesh lo banim veeno megaddelam letalmud tora acherim omrim afilu kara veshana velo shimmesh talmide chachamim hare ze am haaretz amar rav huna halacha kaacherim

Rame bar chama la azmen aleh derav menashsheya bar tachlifa detane sifra vesifre vehilcheta ki nach nafsheh derame bar chama amar rava la nach nafsheh derame bar chama ella dela azmen arav menashsheya bar tachlifa vehatanya acherim omrim afilu kara veshana velo shimmesh talmide chachamim hare ze am haaretz shane rav menashsheya bar tachlifa dimshamma lehu lerabbanan verame bar chama hu dela dak abbatreh lishana acharina deshama shematata mippummayehu derabbanan vegares lehu ketzorva merabbanan dame
Achal tevel umaaser vechu tevel peshita la tzericha betevel tavul midderabbanan hechi dame beatzitz sheeno nakuv
Maaser rishon ku peshita la tzericha kegon shehikdimo bichri mahu detema kedaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye ka mashma lan kidshanni leh

Maaser sheni vechu peshita la tzericha shennifdu velo nifdu kehilchatan maaser sheni kegon sheppedao al gabbe asimon verachamana amar vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha kesef sheyyesh lo alav tzura hekdesh shechillelo al gabbe karka velo pedao bechesef verachamana amar venatan hakkesef vekam lo
Vehashshammash sheachal pachot mikkezayit peshita ayedi ditna resha kezayit tena sefa pachot mikkezayit
Vehannochri en mezammenin alav peshita hacha bemay askinan beger shemmal velo taval deamar rabbi zera amar rabbi yochanan leolam eno ger ad sheyyimmol veyitbol vechamma dela teval goy hu
Nashim vaavadim uktannim en mezammenin alehen amar rabbi yose katan hammuttal baarisa mezammenin alav
Veha tenan nashim vaavadim uktannim en mezammenin alehem
Hu deamar kerabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi af al pi sheamru katan hammuttal baarisa en mezammenin alav aval osin oto senif laasara

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi tisha veeved mitztarfin metivi maase berabbi eliezer shennichnas levet hakkeneset velo matza asara veshichrer avdo vehishlimo laasara shichrer in lo shichrer la tere itzterichu shachrer chad venafek bechad
Vehechi aved hachi vehaamar rav yehuda kol hamshachrer avdo over baase shenneemar leolam bahem taavodu lidvar mitzva shane mitzva habbaa baavera hi mitzva derabbim shane

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi leolam yashkim adam levet hakkeneset kede sheyyizke veyimmane im asara harishonim sheafilu mea baim acharav kibbel alav sechar kullam sechar kullam salka datach ella ema notnin lo sachar keneged kullam
Amar rav huna tisha vearon mitztarfin amar leh rav nachman vearon gavra hu ella amar rav huna tisha nirin kaasara mitztarfin amri lah ki mechannefi veamri lah ki mevadderi

Amar rav amme shenayim veshabbat mitztarfin amar leh rav nachman veshabbat gavra hu ella amar rabbi amme shene talmide chachamim hamchaddedin ze et ze bahalacha mitztarfin machve rav chisda kegon ana verav sheshet machve rav sheshet kegon ana verav chisda

Amar rabbi yochanan katan poreach mezammenin alav tanya name hachi katan shehevi shette searot mezammenin alav veshello hevi shette searot en mezammenin alav veen medakdekin bekatan ha gufa kashya amratte hevi shette searot in la hevi la vahadar tane en medakdekin bekatan leetuye may lav

a: Leetuye katan poreach
Velet hilcheta kechol hane shematata ella ki ha deamar rav nachman katan hayyodea lemi mevarchin mezammenin alav

Abbaye verava hao yatvi kammeh derabba amar lehu rabba lemi mevarchin amri leh lerachamana verachamana hecha yatev rava achvi lishme telala abbaye nefak levarra achvi kelappe shemayya amar lehu rabba tarvayechu rabbanan havetu hayenu deamri inashe butzin butzin mikkitfeh yedia

Amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav tisha achlu dagan veechad achal yarak mitztarfin amar rabbi zera beay mineh merav yehuda shemona mahu shiva mahu amar li la shena shishsha vadday la mibbaya li amar leh rabbi yirmeya shappir avadte dela ibaya lecha hatam tama may mishshum deika rubba hacha name ika rubba veihu savar rubba deminchar baenan

Yannay malka umalketa kerichu rifta bahade hadade umiddiktal lehu lerabbanan la hava leh inish levaroche lehu amar lah lidvethu man yahev lan gavra dimvarech lan amara leh ishteva li dei mayetena lach gavra dela metzaaratte leh ishteva lah ayetiteh leshimon ben shatach achuha otveh ben dideh ledidah amar leh chazet kamma yekara avedna lach amar leh lav atte ka mokratte li ella orayeta hi demokra li dichtiv salseleha utrommekka techabbedcha ki techabbekenna amar lah ka chazet dela mekabbel marut
Yehavu leh kasa levaroche amar hechi avarech baruch sheachal yannay vachaverav mishshello shatyeh lehahu kasa yehavu leh kasa acharina uvarech

Amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan shimon ben shatach daavad legarmeh hu daavad dehachi amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan leolam eno motzi et harabbim yede chovatan ad sheyyochal kezayit dagan
Metivi rabban shimon ben gamliel omer ala vehesev immahem afilu lo tibbel immahem ella betzir velo achal immahem ella gerogeret achat mitztaref
Itzterofe mitztaref aval lehotzi et harabbim yede chovatan ad sheyyochal kezayit dagan
Itmar name amar rav chana bar yehuda mishshemeh derava afilu lo
b: Tibbel immahem ella betzir velo achal immahem ella gerogeret achat mitztaref ulhotzi et harabbim yede chovatam eno motzi ad sheyyochal kezayit dagan amar rav chana bar yehuda mishshemeh derava hilcheta achal ale yarak veshata kos shel yayin mitztaref lehotzi eno motzi ad sheyyochal kezayit dagan

Amar rav nachman moshe tikken leyisrael birkat hazzan beshaa sheyyarad lahem man yehoshua tikken lahem birkat haaretz kevan shennichnesu laaretz david ushlomo tikkenu bone yerushalayim david tikken al yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha ushlomo tikken al habbayit haggadol vehakkadosh hattov vehammetiv beyavne tikkenuha keneged haruge betar deamar rav matna oto hayyom shennitnu haruge betar likvura tiknu beyavne hattov vehammetiv hattov shello hisrichu vehammetiv shennitnu likvura

Tanu rabbanan seder birkat hammazon kach hi beracha rishona birkat hazzan sheniyya birkat haaretz shelishit bone yerushalayim reviit hattov vehammetiv uvshabbat matchil benechama umsayyem benechama veomer kedushshat hayyom baemtza rabbi eliezer omer ratza leomrah bannechama omrah bevirkat haaretz omrah bivracha shettikkenu chachamim beyavne omrah vachachamim omrim eno omrah ella bannechama bilvad
Chachamim hayenu tanna kamma ika benayehu diavad

Tanu rabbanan minnayin levirkat hammazon min hattora shenneemar veachalta vesavata uverachta zo birkat hazzan et elohecha zo birkat hazzimmun al haaretz zo birkat haaretz hattova zo bone yerushalayim vechen hu omer hahar hattov hazze vehallevanon asher natan lach zo hattov vehammetiv en li ella leacharav lefanav minnayin amratte kal vachomer keshehu savea mevarech keshehu raev lo kol shekken

Rabbi omer eno tzarich veachalta vesavata uverachta zo birkat hazzan aval birkat hazzimmun miggaddelu la itti nafka al haaretz zo birkat haaretz hattova zo bone yerushalayim vechen hu omer hahar hattov hazze vehallevanon hattov vehammetiv beyavne tikkenuha en li ella leacharav lefanav minnayin talmud lomar asher natan lach mishshennatan lach
Rabbi yitzchak omer eno tzarich hare hu omer uverach et lachmecha veet memecha al tikre uverach ella uvarech veematay karuy lechem kodem sheyyochlennu
Rabbi natan omer eno tzarich hare hu omer kevoachem hair ken timtzeun oto beterem yaale habbamata leechol ki lo yochal haam ad boo ki hu yevarech hazzevach achare chen yochlu hakkeruim

Vechol kach lamma lefi shehannashim dabberaniyyot hen ushmuel amar kede lehistakkel beyofo shel shaul dichtiv mishshichmo vamala gavoha mikkol haam verabbi yochanan amar lefi sheen malchut nogaat bachavertah afilu kimlo nima

Veen li ella birkat hammazon birkat hattora minnayin amar rabbi yishmael kal vachomer al chayye shaa mevarech al chayye olam habba lo kol shekken rabbi chiyya bar nachmani talmido shel rabbi yishmael omer mishshum rabbi yishmael eno tzarich hare hu omer al haaretz hattova asher natan lach ulhallan hu omer veettena lach et luchot haeven vehattora vehammitzva vego
Rabbi meir omer uminnayin shekkeshem shemmevarech al hattova kach mevarech al haraa talmud lomar asher natan lecha elohecha dayyancha bechal din sheddancha ben midda tova uven middat puranut

Rabbi yehuda ben betera omer eno tzarich hare hu omer tova hattova tova zo tora vechen hu omer ki lekach tov natatti lachem hattova zo binyan yerushalayim vechen hu omer hahar hattov hazze vehallevanon

Tanya rabbi eliezer omer kol shello amar eretz chemda tova urchava bevirkat haaretz umalchut bet david bevone yerushalayim lo yatza yede chovato nachum hazzaken omer tzarich sheyyizkor bah berit rabbi yose omer tzarich sheyyizkor bah tora pelemo omer tzarich sheyyakdim berit letora shezzo nittena beshalosh beritot

a: Vezo nittena bishlosh esre beritot
Rabbi abba omer tzarich sheyyomar bah hodaa techilla vasof vehappochet lo yifchot meachat vechol happochet meachat hare ze megunne

Vechol hachotem manchil aratzot bevirkat haaretz umoshia et yisrael bevone yerushalayim hare ze bur vechol sheeno omer berit vetora bevirkat haaretz umalchut bet david bevone yerushalayim lo yatza yede chovato
Mesayya leh lerabbi ila deamar rabbi ila amar rabbi yaakov bar acha mishshum rabbenu kol shello amar berit vetora bevirkat haaretz umalchut bet david bevone yerushalayim lo yatza yede chovato

Peligi bah abba yose ben dostay verabbanan chad amar hattov vehammetiv tzericha malchut vechad amar enah tzericha malchut man deamar tzericha malchut kasavar derabbanan uman deamar enah tzericha malchut kasavar deorayeta
Tanu rabbanan mahu chotem bevinyan yerushalayim rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer moshia yisrael moshia yisrael in bone yerushalayim la ella ema af moshia yisrael
Rabba bar rav huna ikla leve resh galuta petach bachada vesayyem betarte amar rav chisda gevurta lemechtam betarte vehatanya rabbi omer en chotmin bishtayim
Gufa rabbi omer en chotmin bishtayim etiveh levi lerabbi al haaretz veal hammazon eretz demappeka mazon al haaretz veal happerot eretz demappeka perot
Mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim yisrael dekaddeshinhu lizmannim mekaddesh yisrael verashe chodashim yisrael dekaddeshinhu lerashe chodashim
Mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim chutz mizzo
Umay shena hacha chada hi hatam tarte kol chada vachada beappe nafshah
Vetama may en chotmin bishtayim lefi sheen osin mitzot chavilot chavilot
May have alah

Amar rav sheshet patach berachem al ammecha yisrael chotem bemoshia yisrael patach berachem al yerushalayim chotem bevone yerushalayim verav nachman amar afilu patach berachem al yisrael chotem bevone yerushalayim mishshum shenneemar bone yerushalayim nidche yisrael yechannes ematay bone yerushalayim bizman shennidche yisrael yechannes

Amar leh rabbi zera lerav chisda nete mar venitne amar leh birkat mezona la gemirna vetannoye matnena amar leh may hay amar leh deikkelai leve resh galuta uvarechi birkat mezona vezakfeh rav sheshet lekoeh alay kechiveya veammay dela amari lo berit velo tora velo malchut veammay la amarte kidrav chananel amar rav deamar rav chananel amar rav lo amar berit vetora umalchut yatza berit lefi sheenah benashim tora umalchut lefi sheenan lo benashim velo baavadim veatte shevakte kol hane tannae veamorae vaavadte kerav

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan hattov vehammetiv tzericha malchut may ka mashma lan kol beracha sheen bah malchut lo shemah beracha veha amrah rabbi yochanan chada zimna amar rabbi zera lomar shetztzericha shette malchuot chada didah vachada devone yerushalayim

I hachi nive telat chada didah vachada devone yerushalayim vachada devirkat haaretz ella birkat haaretz may tama la mishshum dehaveya lah beracha hassemucha lachavertah bone yerushalayim name la tive dehaveya lah beracha hassemucha lachavertah
Hu haddin daafilu bone yerushalayim name la baaya ayede deamar malchut bet david lav orach ara dela amar malchut shamayim rav pappa amar hachi kaamar tzericha shette malchuot levar middidah

Yatev rabbi zera achore derav gidel veyatev rav gidel kammeh derav huna veyatev vekaamar taa velo hizkir shel shabbat omer baruch shennatan shabbatot limnucha leammo yisrael beahava leot velivrit baruch mekaddesh hashshabbat amar leh man amrah rav
Hadar yatev vekaamar taa velo hizkir shel yom tov omer baruch shennatan yamim tovim leammo yisrael lesimcha ulzikkaron baruch mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim amar leh man amrah rav

Hadar yatev vekaamar taa velo hizkir shel rosh chodesh omer baruch shennatan rashe chodashim leammo yisrael lezikkaron vela yadana i amar bah simcha i la amar bah simcha i chatem bah i la chatem bah i dideh i derabbeh
Gidel bar minome hava kae kammeh derav nachman tea rav nachman
b: Vahadar leresha amar leh may tama aved mar hachi amar leh deamar rabbi shela amar rav taa chozer larosh

Veha amar rav huna amar rav taa omer baruch shennatan amar leh lav itmar alah amar rav menashsheya bar tachlifa amar rav lo shanu ella shello patach behattov vehammetiv aval patach behattov vehammetiv chozer larosh
Amar rav idi bar avin amar rav amram amar rav nachman amar shemuel taa velo hizkir shel rosh chodesh battefilla machazirin oto bevirkat hammazon en machazirin oto

Amar leh rav avin lerav amram may shena tefilla umay shena birkat hammazon amar leh af ledidi kashya li ushelteh lerav nachman vaamar li mineh demar shemuel la shemia li ella nechze anan tefilla dechova hi machazirin oto birkat mezona dei bae achel i bae la achel en machazirin oto

Ella meatta shabbatot veyamim tovim dela saggi dela achel hachi name dei tae hadar amar leh in deamar rabbi shela amar rav taa chozer larosh veha amar rav huna amar rav taa omer baruch shennatan lav itmar alah lo shanu ella shello patach behattov vehammetiv aval patach behattov vehammetiv chozer larosh
Ad kamma mezammenin vechu

Lememra derabbi meir chashev leh kezayit verabbi yehuda kevetza veha ipcha shaminan lehu ditnan vechen mi sheyyatza miyerushalayim venizkar shehaya beyado besar kodesh im avar tzofim sorfo bimkomo veim lav chozer vesorfo lifne habbira meatze hammaaracha
Ad kamma hem chozrim rabbi meir omer ze veze bichvetza verabbi yehuda omer ze veze bichzayit

Amar rabbi yochanan muchlefet hashshita abbaye amar leolam la tefoch hacha bikrae peligi rabbi meir savar veachalta zo achila vesavata zo shetiyya vaachila bichzayit verabbi yehuda savar veachalta vesavata achila sheyyesh bah sevia veezo zo kevetza
Hatam bisvara peligi rabbi meir savar chazarato ketumato ma tumato bichvetza af chazarato bichvetza verabbi yehuda savar chazarato keisuro ma isuro bichzayit af chazarato bichzayit
Matni ketzad mezammenin bishlosha omer nevarech bishlosha vahu omer barchu
Baasara omer nevarech elohenu baasara vahu omer barchu echad asara veechad asara ribbo

Bemea hu omer nevarech elohenu bemea vahu omer barchu uvelef hu omer nevarech la elohenu elohe yisrael beelef vahu omer barchu beribbo omer nevarech la elohenu elohe yisrael elohe tzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu beribbo vahu omer barchu
Kainyan shehu mevarech kach onim acharav baruch elohenu elohe yisrael elohe tzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu

Rabbi yose haggelili omer lefi rov hakkahal hem mevarchim shenneemar bemakhelot barchu elohim mimmekor yisrael amar rabbi akiva ma matzinu bevet hakkeneset echad merubbim veechad muatim omer barchu et rabbi yishmael omer barchu et hamvorach
Gema amar shemuel leolam al yotzi adam et atzmo min hakkelal
Tenan bishlosha vahu omer barchu
Ema

a: Af barchu umikkol makom nevarech adif deamar rav adda bar ahava amri be rav tenena shishsha nechlakin ad asara
I amratte bishlama nevarech adif mishshum hachi nechlakin ella i amratte barchu adif ammay nechlakin ella lav shema minah nevarech adif shema minah

Tanya name hachi ben sheamar barchu ben sheamar nevarech en tofsin oto al kach vehannakdanin tofsin oto al kach umibbirchotav shel adam nikar im talmid chacham hu im lav ketzad rabbi omer uvtuvo hare ze talmid chacham umittuvo hare ze bur
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi vehachtiv umibbirchatcha yevorach et bet avdecha leolam bishela shane bishela name hachtiv harchev picha vaamalleehu hahu bedivre tora ketiv
Tanya rabbi omer betuvo chayinu hare ze talmid chacham chayyim hare ze bur neharbelae matni ipcha velet hilchata kinharbelae
Amar rabbi yochanan nevarech sheachalnu mishshello hare ze talmid chacham lemi sheachalnu mishshello hare ze bur
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe veha amrinan lemi sheasa laavotenu velanu et kol hannissim haellu amar leh hatam mochcha milta man aved nise kudsha berich hu
Amar rabbi yochanan baruch sheachalnu mishshello hare ze talmid chacham al hammazon sheachalnu hare ze bur

Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua la amaran ella bishlosha deleka shem shamayim aval baasara deika shem shamayim mochcha milta keditnan kainyan shehu mevarech kach onin acharav baruch elohe yisrael elohe hatztzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim al hammazon sheachalnu
Echad asara veechad asara ribbo ha gufa kashya amratte echad asara veechad asara ribbo alma ki hadade ninhu vahadar katane bemea omer beelef omer beribbo omer
Amar rav yosef la kashya ha rabbi yose haggelili ha rabbi akiva ditnan rabbi yose haggelili omer lefi rov hakkahal hem mevarchin shenneemar bemakhelot barchu elohim

Amar rabbi akiva ma matzinu bevet hakkeneset vechu verabbi akiva hay kera derabbi yose haggelili may aved leh mibe leh lechidtanya haya rabbi meir omer minnayin sheafilu ubbarin shebbime imman amru shira al hayyam shenneemar bemakhelot barchu elohim mimmekor yisrael veidach mimmekor nafka
Amar rava halacha kerabbi akiva ravina verav chama bar buzi ikkelau leve resh galuta kam rav chama veka mehaddar abbe mea amar leh ravina la tzerichatte hachi amar rava halacha kerabbi akiva
Amar rava ki achlinan rifta be resh galuta mevarchinan shelosha shelosha velivarchu asara asara shema resh galuta veikfad venipku bevirketa deresh galuta ayede deaveshu kulle alma la shami
Amar rabba tosfaa hane shelosha decharchi rifta bahade hadade ukdem chad minayehu uvarech ledateh inun nafkin bezimmun dideh ihu la nafek bezimmun didhu lefi sheen zimmun lemafrea

Rabbi yishmael omer rafram bar pappa ikkela leve kenishta daavi gibar kam kera besifra vaamar barchu et veishtik vela amar hamvorach avashu kulle alma barchu et hamvorach amar rava patya ukkama bahade pelugta lema lecha veod ha nehug alma kerabbi yishmael
Matni shelosha sheachlu keachat enan rashshain lechalek vechen arbaa vechen chamishsha shishsha nechlakin ad asara vaasara en nechelakin ad esrim
Shette chavurot shehau ochlot bevayit echad bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu hare ellu mitztarfin lezimmun veim lav ellu mezammenin leatzman veillu mezammenin leatzman
En mevarchin al hayyayin ad sheyyitten letocho mayim divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim mevarchin
Gema may ka mashma lan tenena chada zimna shelosha sheachlu keachat chayyavin lezammen
Ha ka mashma lan ki ha deamar rabbi abba amar shemuel shelosha sheyyashvu leechol keachat vaadayin lo achlu enan rashshain lechalek

Lishana acharina amar rabbi abba amar shemuel hachi katane shelosha sheyyashvu leechol keachat af al pi shekkal echad veechad ochel mikkikkaro enan rashshain lechalek i name ki ha derav huna deamar rav huna shelosha shebbau mishshalosh chavurot enan rashshain lechalek
Amar rav chisda vehu shebbau mishshalosh chavurot shel shelosha bene adam
Amar rava
b: Vela amaran ella dela akdimu hanach veazmun alayehu beduchtayehu aval azmun alayehu beduchtayehu perach zimun minayehu
Amar rava mena amena lah ditnan mitta shennigneva chetzyah o sheavda chetzyah o shechalakuha achin o shuttafin tehora hecheziruha mekabbelet tuma mikkan ulhabba
Mikkan ulhabba in lemafrea la alma kevan defalguha perach lah tuma minah hacha name kevan deazmun alayehu perach zimun minayehu
Shette chavurot vechu tana im yesh shammash benehem shammash metzarfan

En mevarchin al hayyayin tanu rabbanan yayin ad shello natan letocho mayim en mevarchin alav bore peri haggefen ella bore peri haetz venotlin mimmennu layyadayim mishshennatan letocho mayim mevarchin alav bore peri haggefen veen notlin mimmennu layyadayim divre rabbi eliezer vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach mevarchin alav bore peri haggefen veen notlin hemennu layyadayim
Keman azla ha deamar shemuel ose adam kol tzerachav befat keman kerabbi eliezer
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer bechos shel beracha sheen mevarchin alav ad sheyyitten letocho mayim may tama amar rav oshaya baenan mitzva min hammuvchar
Verabbanan lemay chaze amar rabbi zera chaze lekuryate
Tanu rabbanan arbaa devarim neemru befat en mannichin basar chay al happat veen maavirin kos male al happat veen zorkin et happat veen somchin et hakkeara befat

Ammemar umar zutra verav ashe kerachu rifta bahade hadade ayeti lekammayehu tamre verimmone shekal mar zutra petak lekammeh derav ashe dastana amar leh la savar lah mar leha detanya en zorkin et haochalin hahi befat tanya vehatanya keshem sheen zorkin et happat kach en zorkin et haochalin amar leh vehatanya af al pi sheen zorkin et happat aval zorkin et haochalin
Ella la kashya ha bemide demimmeis ha bemide dela mimmeis

Tanu rabbanan mamshichin yayin betzinnorot lifne chatan velifne kalla vezorkin lifnehem kelaot veegozim bimot hachamma aval lo bimot haggeshamim aval lo geluskaot lo bimot hachamma vela bimot haggeshamim
Amar rav yehuda shachach vehichnis ochalin letoch piv belo beracha mesallekan letzad echad umvarech
Tanya chada bolan vetanya idach poltan vetanya idach mesallekan
La kashya ha detanya bolan bemashkin veha detanya poltan bemide dela mimmeis veha detanya mesallekan bemide demimmeis

a: Bemide dela mimmeis name lesallekinhu letzad echad velivarech targemah rav yitzchak kaskesaa kammeh derabbi yose bar avin mishshemeh derabbi yochanan mishshum shenneemar yimmale fi tehillatecha
Beo mineh merav chisda mi sheachal veshata velo berach mahu sheyyachazor vivarech amar lehu mi sheachal shum verecho nodef yachzor veyochal shum acher kede sheyehe recho nodef
Amar ravina hilkach afilu gamar seuddato yachzor vivarech detanya taval veala omer baaliyyato baruch asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al hattevila
Vela hi hatam meikara gavra la chaze hacha meikara gavra chaze vehoil veidchi idchi
Tanu rabbanan isparagos yafe lallev vetov laenayim vechol shekken livne meayim veharagil bo yafe lechol gufo vehammishtakker hemennu kashe lechol gufo
Middekatane yafe lallev mikkelal divchamra askinan vekatane vechol shekken livne meayim vehatanya lelaat yafe leramat kashe
Ki tanya hahi bimushshan keditnan kunam yayin sheani toem shehayyayin kashe livne meayim amru lo vahalo meushshan yafe hu livne meayim veshatak asur bechadash umuttar bimushshan shema minah

Tanu rabbanan shishsha devarim neemru beisparagos en shotin oto ella keshehu chay umale mekabbelo beyamin veshotehu bismol veen mesichin acharav veen mafsikin bo veen machazirin oto ella lemi shennatnu lo verak acharav veen somchin oto ella bemino
Vehatanya en somchin oto ella befat la kashya ha bidchamra ha bidshichra
Tane chada lelaat yafe leramat kashe vetanya idach leramat yafe lelaat kashe la kashya ha bidchamra ha bidshichra
Tane chada rak acharav loke vetanya idach lo rak acharav loke la kashya ha bidchamra ha bidshichra
Amar rav ashe hashta deamratte lo rak acharav loke memav nizrakin afilu bifne hammelech

Amar rabbi yishmael ben elisha shelosha devarim sach li suriel sar happanim al tittol chalukcha beshacharit miyyad hashshammash vetilbash veal tittol yadecha mimmi shello natal yadav veal tachazir kos isparagos ella lemi shennetano lecha mippene shettachsefit veamri lah istalganit shel malache chabbala metzappin lo laadam veomrim ematay yavo adam lide echad middevarim hallalu veyillached

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi shelosha devarim sach li malach hammavet al tittol chalukcha shacharit miyyad hashshammash vetilbash veal tittol yadecha mimmi shello natal yadav veal taamod lifne hannashim beshaa shechozrot min hammet mippene sheani merakked uva lifnehen vecharbi beyaday veyesh li reshut lechabbel

Vei paga may takkanteh linshof midduchteh arba ammot i ika nahara lebereh vei ika darka acharina lezil bah vei ika guda leku achora vei la lahdar appeh velema vayyomer el hassatan yigar becha vego ad dechalfi mineh

Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi avahu veamri lah bematnita tana asara devarim neemru bechos shel beracha taun haddacha ushtifa chay umale itur veituf notlo bishte yadav venotno bayyamin umagbiho min hakkarka tefach venoten enav bo veyesh omrim af meshaggero bemattana leanshe veto
Amar rabbi yochanan anu en lanu ella arbaa bilvad hadacha shetifa chay umale tana hadacha mibbifnim ushtifa mibbachutz

Amar rabbi yochanan kol hamvarech al kos male notnin lo nachala beli metzarim shenneemar umale birkat yam vedarom yerasha rabbi yose bar chanina omer zoche venochel shene olamim haolam hazze vehaolam habba
Itur rav yehuda meatterehu betalmidim rav chisda meattar leh benatle amar rabbi chanan uvchay amar rav sheshet uvvirkat haaretz
Ituf rav pappa miattaf veyatev rav assi pares sudara al resheh
Notlo bishte yadav amar rabbi chinana bar pappa may keraa seu yedechem kodesh uvarchu et
Venotno layyamin amar rabbi chiyya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan rishonim shaalu semol mahu shettesayyea layyamin amar rav ashe hoil verishonim ibaya lehu velo ipshit lehu
b: Anan naaved lechumra
Umagbiho min hakkarka tefach amar rav acha berabbi chanina may keraa kos yeshuot essa uvshem ekra
Venoten enav bo ki hechi dela nasach dateh mineh
Umshaggero leanshe beto bemattana ki hechi detitbarach devethu

Ulla ikkela leve rav nachman kerech rifta barech birkat mezona yehav leh kasa devirketa lerav nachman amar leh rav nachman lishaddar mar kasa devirketa leyalta amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan en peri vitnah shel ishsha mitbarech ella mipperi bitno shel ish shenneemar uverach peri vitnecha peri vitnah lo neemar ella peri vitnecha
Tanya name hachi rabbi natan omer minnayin sheen peri vitnah shel ishsha mitbarech ella mipperi bitno shel ish shenneemar uverach peri vitnecha peri vitnah lo neemar ella peri vitnecha

Addehachi shemaa yalta kama bezihara veallat leve chamra utvara arba mea danne dechamra amar leh rav nachman neshaddar lah mar kasa acharina shelach lah kol hay navga devirketa hi shelacha leh mimmehaddure mile umissemartute kalme

Amar rav assi en massichin al kos shel beracha veamar rav assi en mevarchin al kos shel puranut may kos shel puranut amar rav nachman bar yitzchak kos sheni tanya name hachi hashshote kiflayim lo yevarech mishshum shenneemar hikkon likrat elohecha yisrael vehay la metakkan
Amar rabbi avahu veamri lah bematnita tana haochel umhallech mevarech meummad uchshehu ochel meummad mevarech meushshav uchshehu mesev veochel yoshev umvarech vehilcheta bechullehu yoshev umvarech

Matni ellu devarim shebben bet shammay uven bet hillel basseuda bet shammay omrim mevarech al hayyom veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin uvet hillel omrim mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hayyom
Bet shammay omrim notlin layyadayim veachar kach mozgin et hakkos uvet hillel omrim mozgin et hakkos veachar kach notlin layyadayim
Bet shammay omrim mekanneach yadav bammappa umannichah al hashshulchan uvet hillel omrim al hakkeset
Bet shammay omrim mechabbedin et habbayit veachar kach notlin layyadayim uvet hillel omrim notlin layyadayim veachar kach mechabbedin et habbayit
Bet shammay omrim ner umazon besamim vehavdala uvet hillel omrim ner uvsamim mazon vehavdala
Bet shammay omrim shebbara meor haesh uvet hillel omrim bore meore haesh
En mevarchin lo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel goyim velo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel metim velo al hanner velo al habbesamim shel avoda zara veen mevarchin al hanner ad sheyyeotu leoro
Mi sheachal veshachach velo berach bet shammay omrim yachzor limkomo vivarech uvet hillel omrim yevarech bimkom shennizkar vead matay mevarech ad kede sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav
Ba lahen yayin achar hammazon im en sham ella oto kos bet shammay omrim mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hammazon uvet hillel omrim mevarech al hammazon veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin
Veonin amen achar yisrael hamvarech veen onin amen achar kuti hamvarech ad sheyyishma kol habberacha kullah

Gema tanu rabbanan devarim shebben bet shammay uvet hillel bisuda bet shammay omrim mevarech al hayyom veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin shehayyom gorem layyayin sheyyavo uchvar kadash hayyom vaadayin yayin lo ba

Uvet hillel omrim mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hayyom shehayyayin gorem lakkedushsha shetteamer davar acher birkat hayyayin tedira uvirkat hayyom enah tedira tadir vesheeno tadir tadir kodem vahalacha kedivre bet hillel
May davar acher vechi tema hatam tarte vehacha chada hacha name tarte ninhu birkat hayyayin tedira uvirkat hayyom enah tedira tadir vesheeno tadir tadir kodem
Vahalacha kedivre bet hillel peshita deha nafka bat kol

Haroe shofar bachalom yashkim veyomar vehaya bayyom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher tiku shofar baggiva

Haroe kelev bachalom yashkim veyomar ulchol bene yisrael lo yecheratz kelev leshono kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher vehakkelavim azze nefesh haroe ari bachalom yashkim veyomar arye shaag mi lo yira kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher ala arye missubbecho

Haroe tiglachat bachalom yashkim veyomar vayegallach vayechallef simlotav kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher ki im gullachti vesar mimmenni chochi haroe beer bachalom yashkim veyomar beer mayim chayyim kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher kehakir bayir memeha haroe kane bachalom yashkim veyomar kane ratzutz lo yishbor kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher hinne vatachta lecha al mishenet hakkane haratzutz

Tanu rabbanan haroe kane bachalom yetzappe lechochma shenneemar kene chachma kanim yetzappe levina shenneemar uvchol kinyancha kene vina amar rabbi zera kara kura kira kanya kullehu meallu lechelma tanya en marin dilluin ella lemi shehu yere shamayim bechal kocho
Haroe shor bachalom yashkim veyomar bechor shoro hadar lo kodem sheyyikdemennu pasuk acher ki yiggach shor et ish

Tanu rabbanan chamishsha devarim neemru beshor haochel mibbesaro mitashsher negacho haveyin leh banim shemnaggechim battora neshacho yissurin baim alav beato derech rechoka nizdammena lo rechavo ole ligdulla
Vehatanya rechavo met la kashya ha derachev hu letora ha derachev tora ledideh

Haroe chamor bachalom yetzappe lishua shenneemar hinne malkech yavo lach tzaddik venosha hu ani verochev al chamor haroe chatul bachalom beatra dekaru leh shunnara naaset lo shira naa shinara naase lo shinuy ra haroe anavim bachalom levanot ben bizmannan uven shello bizmannan yafot shechorot bizmannan yafot shello bizmannan raot haroe sus lavan bachalom ben benachat ben beraduf yafe lo adom benachat yafe beraduf kashe

Haroe yishmael bachalom tefillato nishmaat vedaveka yishmael ben avraham aval tayyaa bealma la haroe gamal bachalom mita niknesa lo min hashshamayim vehitztziluhu mimmenna amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina may keraa veanochi ered immecha mitzrayema veanochi aalcha gam alo rav nachman bar yitzchak amar mehacha gam heevir chattatcha lo tamut
Haroe pinchas bachalom pele naasa lo haroe pil bachalom pelaot naasu lo pilim pile pelaot naasu lo
Vehatanya kol mine chayyot yafin lachalom chutz min happil umin hakkof la kashya

a: Ha dimsarag ha dela mesarag haroe huna bachalom nes naasa lo chanina chananya yochanan nisse nissim naasu lo haroe hesped bachalom min hashshamayim chasu alav ufdauhu vehane mile bichtava
Haone yehe shemeh rabba mevarach muvtach lo shehu ben haolam habba hakkore keriat shema rauy shettishre alav shechina ella sheen doro zakkay lechach

Hammanniach tefilin bachalom yetzappe ligdulla shenneemar verau kol amme haaretz ki shem nikra alecha vego vetanya rabbi eliezer haggadol omer ellu tefilin shebbarosh hammitpallel bachalom siman yafe lo vehane mile dela sayyem

Habba al immo bachalom yetzappe levina shenneemar ki im labbina tikra habba al naara meorasa yetzappe letora shenneemar tora tziva lanu moshe morasha kehillat yaakov al tikre morasha ella meorasa habba al achoto bachalom yetzappe lechochma shenneemar emor lachochma achoti atte habba al eshet ish bachalom muvtach lo shehu ben haolam habba vehane mile dela yada lah vela harhar bah meurta

Amar rabbi chiyya bar abba haroe chittim bachalom raa shalom shenneemar hassam gevulech shalom chelev chittim yasbiech haroe seorim bachalom saru aonotav shenneemar vesar aonecha vechattatcha techuppar amar rabbi zera ana la selaki mibbavel leeretz yisrael ad dachazay seare bechelma
Haroe gefen teuna bachalom en ishto mappelet nefalim shenneemar eshtecha kegefen poriyya soreka yetzappe lammashiach shenneemar osri laggefen iro velassoreka beni atono

Haroa teena bachalom torato mishtammeret bekirbo shenneemar notzer teena yochal piryah haroe rimmonim bachalom zutre pare iskeh kerimmona ravreve rave iskeh kerimmona palge im talmid chacham hu yetzappe letora shenneemar ashkecha miyyayin harekach measis rimmoni veim am haaretz hu yetzappe lemitzot shenneemar kefelach harimmon rakkatech may rakkatech afilu rekanin shebbach meleim mitzot kerimmon

Haroe zetim bachalom zutre pare verave vekae iskeh kezetim vehane mile pere aval ilane haveyin leh banim merubbin shenneemar banecha kishtile zetim vego ika deamri haroe zayit bachalom shem tov yotze lo shenneemar zayit raanan yefe feri toar kara shemech haroe shemen zayit bachalom yetzappe limor tora shenneemar veyikchu elecha shemen zayit zach haroe temarim bachalom tammu aonotav shenneemar tam aonech bat tziyyon

Amar rav yosef haroe ez bachalom shana mitbarechet lo izzim shanim mitbarchot lo shenneemar vede chalev izzim lelachmecha haroe hadas bachalom nechasav matzlichin lo veim en lo nechasim yerushsha nofelet lo mimmakom acher amar ulla veamri lah bematnita tana vehu dachaza bechannayehu haroe etrog bachalom hadur hu lifne kono shenneemar peri etz hadar kappot temarim haroe lulav bachalom en lo ella lev echad leaviv shebbashshamayim
Haroe auoz bachalom yetzappe lechochma shenneemar chochmot bachutz taronna vehabba aleha have rosh yeshiva amar rav ashe ani reitiha uvati aleha uslekit ligdulla

Haroe tarnegol bachalom yetzappe leven zachar tarnegolim yetzappe levanim zecharim tarnegolet yetzappe letarbitza naa vegila haroe betzim bachalom teluya bakkashato nishtabberu naaset bakkashato vechen egozim vechen kishshuim vechen kol kele zechuchit vechen kol hannishbarim kaellu
Hannichnas lakkerach naasu lo chafatzav shenneemar vayyanchem el mechoz cheftzam hamgalleach rosho bachalom siman yafe lo rosho uzkano lo ulchol mishpachto
Hayyoshev baareva ketanna shem tov yotze lo baareva gedola lo ulchol mishpachto vehane mile demiddalya dalloye
Hannifne bachalom siman yafe lo shenneemar mihar tzoe lehippateach vehane mile dela kannach

Haole laggag bachalom ole ligdulla yarad yored miggedullato abbaye verava deamri tarvayehu kevan sheala ala hakkorea begadav bachalom korim lo gezar dino haomed arom bachalom bevavel omed belo chet beeretz yisrael arom belo mitzot hannitpas lesardeot shemira naaset lo netanuhu bekolar hosifu lo shemira al shemirato vehane mile bekolar aval chavla bealma la
Hannichnas laagam bachalom naase rosh yeshiva leyaar naase rosh livne challa

Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua chazo chelma rav pappa deayel leagma naasa rosh yeshiva rav huna bereh derav yehoshua deayel leyaar naasa rosh livne kalla ika deamri tarvayehu leagma ayeli ella rav pappa ditle tavla naasa rosh yeshiva rav huna bereh derav yehoshua dela tele tavla naasa rosh livne kalla amar rav ashe ana ayalit leagma utlay tavla venabbachi bah nabboche
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman bar yitzchak hammakkiz dam bachalom aonotav mechulin lo
Vehatanya aonotav sedurin lo may sedurin sedurin limachel

Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet haroe nachash bachalom parnasato mezummenet lo neshacho nichpela lo harago avda parnasato amar leh rav sheshet kol shekken shennichpela parnasato vela hi rav sheshet hu dachaza chiveya bechelmeh vekatleh

Tane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan kol mine mashkin yafin lachalom chutz min hayyayin yesh shotehu vetov lo veyesh shotehu vera lo yesh shotehu vetov lo shenneemar veyayin yesammach levav enosh veyesh shotehu vera lo shenneemar tenu shechar leoved veyayin lemare nafesh
Amar leh rabbi yochanan letanna teni talmid chacham leolam tov lo shenneemar lechu lachamu velachami ushtu beyayin masachti
b: Amar rabbi yochanan hishkim venafal pasuk letoch piv hare ze nevua ketanna tanu rabbanan shelosha melachim hem haroe david bachalom yetzappe lachasidut shelomo yetzappe lechochma achav yidag min happuranut
Shelosha neviim hem haroe sefer melachim yetzappe ligdulla yechezkel yetzappe lechochma yeshaya yetzappe lenechama yirmeya yidag min happuranut
Shelosha ketuvim gedolim hem haroe sefer tehillim yetzappe lachasidut mishle yetzappe lechochma iyyov yidag min happuranut
Shelosha ketuvim ketannim hem haroe shir hashshirim bachalom yetzappe lachasidut kohelet yetzappe lechochma kinot yidag min happuranut haroe megillat ester nes naasa lo
Shelosha chachamim hem haroe rabbi bachalom yetzappe lechochma rabbi elazar ben azarya yetzappe laashirut rabbi yishmael ben elisha yidag min happuranut
Shelosha talmide chachamim hem haroe ben azzay bachalom yetzappe lachasidut ben zoma yetzappe lechochma acher yidag min happuranut
Kol mine chayyot yafot lachalom chutz min happil vehakkof vehakkippod vehaamar mar haroe pil bachalom pele naasa lo la kashya ha dimsarag ha dela mesarag

Kol mine mattechet yafin lachalom chutz mimmar pesal vekardom vehane mile dachazanhu bekattayehu kol mine perot yafin lachalom chutz mippagge temara kol mine yerakot yafin lachalom chutz merashe lefatot vehaamar rav la iattari ad dachazay rashay lefatot ki chaza bechannayehu chaza kol mine tzivonin yafin lachalom chutz min hattechelet kol mine ofot yafin lachalom chutz min karya vekippofa vekurperay
Hagguf hagguf meen meshivin umarchivin siman

Shelosha nichnasin lagguf veen hagguf nehene mehen gudgedaniyyot vechafniyyot ufagge temara shelosha en nichnasin lagguf vehagguf nehene mehen ellu hen rechitza vesicha vetashmish shelosha meen haolam habba ellu hen shabbat shemesh vetashmish
Tashmish demay ilema tashmish hammitta ha michchash kachesh ella tashmish nekavim
Shelosha meshivin dato shel adam ellu hen kol umare vareach shelosha marchivin dato shel adam ellu hen dira naa veishsha naa vechelim naim

Chamishsha veshishsha vaasara siman chamishsha echad mishshishshim ellu hen esh devash veshabbat veshena vachalom esh echad mishshishshim legehinnam devash echad mishshishshim lamman shabbat echad mishshishshim laolam habba shena echad mishshishshim lammita chalom echad mishshishshim lannevua

Shishsha devarim siman yafe lachole ellu hen ittush zea shilshul keri veshena vachalom ittush dichtiv atishotav tahel or zea dichtiv bezeat appecha tochal lechem shilshul dichtiv mihar tzoe lehippateach velo yamut lashshachat keri dichtiv yire zera yaarich yamim shena dichtiv yashanti az yanuach li chalom dichtiv vetachalimeni vehachayeni

Shishsha devarim merappein et hachole mecholo urfuato refua ellu hen keruv utradin vesisin yeveshin vekeva veheret veoteret hakkaved veyesh omrim af dagim ketannim vela od ella sheddagim ketannim mafrin umavrin kol gufo shel adam

Asara devarim machazirin et hachole lecholo vecholo kashe ellu hen haochel besar shor basar shamen besar tzali besar tzipporim uvetza tzeluya vetiglachat veshachalayim vehechalav vehaggevina vehammerchatz veyesh omrim af egozim veyesh omrim af kishshuim

Tana deve rabbi yishmael lamma nikra sheman kishshuim mippene shehen kashin lagguf kacharavot ini vehachtiv vayyomer lah shene goyim bevitnech al tikre goyim ella geyim veamar rav yehuda amar rav ellu antoninus verabbi shello pasak mishshulchanam lo tzenon velo chazeret velo kishshuin lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim
La kashya ha beravreve ha bezutre

Tanu rabbanan met babbayit shalom babbayit achal veshata babbayit siman yafe labbayit natal kelim min habbayit siman ra labbayit targemah rav pappa bimsana vesandala kol deshakel shachva mealle bar mimmesana vesandala kol deyahev shachva mealle bar meafra vechardela

Makom shenneekra mimmennu avoda zara tanu rabbanan haroe markulis omer baruch shennatan erech appayim leovre retzono makom shenneekra mimmennu avoda zara omer baruch sheakar avoda zara meartzenu uchshem shenneekra mimmakom ze ken teaker mikkol mekomot yisrael vehashev lev ovdehem leovdecha uvchutz laaretz en tzarich lomar vehashev lev ovdehem leovdecha mippene sherubbah goyim rabbi shimon ben elazar omer af bechutz laaretz tzarich lomar ken mippene sheatidim lehitgayyer shenneemar az ehpoch el ammim safa verura

Darash rav hamnuna haroe bavel harshaa tzarich levarech chamesh berachot raa bavel omer baruch shehecheriv bavel harshaa raa beto shel nevuchadnetztzar omer baruch shehecheriv beto shel nevuchadnetztzar harasha raa gov shel araot o kivshan haesh omer baruch sheasa nissim laavotenu bammakom hazze raa markulis omer baruch shennatan erech appayim leovre retzono raa makom shennotlin mimmennu afar omer baruch omer veose gozer umkayyem

Rava ki hava chaze chamare deshakli afra taref lehu yeda al gabbayehu veamar rehutu tzaddike lemebad reuta demarayechu mar bereh deravina ki hava mate levavel hava shakel afra besudareh veshade levarra lekayyem ma shenneemar vetetetiha bematate hashmed amar rav ashe ana ha derav hamnuna la shemia li ella middatay barechtinhu lechullehu

a: Amar rabbi yirmeya ben elazar nitkallela bavel nitkallelu shecheneha nitkallela shomron nitbarchu shecheneha nitkallela bavel nitkallelu shecheneha dichtiv vesamtiha lemorash kippod veagme mayim nitkallela shomron nitbarchu shecheneha dichtiv vesamti shomron lei hassade lemattae charem vego
Veamar rav hamnuna haroe uchluse yisrael omer baruch chacham harazim uchluse goyim omer bosha immechem vego

Tanu rabbanan haroe uchluse yisrael omer baruch chacham harazim sheen datam doma ze laze veen partzufehen domim ze laze ben zoma raa uchlusa al gav maala behar habbayit amar baruch chacham harazim uvaruch shebbara kol ellu leshammesheni

Hu haya omer kamma yegiot yaga adam harishon ad shemmatza pat leechol charash vezara vekatzar veimmer vedash vezara uvarar vetachan vehirkid velash veafa veachar kach achal vaani mashkim umotze kol ellu metukkanin lefanay vechamma yegiot yaga adam harishon ad shemmatza beged lilbosh gazaz velibben venippetz vetava vearag veachar kach matza beged lilbosh vaani mashkim umotze kol elle metukkanim lefanay kol ummot shokdot uvaot lefetach beti vaani mashkim umotze kol ellu lefanay

Hu haya omer oreach tov mahu omer kamma terachot tarach baal habbayit bishvili kamma basar hevi lefanay kamma yayin hevi lefanay kamma geluskaot hevi lefanay vechol ma shettarach lo tarach ella bishvili aval oreach ra mahu omer ma torach tarach baal habbayit ze pat achat achalti chaticha achat achalti kos echad shatiti kol torach shettarach baal habbayit ze lo tarach ella bishvil ishto uvanav
Al oreach tov mahu omer zechor ki tasgi foolo asher shorru anashim al oreach ra ketiv lachen yereuhu anashim vego

Vehaish bime shaul zaken ba vaanashim amar rava veitema rav zevid veitema rav oshaya ze yishay avi david sheyyatza beuchlusa venichnas beuchlusa vedarash beuchlusa amar ulla nekitinan en uchlusa bevavel tana en uchlusa pechuta mishshishshim ribbo

Tanu rabbanan haroe chachme yisrael omer baruch shechalak mechochmato lireav chachme ummot haolam omer baruch shennatan mechochmato levasar vadam haroe malche yisrael omer baruch shechalak mikkevodo lireav malche ummot haolam omer baruch shennatan mikkevodo levasar vadam

Amar rabbi yochanan leolam yishtaddel adam larutz likrat malche yisrael velo likrat malche yisrael bilvad ella afilu likrat malche ummot haolam sheim yizke yavchin ben malche yisrael lemalche ummot haolam

Rav sheshet saggi nehor hava hao kaazli kulle alma lekabbole appe malka vekam azal bahadayehu rav sheshet ashkecheh hahu mina amar leh chatzve lenahra kagne leya amar leh ta chazi deyadana tefe minach chalaf gunda kammayeta ki ka avesha amar leh hahu mina ata malka amar leh rav sheshet la kaate chalaf gunda tinyana ki ka avesha amar leh hahu mina hashta ka ate malka amar leh rav sheshet la ka ate malka chalef telitay ki ka shatka amar leh rav sheshet vadday hashta ate malka

Amar leh hahu mina mena lach ha amar leh demalchuta deara keen malchuta dirkia dichtiv tze veamadta vahar lifne vehinne over veruach gedola vechazak mefarek harim umshabber selaim lifne lo varuach veachar haruach raash lo varaash veachar haraash esh lo vaesh veachar haesh kol demama dakka

Ki ata malka patach rav sheshet veka mevarech leh amar leh hahu mina leman dela chazet leh ka mevarchatte umay havi aleh dehahu mina ika deamri chavrohi kachlinhu leeneh veika deamri rav sheshet natan enav bo venaasa gal shel atzamot

Rabbi shela naggedeh lehahu gavra dival goya azal achal beh kurtze be malka amar ika chad gavra bihudae deka dayen dina bela harmana demalka shaddar aleh peristeka ki ata amri leh may tama naggedteh lehay amar lehu deva al chamarta amri leh it lecha sahadi amar lehu in ata eliyyahu iddemi leh keinish veashed amri leh i hachi bar ketala hu amar lehu anan miyyoma diglenan mearin let lan reshuta lemiktal attun may devaetun avidu beh

Ad dimayeni beh bedina petach rabbi shela vaamar lecha haggedulla vehaggevura vego amri leh may kaamratte amar lehu hachi kaamena berich rachamana deyahev malchuta beara keen malchuta dirkia vihav lechu shultana verachami dina amaru chabbiva aleh yekara demalchuta kulle hay yahavi leh kulfa amaru leh dun dina

Ki hava nafek amar leh hahu gavra aved rachamana nisa leshakkare hachi amar leh rasha lav chamare ikru dichtiv asher besar chamorim besaram chazyeh dekaazel lememra lehu dikrinhu chamare amar hay rodef hu vehattora amra im ba lehorgecha hashkem lehorgo machyeh bekulfa vekatleh

Amar hoil veitavid li nisa behay kera dareshna leh lecha haggedulla zo maase vereshit vechen hu omer ose gedolot ad en cheker vehaggevura zo yetziat mitzrayim shenneemar vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola vego vehattiferet zo chamma ulvana sheamdu lo lihoshua shenneemar vayyiddom hashshemesh veyareach amad vego vehannetzach zo mappaltah shel romi vechen hu omer veyez nitzcham al begaday vego vehahod zo milchemet nachale arnon shenneemar al ken yeamar besefer milchamot et vahev besufa vego ki chol bashshamayim uvaaretz zo milchemet sisra shenneemar min shamayim nilchamu hakkochavim mimmesillotam vego lecha hammamlacha zo milchemet amalek vechen hu omer ki yad al kes yah vehammitnasse zo milchemet gog umagog vechen hu omer hinni elecha gog nesi rosh meshech vetuval lechol lerosh amar rav chanan bar rava amar rabbi yochanan afilu resh gargita min shemayya mannu leh
Bematnita tanna mishshemeh derabbi akiva lecha haggedulla zo keriat yam suf vehaggevura zo makkat bechorot vehattiferet zo mattan tora vehannetzach zo yerushalayim vehahod zo bet hammikdash
b: Tanu rabbanan haroe batte yisrael beyishshuvan omer baruch matztziv gevul almana bechurbanan omer baruch dayyan haemet batte ummot haolam beyishshuvan omer bet geim yissach bechurbanan omer el nekamot el nekamot hofia

Ulla verav chisda hao ka azli beorcha ki meto appitcha deve rav chana bar chanilay negad rav chisda veittenach amar leh ulla ammay ka mittenachatte vehaamar rav anacha shoveret chatzi gufo shel adam shenneemar veatta ven adam heanach beshivron motnayim vego verabbi yochanan amar af kol gufo shel adam shenneemar vehaya ki yomru elecha al ma atta neenach veamarta el shemua chi vaa venames kol lev vego

Amar leh hechi la ettenach beta dahao bah shitin afyata bimama veshitin afyata belelya veafyan lechol man ditzrich vela shekal yeda min kisa disvar dilma ate ane bar tovim veaddematu leh lechisa ka mikkesif vetu hao petichin leh arba bave learba ruchata dealma vechol dahava ayel kafen nafek ki sava vahao shadu leh chitte usare bishne vatztzoret abbaray dechol man dichsifa milta lemishkal bimama ate veshakel belelya hashta nefal betilla vela ettenach

Amar leh hachi amar rabbi yochanan miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash nigzera gezera al battehen shel tzaddikim sheyyechervu shenneemar beoznay tzevaot im lo battim rabbim leshamma yihu gedolim vetovim meen yoshev veamar rabbi yochanan atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziran leyishshuvan shenneemar shir hammaalot ledavid habbotchim ba kehar tziyyon ma har tziyyon atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziro leyishshuvo af battehen shel tzaddikim atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachaziran leyishshuvan chazyeh dela meyashva dateh amar leh dayyo leeved sheyehe kerabbo

Tanu rabbanan haroe kivre yisrael omer baruch asher yatzar etchem baddin vezan etchem baddin vechilkel etchem baddin veasaf etchem baddin veatid lahakimchem baddin mar bereh deravina mesayyem bah mishshemeh derav nachman veodea mispar kullechem vehu atid lehachotchem ulkayyem etchem baruch mechayye hammetim kivre goyim omer bosha immechem vego

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi haroe et chavero leachar sheloshim yom omer baruch shehecheyanu vekiyemanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze leachar shenem asar chodesh omer baruch mechayye hammetim amar rav en hammet mishtakkeach min hallev ella leachar shenem asar chodesh shenneemar nishkachti kemet millev hayiti kichli oved

Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua hao kaazli beorcha pegau beh berav chanina bereh derav ika amaru leh bahade dachazenach barechinan alach tarte baruch asher chalak mechochmato lireav veshehecheyanu amar lehu ana name kevan dachazitinchu chashshevtinchu illavay keshitin ribbeon bet yisrael uvarechna alayechu telata hanach tarte uvaruch chacham harazim amaru leh chachimatte kulle hay yahavi beh enayehu ushchev

Ika deamri amar rav matna afilu bichrach sheddanin vehorgin bo zimnin dela mitreme leh inash deyalef leh zechuta

Bishlama hu metaher vehem metammein lechumra ella hu metamme vehem metaharin hechi have veha tanya chacham shettimme en chavero rashshay letaher asar en chavero rashshay lehattir kasavri ki hechi dela niggarru batreh
Tanu rabbanan keshennichnesu rabbotenu lakkerem beyavne hau sham rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili patchu kullam bichvod achsanya vedarshu

Patach rabbi yehuda rosh hamdabberim bechal makom bichvod tora vedarash umoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma aron shello haya meruchak ella shenem asar mil amra tora vehaya kol mevakkesh yetze el ohel moed talmide chachamim sheholchim meir lair umimmedina limdina lilmod tora al achat kamma vechamma

Vedibber el moshe panim el panim amar rabbi yitzchak amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe moshe ani veatta nasbir panim bahalacha ika deamri kach amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe keshem sheani hisbarti lecha panim kach atta hasber panim leyisrael vehachazer haohel limkomo

Veshav el hammachane vego amar rabbi avahu amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe achshav yomru harav bechaas vetalmid bechaas yisrael ma tehe alehem im atta machazir haohel limkomo mutav veim lav yehoshua bin nun talmidcha mesharet tachtecha
Vehayenu dichtiv veshav el hammachane amar rava af al pi chen lo yatza haddavar levattala shenneemar umsharto yehoshua bin nun naar lo yamish mittoch haohel

Veod patach rabbi yehuda bichvod tora vedarash hasket ushma yisrael hayyom hazze nihyeta leam vechi oto hayyom nittena tora leyisrael vahalo oto yom sof arbaim shana haya ella lelammedcha shechaviva tora al lomdeha bechal yom vaom kayyom shennittena mehar sinay
Amar rabbi tanchum bereh derabbi chiyya ish kefar akko teda shehare adam kore keriat shema shacharit vearvit veerev echad eno kore dome kemi shello kara keriat shema meolam

Hasket asu kittot kittot veisku battora lefi sheen hattora niknet ella bachavura kidrabbi yose berabbi chanina deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina may dichtiv cherev el habbaddim venoalu cherev al sonehem shel talmide chachamim sheyyoshvim bad bevad veoskim battora velo od ella shemmittappeshim ketiv hacha venoalu uchtiv hatam asher noalnu velo od ella shechotim shenneemar vaasher chatanu
Ibaet ema mehacha noalu sare tzoan

Davar acher hasket ushma yisrael kattetu atzmechem al divre tora kidamar resh lakish deamar resh lakish minnayin sheen divre tora mitkayemin ella bemi shemmemit atzmo aleha shenneemar zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel
Davar acher hasket ushma yisrael has veachar kach kattet kidrava deamar rava leolam yilmod adam tora veachar kach yehege
Amri deve rabbi yannay may dichtiv ki mitz chalav yotzi chema umitz af yotzi dam umitz appayim yotzi riv
Bemi atta motze chema shel tora bemi shemmeki chalav sheyyanak mishde immo aleha
Umitz af yotzi dam kol talmid shekkoes alav rabbo paam rishona veshotek zoche lehavchin ben dam tame ledam tahor

Umitz appayim yotzi riv kol talmid shekkoes alav rabbo paam rishona ushniyya veshotek zoche lehavchin ben dine mamonot ledine nefashot ditnan rabbi yishmael omer harotze sheyyitchakkem yaasok bedine mamonot sheen lach miktzoa battora yoter mehen shehen kemayan novea
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani may dichtiv im navalta vehitnasse veim zammota yad lefe kol hamnabbel atzmo al divre tora sofo lehitnasse veim zamam yad lefe

Patach rabbi nechemya bichvod achsanya vedarash may dichtiv vayyomer shaul el hakkeni lechu suru redu mittoch amaleki pen osifcha immo veatta asita chesed im kol bene yisrael vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma yitro shello kerav et moshe ella lichvod atzmo kach hamareach talmid chacham betoch beto umaachilo umashkehu umhannehu minnechasav al achat kamma vechamma

Patach rabbi yose bichvod achsanya vedarash lo tetaev adomi ki achicha hu lo tetaev mitzri ki ger hayita veartzo vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma mitzriyyim shello kervu et yisrael ella letzorech atzman shenneemar veim yadata veyesh bam anshe chayil vesamtam sare mikne al asher li kach hamareach talmid chacham betoch beto umaachilo umashkehu umhannehu minnechasav al achat kamma vechamma

Patach rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili bichvod achsanya vedarash vayevarech et oved edom haggitti baavur aron haelohim vahalo devarim kal vachomer uma aron shello achal veshata ella kibbed veribbetz lefanav kach hamareach talmid chacham betoch beto umaachilo umashkehu umhannehu minnechasav al achat kamma vechamma
May hi beracha shebbercho amar rav yehuda bar zevida zo chamot ushmone kalloteha sheyyaldu shishsha shishsha bechares echad

a: Shenneemar peulletay hashshemini uchtiv ki vercho elohim kol elle mibbene oved edom hemma uvnehem vaachehem ish chayil bakkoach laavoda shishshim ushnayim leoved edom
Amar rabbi avin hallevi kol haddochek et hashshaa shaa dochakto vechol hannidche mippene hashshaa shaa nidchet mippanav

Midderabba verav yosef derav yosef sinay verabba oker harim itztericha lehu shata shelachu lehatam sinay veoker harim eze mehem kodem shelachu lehu sinay kodem shehakkol tzerichin lemare chittayya af al pi chen lo kibbel alav rav yosef deamri leh kaldae malchatte tarten shenin
Melach rabba esrin vetarten shenin melach rav yosef tarten shenin ufalga
Kol hanach shene dimlach rabba afilu ummana leveteh la kera
Veamar rabbi avin hallevi may dichtiv yaancha beom tzara yesaggevcha shem elohe yaakov elohe yaakov velo elohe avraham veyitzchak mikkan levaal hakkora sheyyikkanes beovyah shel kora

Veamar rabbi avin hallevi kol hannehene misseuda shettalmid chacham sharuy betochah keilu nehene mizziv shechina shenneemar vayyavo aharon vechol zikne yisrael leechol lechem im choten moshe lifne haelohim vechi lifne elohim achlu vahalo lifne moshe achlu
Ella lomar lach kol hannehene misseuda shettalmid chacham sharuy betochah keilu nehene mizziv shechina

Veamar rabbi avin hallevi hanniftar mechavero al yomar lo lech beshalom ella lech leshalom shehare yitro sheamar lo lemoshe lech leshalom ala vehitzliach david sheamar lo leavshalom lech beshalom halach venitla
Veamar rabbi avin hallevi hanniftar min hammet al yomar lo lech leshalom ella lech beshalom shenneemar veatta tavo el avotecha beshalom
Amar rabbi levi bar chiyya hayyotze mibbet hakkeneset venichnas levet hammidrash veosek battora zoche umkabbel pene shechina shenneemar yelchu mechayil el chayil yerae el elohim betziyyon
Amar rabbi chiyya bar ashe amar rav talmide chachamim en lahem menucha lo baolam hazze velo baolam habba shenneemar yelchu mechayil el chayil yerae el elohim betziyyon
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam shenneemar vechol banayich limmude verav shelom banayich

Al tikre banayich ella bonayich shalom rav leohave toratecha veen lamo michshol yehi shalom bechelech shalva bearmenotayich lemaan achay vereay adabbera na shalom bach lemaan bet elohenu avaksha tov lach oz leammo yitten yevarech et ammo vashshalom
